# 金铲铲 · 海克斯核心

**dsh-jcc-theme** — 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换一副金铲铲同人外观：原创海克斯竞技场背景、
金色铲影、四套强化配色与可开关的氛围光效，右下角一枚「海克斯核心」，点开就能换强调色、
调棋盘纹理与棱角，或者一键关掉。

> 非官方同人作品，与腾讯、Riot Games 无关。不含任何游戏素材：图标与底纹都是本仓库用
> CSS / SVG 画的几何图形，配色来自公开的设计令牌。「金铲铲之战」「Teamfight Tactics」
> 是其各自权利人的商标。

![深色 · 海克斯金](assets/screenshot-dark.png)

## 它做了什么

- **两套明暗外观**：浅色是羊皮纸棋盘地图，深色是奥术蓝黑竞技场；跟随 DSH 的「浅色 / 深色 /
  跟随系统」设置，无需单独开关。
- **原创背景图**：夜场是六边形看台、金色铲影与漂浮海克斯晶体；浅色是旧地图等高线、罗盘与
  同款铲影。两张都以内联 SVG data URI 提供，不额外请求任何图片。
- **四枚强化符文**：海克斯金、奥术青、狂暴紫、星界蓝。切换后边框、品牌色、链接、焦点环、
  侧栏选中态一起换；切换是纯 CSS 属性，不重载页面。
- **棋盘纹理**：淡 / 标准 / 浓烈三档，控制界面底层那层六边形网格与两团环境光的强度。
- **氛围光效**：一层缓慢呼吸的极光，加两层速度不同的金色浮尘，全部在应用画布之后；
  面板里可以关掉，`prefers-reduced-motion` 下自动停止动画。
- **界面棱角**：圆润 / 锐利。锐利会同时收紧面板和产品自己的圆角令牌，卡片、按钮、
  输入框一起变成 HUD 方角。
- **海克斯核心**：右下角悬浮的六边形按钮。面板里可以启用/关闭主题、换强调色、调纹理、
  切棱角、开关氛围光效、恢复默认；选择记在本机 `localStorage`，刷新后还在。
- **关闭即还原**：所有页面级样式都挂在 `<html data-jcc="on">` 下。关掉开关（或从插件市场
  停用）后，原生界面立刻回来，不用卸载。

浅色：

![浅色 · 海克斯金](assets/screenshot-light.png)

星界蓝 + 锐利棱角 + 浓烈纹理：

![深色 · 星界蓝 · 锐利](assets/screenshot-sharp.png)

## 安装

要求 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 或更新**（含桌面端）。插件只带浏览器半边，没有宿主服务、没有配置
schema、没有终端命令。

### 从插件市场安装

收录后，在 **设置 → 插件市场** 里搜索「金铲铲」或 `dsh-jcc-theme`，一键安装。

### 从命令行安装

```sh
# 预构建 tarball（推荐，装完不用构建）
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/liuyaguang8023/dsh-jcc-theme/releases/latest/download/dsh-jcc-theme.tgz"

# 或直接从源码装（仓库里已带构建产物，无需 npm install）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:liuyaguang8023/dsh-jcc-theme
```

装完按市场的提示刷新页面；如果宿主在启动时组合 bundle，重启一次 `dsh web` 即可。

## 使用

1. 页面右下角出现六边形「海克斯核心」按钮。
2. 点开面板：
   - **启用主题** — 总开关，关掉完全还原原生界面；
   - **强化符文** — 金 / 青 / 紫 / 蓝四种强调色；
   - **棋盘纹理** — 淡 / 标准 / 浓烈；
   - **界面棱角** — 圆润 / 锐利；
   - **氛围光效** — 极光与金色浮尘的开/关；
   - **恢复默认** — 回到海克斯金 + 标准纹理 + 圆润 + 氛围开。
3. 点面板外面或按 `Esc` 收起。

选择存储在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-jcc/v1` 键里，格式是
`{"on":true,"accent":"gold","texture":"normal","ambience":true,"corners":"soft"}`。不上传、不联网。

## 兼容性

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`（`engines.dsh`） |
| 明暗 | 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统，跟随 DSH 令牌 |
| 窄屏 | 面板上移并限制宽度，避免压住输入框 |
| 字体 | 不改字体栈；标题字距、按钮样式也只作用于主题自己的面板 |
| 网络 | 零请求。没有图片、字体、脚本来自外部 |
| 权限 | 不读写文件、不执行命令、不调用宿主 API |

## 工作原理

- **颜色**：在 `src/client.js` 里按「强调色 × 明暗」生成 `--dsw-alias-*` 令牌，选择器写成
  `:root[data-jcc="on"][data-jcc-accent="gold"] body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，比产品自身的
  `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 更具体，所以能稳定覆盖、也能随时撤回。
- **背景**：两张原创 SVG 场景在构建时编码成 data URI，作为 `body` 的第一层背景，再叠三条
  `repeating-linear-gradient`（0° / ±60°）的棋盘网格与两层径向光。`background-attachment: fixed`
  让整层背景不随消息滚动。应用框架和各个页面根节点会用 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 盖住这层画布，所以客户端会在运行时找出「覆盖整个视口」的画布层并把它们变透明；粘性标题、卡片、附件这类同样用该令牌的小元素保持不透明。
- **氛围**：一个 `z-index: -1` 的固定层，两层浮尘用 `background-image` + `transform` 漂移，
  极光用径向渐变呼吸；画布层透明，所以它只出现在界面背后，不挡文字。
- **棱角**：锐利模式同时覆写 `--dsw-radius-*` 与面板自己的圆角变量，保证卡片、按钮和
  面板一起变方，而不是只有面板。
- **面板**：纯 DOM + CSS，不依赖 React、不使用 `slots`，所以宿主升级换掉组件类名也不会
  把面板弄坏；唯一耦合的是稳定的 `data-ds-dark-theme` 属性与设计令牌。
- **构建**：`client/index.js` 由 `src/client.js` + `src/theme.css` 拼成，提交进仓库，所以从
  源码安装不需要构建步骤。

## 开发

仓库零运行时依赖，只需要 Node 20+。`test/dom.mjs` 会调用本机 Chrome（找不到时自动跳过）。

```sh
npm run build      # 重新生成 client/index.js
npm test           # manifest + 调色板契约
npm run test:dom   # 真 DOM 里把交互跑一遍（headless Chrome）

# 本地预览：preview/index.html 用产品的真实 token 快照搭了一个 DSH 外壳
open preview/index.html
node scripts/shoot.mjs   # 重新生成 assets/ 里的截图
```

`preview/tokens.css` 是从 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 `dsh-client-ui-theme` 抽出的令牌快照，只用于
本地预览，不参与发布。

## 许可

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: One-click full frontend reload button in the DSH conversation session header.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ui-reload

A "reload the whole frontend" button in the DSH conversation session header, immediately left of the share button.

Clicking it reloads the entire page — the one operation that reliably picks up anything the frontend can be out of sync with: client plugin bundles rebuilt under the running page, plugin-list changes, stale CSS, and the shell's own code.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Mode | Web UI (`web` or `desktop` profile) — there is no CLI surface |

Earlier DSH releases are untested. The button mounts into the slot `conversation.session.header.utilities`; a release that renames or removes that slot leaves it unrendered.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the row is appended to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loader mounts it on the next start. Reload the page once after installing — the client half is served as a separate module.

Manual install:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: ui-reload
      name: 'dsh-ui-reload'
```

## Why a full reload and not HMR

DSH already ships `dsh-client-hmr`, which republishes a plugin the moment its bundle changes. This button exists for the residue that path cannot reach — a page whose shell or bootstrap predates a change, or state that only a real document load clears. Reloading the document is the only thing that covers all of it.

**What survives a click:** conversation, workspace and connection state — they live on the host.

**What does not:** anything held only in the page — scroll position, open panels, in-flight composer text, running client-side timers.

## How it works

The package has two halves and the bundle patch mounts both:

- `lib/index.js` — the host half. It exports an empty `apply()` and registers no route, service or watcher, because a plain page reload needs nothing from the host. It exists only so the bundle row has something to mount; dropping it would stop the package from being composed at all, taking the client button with it.
- `lib/client.js` — the browser half, injected through `dsh.client.inject: ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots"]`. It registers the button into `conversation.session.header.utilities` and calls `window.location.reload()` on click, after a 400 ms acknowledgement so the click registers visually before the load takes over.

## Companion plugins

- [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) — sidebar with tags, grouping and drag-to-move.
- [`dsh-session-manager`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-manager) — agent tools and REST API for session housekeeping.
- [`dsh-session-search`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-search) — in-conversation find bar.
- [`dsh-session-query-vector`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-query-vector) — semantic session search backend.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: ghost-text next-message suggestions, Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-composer-prediction

Codex-style **composer predictions** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

After each assistant turn, the plugin asks a cheap chat model for the message you
are most likely to send next and paints it as **ghost text in the empty
composer**. Press **Tab** to insert it into the draft (nothing is sent), **Esc**
to dismiss it, or just start typing to discard it. Turn the whole thing off in
**Settings → Predictions**, a dedicated Settings section this plugin
contributes (`settings.section`), because the shipped Plugins page is read-only.

## Behaviour

| Event | Result |
|---|---|
| Assistant turn ends (`running: true → false`) | A prediction is requested after the configured delay |
| Composer is not empty, or you are already typing | Nothing is requested or shown |
| **Tab** while a prediction is visible | The whole suggestion is inserted into the draft; nothing is sent |
| **Esc** while a prediction is visible | The offer is withdrawn and not repeated for that turn |
| You open a session that already has an assistant answer | One prediction is made for its latest turn, then deduped per session + turn |
| You switch to another session and back | The cached offer is restored immediately; no new request is made (up to 40 sessions are remembered) |
| A switched-to session needs a new prediction | It waits for the chat store to swap (node list change, 400 ms cap) so the request can never carry the previous session's transcript |
| You type or attach a file | The offer is hidden; clearing the draft brings it back for the same turn |
| You switch the feature off and back on | Forgets the session's offer and "already asked" marker, then predicts again immediately |
| You accept, dismiss, start a new turn, or disable the feature | The offer is discarded and any in-flight request is cancelled |
| A response arrives late or for an older turn | Dropped — it can never replace or resurrect a newer offer |

## Install

From the npm registry (once published):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-composer-prediction
```

Or straight from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add ./dsh-composer-prediction --config.auto-install-peers=false
```

`dsh` links the package into the profile and appends the bundle to
`dsh.profile.bundles` because the package declares `dsh.bundle`. Restart the app
afterwards (a page refresh only reloads the browser half).

Verify the layer composed without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile <your-profile> --dump-config
```

You should see a `# == dsh-composer-prediction` layer and a `composer-predict` row.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-composer-prediction
```

### Install from the Discover tab

[`market/index.json`](market/index.json) is a ready-to-host plugin-market index
listing this package. Turn on **Custom plugin markets**, then add this URL under
**Plugins → Discover → Add index source**:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Amir-Bazylkhanov/dsh-composer-prediction/main/market/index.json
```

Regenerate it after a release with `npm run market`.

## Configuration

Everything lives in `$DSH_HOME/composer-predict.json` and in the Settings page.
The document is written by the plugin's host half (merge + atomic rename); it is
not a `settings.yaml` namespace because the 0.2.x `ctx.settings` service is a form
layer over loader entries and no longer hands a plugin a live namespace scope.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch (also the Settings toggle) |
| `provider` | `""` | Empty = the deployment default route (`ctx.agentDefaultModel`) |
| `model` | `""` | Empty = the deployment default model |
| `maxTokens` | `64` | Output cap for the prediction |
| `temperature` | `0.8` | Sampling temperature (direct-HTTP transport only) |
| `delayMs` | `0` | Quiet period after a turn before predicting |
| `maxSuggestionChars` | `200` | Hard cap on an offered suggestion |
| `contextMessages` | `10` | Trailing messages fed to the predictor |
| `maxContextChars` | `6000` | Transcript character budget |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | Fallback only: used when no harness LLM service is composed |
| `apiKey` | `""` | Fallback only: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, then `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` |

### Model and reasoning

By default the plugin calls **the harness's own LLM service** (`ctx.llm`), not a
private endpoint. That means:

- it uses the **same provider route and credentials as your sessions** — with a
  subscription route (`deepseek-account`, Kimi, …) you need no API key at all;
- the model is your **deployment default** (`ctx.agentDefaultModel`, e.g.
  `deepseek-flash`) unless you override `provider`/`model` in Settings;
- **reasoning is pinned to the model's cheapest advertised effort**
  (`model.reasoning.efforts[0]`). A next-message guess should not spend a
  thinking budget; if the model advertises no efforts, the provider default is
  left alone. Output is capped at `maxTokens` (64 by default).

The direct OpenAI-compatible HTTP path (`baseUrl` + `apiKey`) exists only for
compositions with no `ctx.llm`; it is not used in a normal DSH install.

If a prediction cannot run, the reason is no longer swallowed: the Settings card
shows it and the browser console logs `[composer-predict] …`.

### Settings page and status

The plugin contributes its own **Settings → Predictions** section
(`settings.section`, the same list slot that hosts "Built-in plugins"), with the
enable switch, provider/model overrides and timing.

There is no placeholder state: the ghost text simply appears when it is ready.
When a prediction comes back empty or fails, the composer shows the reason
instead (`no prediction: no-model-route`, `composer-predict: provider HTTP 401`, …)
and keeps showing it until you type, dismiss it, switch session, or disable the
feature. The console logs `[composer-predict] …` in both cases.

## How it works

```
 host half (lib/index.js, lib/handler.js)
   ├─ config document `composer-predict.json`  → $DSH_HOME
   └─ POST /api/composer-predict/rpc         → config.get / config.set / predict / cancel
                                                └─ chat completion → normalizeSuggestion()

 browser half (lib/client.js)
   ├─ slot conversation.input.overlay  → ghost text over the empty composer
   ├─ slot settings.section            → "Predictions" Settings page
   ├─ useChat(legacy.nodes)            → transcript tail
   ├─ useInput(draft) / useSession(running) → eligibility
   └─ capture keydown                  → Tab accepts, Esc dismisses
```

The overlay measures the real `[data-composer-input]` element and clones its
font metrics, so padding, wrapping and height follow the composer instead of
guessing at CSS. The native placeholder is hidden (and restored) only while the
ghost is visible.

Bundles are built without a toolchain: `scripts/build-client.mjs` concatenates
the shared helpers and the component body into the `window.__ModuleLoader__`
factory the host serves — no bundler, no dependencies, no network.

## Development

```sh
node scripts/build-client.mjs   # regenerate lib/client.js
node scripts/test.mjs           # 32 assertions across shared/host/client
node --check lib/index.js
```

Tests cover suggestion normalization, transcript extraction, prompt building,
config sanitization, every RPC endpoint (with a stubbed provider), cancellation,
and a VM smoke test that loads the generated bundle, runs `apply()` and renders
the overlay.

### Manual verification

The client exposes `window.__composerPredict` so the overlay can be exercised
without waiting for a turn:

```js
__composerPredict.suggest('Add a regression test for the empty-input case.')
__composerPredict.state()
__composerPredict.clear()
__composerPredict.predictNow()   // re-run the real prediction path
```

## Limitations

- The prediction triggers on the idle transition; if you are already typing when
  the turn ends, no offer is made (deliberately: it should never fight the user).
- The ghost is positioned over the first line of an empty composer; a composer
  pre-filled with attachments does not sh

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩 · Unofficial Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-locale-ko

**DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩** · 딥시크 하네스 한글 패치

> **Korean (한국어) UI language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/).**
> Install it from **Plugins → Add plugin** with `https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko`, then pick 한국어 in Settings → General → Language.
> Unofficial community translation; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

DeepSeek Harness의 화면(채팅, 사이드바, 설정, 플러그인, 자동화 작업, 파일 미리보기, 대화상자 등)을 한국어로 바꿔 주는 플러그인입니다.
앱 프로그램 파일은 건드리지 않고 DSH 플러그인으로만 설치되기 때문에, 플러그인 화면에서 언제든 끄거나 제거할 수 있습니다.

| 적용 전 | 적용 후 |
|---|---|
| ![적용 전: 영어 화면](docs/before-main.png) | ![적용 후: 한국어 화면](docs/after-main.png) |

<details>
<summary>스크린샷 더 보기 (설정, 플러그인 화면)</summary>

![설정 → 일반 화면](docs/settings.png)

![플러그인 화면의 한국어 언어팩 상세 정보](docs/plugins.png)

</details>

## 기준 앱

이 언어팩은 DeepSeek의 [DeepSeek Harness 공식 페이지](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)에서 배포하는 **공식 데스크톱 앱**(Download for Windows)을 기준으로 만들었습니다. 같은 페이지에서 안내하는 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`(Web UI)에서도 동작합니다.

이 프로젝트는 비공식 커뮤니티 번역이며, DeepSeek가 만들거나 보증한 것이 아닙니다.

## 지원 버전

| 앱 | 버전 |
|---|---|
| [DeepSeek Harness 공식 데스크톱 앱](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (Windows 64-bit) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (Web UI) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |

다른 버전에서는 일부 문구가 영어로 나오거나 동작하지 않을 수 있습니다.

## 설치

Node.js나 터미널은 필요 없습니다.

1. DeepSeek Harness 왼쪽 사이드바에서 **플러그인**을 엽니다.
2. 오른쪽 위 **플러그인 추가**를 누르고, 아래 주소를 입력한 뒤 **설치**를 누릅니다.

   ```
   https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko
   ```

3. 설치가 끝나면 **지금 켜기**를 누릅니다. 다시 시작하지 않아도 바로 적용됩니다.

설정 → 일반 → 언어에서 `한국어`를 고를 수 있습니다. 운영체제 언어가 한국어이고 따로 고른 언어가 없으면 자동으로 한국어가 선택됩니다.

### 끄기 / 제거 / 업데이트

- **끄기**: 플러그인 → 설치된 플러그인 → 한국어 언어팩의 스위치를 끕니다.
- **제거**: 한국어 언어팩을 눌러 상세 화면에서 **제거**를 누릅니다.
- **업데이트**: 제거한 뒤 같은 주소로 다시 설치합니다.

설치, 끄기, 제거는 모두 DSH 앱의 **플러그인 화면**에서 처리되며, 언어팩은 **내 설정 파일**(`cordis.patch.yml`)을 직접 수정하지 않습니다.

## 구성

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | DSH 플러그인 선언 (번들 + 클라이언트 플러그인) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 번들을 켜면 언어팩 플러그인을 불러오는 설정 |
| `lib/client.js` | 빌드된 언어팩 본체 |
| `locale/*.json` | 플러그인 화면에 표시되는 이름과 설명 (영어·중국어·한국어) |
| `icon.svg` | 플러그인 아이콘 |
| `src/ko-dict.json` | 앱 번역 시스템에 등록된 문구의 한국어 번역 (0.2.1 기준 56개 네임스페이스, 2,566개 키) |
| `src/ko-static.json` | 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 문구의 한국어 번역. `global`(어디서나), `plugins`(플러그인 화면 안에서만) 두 묶음 |
| `src/client.template.js`, `src/build.mjs` | 위 파일들로 `lib/client.js`를 만드는 템플릿과 빌드 스크립트 |

## 번역 수정하기

`src/ko-dict.json` 또는 `src/ko-static.json`을 고친 뒤 빌드하세요.

```bash
node src/build.mjs
```

오역이나 빠진 문구는 Issue나 Pull Request로 알려 주세요.

## 동작 방식

- DSH가 제공하는 언어팩 API로 `ko` 언어(대체 언어 `en`)를 추가하고, 네임스페이스별 한국어 사전을 등록합니다. 언어 선택은 DSH가 직접 설정에 저장합니다.
- 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 일부 문구는, 화면에 표시된 텍스트가 정확히 일치할 때만 한국어로 바꿉니다. 다른 언어로 바꾸면 즉시 원래 문구로 돌아갑니다.
  - 플러그인 이름·설명은 플러그인 화면 안에서만 바꿉니다.
  - "Status", "Tools" 같은 짧은 단어는 바꾸지 않습니다. 같은 이름의 파일·폴더·세션 제목이 잘못 바뀌지 않도록 하기 위해서입니다.
  - 대화 본문(AI 답변, 사용자 메시지, 추론 내용, 코드)은 바꾸지 않습니다.

## 한계

- 앱 자체에 내장된 화면은 번역할 수 없습니다. 공식 데스크톱 앱의 창 메뉴(Application, Edit 등)가 여기에 해당합니다.
- 설정 → 기본 제공 플러그인 목록의 패키지 설명은 각 패키지의 개발자용 설명이라 공식 중국어판에서도 영어로 나오며, 이 언어팩도 번역하지 않습니다.
- 외부 플러그인과 서버에서 내려오는 일부 문구(도구 이름, 오류 원문 등)는 영어로 남을 수 있습니다.
- 앱이 업데이트되면 새 문구가 영어로 나올 수 있습니다.

## 라이선스

[MIT](LICENSE)

번역의 원문은 MIT 라이선스로 배포되는 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek)의 UI 문구입니다. 자세한 내용은 [NOTICE](NOTICE)를 보세요.

中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★ · [dsh-models](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models) 模型选择 + 子代理路由 + 推理层级）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 性能 Benchmark | 指标 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 热查询延迟 | ~2000ms | ~1500ms | ~800ms | **~10ms** | | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 缓存 | 无 | 页面缓存 | 页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite）** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 架构 ### 主流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[用户查询] --> B[语言检测] B --> C[引擎分诊] C --> D[并行搜索] D --> E[结果聚合] E --> F[可信度评分] F --> G[JSON 输出] H[双层缓存] -.-> D I[预算控制] -.-> C ``` ### 引擎分诊流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[用户查询] --> B{语言检测} B -->|中文| C[中文引擎组] B -->|英文| D[英文引擎组] B -->|日韩| E[日韩引擎组] B -->|其他| F[通用引擎组] C --> G{领域判断} D --> G E --> G F --> G G -->|学术| H[学术引擎] G -->|代码| I[代码引擎] G -->|购物| J[购物引擎] G -->|金融| K[金融引擎] G -->|新闻| L[新闻引擎] G -->|通用| M[网页引擎] H --> N[并行搜索] I --> N J --> N K --> N L --> N M --> N ``` ### 缓存机制 ```mermaid graph LR A[查询请求] --> B{内存缓存} B -->|命中| C[直接返回] B -->|未命中| D{SQLite 缓存} D -->|命中| E[返回并更新内存] D -->|未命中| F[执行搜索] F --> G[结果写入 SQLite] G --> H[结果写入内存] H --> I[返回结果] ``` ### 可信度评分流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[搜索结果] --> B[Selection 评分] A --> C[Absorption 评分] A --> D[Freshness 评分] A --> E[共识评分] B --> F[综合可信度] C --> F D --> F E --> F F --> G{阈值判断} G -->|高于阈值| H[保留] G -->|低于阈值| I[丢弃] H --> J[JSON 输出] ``` ### 预算控制流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[搜索请求] --> B{预算检查} B -->|预算充足| C[免费引擎优先] B -->|预算紧张| D[仅免费引擎] B -->|预算耗尽| E[返回缓存] C --> F{免费引擎有结果?} D --> F F -->|有| G[返回结果] F -->|无| H{有 Key?} H -->|有| I[付费引擎搜索] H -->|无| J[返回空结果] I --> G ``` ### 整体架构 ```mermaid graph TB subgraph 用户层 A[Agent / 用户] end subgraph 接入层 B[CLI] C[MCP Server] D[Python SDK] end subgraph 核心层 E[语言检测] F[引擎分诊] G[并行搜索] H[结果聚合] I[可信度评分] end subgraph 数据层 J[内存缓存] K[SQLite 缓存] L[265+ 搜索引擎] end subgraph 控制层 M[预算控制] N[多语言支持] end A --> B A --> C A --> D B --> E C --> E D --> E E --> F F --> G G --> H H --> I J -.-> G K -.-> G L --> G M -.-> F N -.-> E I --> A ``` > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查

# dsh-profile-stylist（个人资料配置）

**你说要什么样的人设，它写出来，并把资料页填好。**

"我想要个给主人打工的 AI 小助手，可爱但专业" → 它生成昵称/简介/标语 → 从你的素材库里挑一张头像（或按名字画一张）→ 打开你自己的资料页填进去。

> 它替用户写**关于他自己**的东西，所以默认值是三重的保守：
> **默认 dry-run**（不传 `confirm: true` 只演算）、**只认资料字段**（档案里没有密码/邮箱/安全设置）、
> **写前摊开**（要写什么、写到哪、用哪张图，提交前整份给人看）。

---

## 它做什么

| 步 | 动作 | 细节 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ① | 生成文案 | 按"你的需求"让**宿主模型服务**出昵称/简介/标语/所在地/链接；写不出来就不写，**不编** |
| ② | 收敛草稿 | 字段白名单 + 按站点长度截断（GitHub bio 160 字符）+ **网址只收 http/https** |
| ③ | 选头像 | 素材库 / 你给的本地图片路径（本机没有图像生成服务，所以只这三条路） |
| ④ | 体检 | 目标站点能不能写这些字段、有哪些会超限、选择器是否验证过 |
| ⑤ | 写入（要显式确认） | 打开资料页 → 填文本 → 头像走 `File → DataTransfer → input.files → change` 交给站点自己的 JS → 点保存/确认 |
| ⑥ | 回报 | 填了哪些、缺哪些、头像是否确认、任何警告 |

## 三个工具

```
profile_assets  [target=github]                     # 看素材库里有哪些图
profile_author  wish="…" [host=github] [current=…]   # 出草稿，不写站点
profile_apply   fields='{"name":"…","bio":"…"}' [host=github] [avatarPath=…|avatarFromAssets=…] [confirm=true]
```

`profile_apply` **不传 `confirm: true` 就是 dry-run**：只做体检 + 展示，不打开页面、不点任何按钮。

## 头像从哪来

本机**没有图像生成服务**，所以头像只有四条来源：

| 来源 | 怎么用 |
| --- | --- |
| **素材库** | 往 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-profile-stylist\assets\avatars\` 丢 png/jpg，然后 `avatarFromAssets:"文件名"` |
| **本地图片** | `avatarPath:"D:\\pics\\me.png"`（≤12MB，插件会按 512×512 规格化后再交） |
| **当场合成**（v0.2 新增） | `avatarTemplate:"initials" \\| "gradient" \\| "tagline"`：在页面里用 canvas 画一张 460×460 PNG，零外部依赖。`initials` 纯色底+名字首字、`gradient` 渐变底+首字、`tagline` 深色底+名字+标语（配 `avatarTagline:"一句话"`）。配色由名字稳定决定（同一名字永远同一个颜色） |
| 都不给 | 不换头像 |

```js
profile_apply fields='{"name":"七个知更鸟","bio":"…"}' avatarTemplate="tagline" avatarTagline="写插件的那个人" confirm=true
```

## 支持的站点

**一句话：只适合「git 系」的资料页 —— 目前就是 GitHub 和 Gitee，两家都是真机验证过的。**
其他的（微博 / 知乎 / B站 / 小红书 / 掘金…）**没有适配**，传了会直接拒绝，不猜选择器。

| 站点 | 状态 | 备注 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **GitHub** | ✅ 选择器**真机验证过** | `#user_display_name` / `#user_profile_bio` / `#avatar_upload` + 「Set new profile picture」 |
| **Gitee** | ✅ 选择器**真机验证过**（2026-10-17，gitee.com/profile） | `#user_name` / `#user_bio` / `#user_company` / `#user_blog`，保存按钮 `button[name=commit]`（「更新」），头像 `#avatar-input` + `#confirm-avatar`（「确定」） |

**逐字段的支持差异**（同样是 git 站，字段并不完全一样）：

| 字段 | GitHub | Gitee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 昵称 / 显示名 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 一句话简介 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 公司 / 组织 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 链接（主页） | ✅ | ✅ |
| **所在地** | ✅ | ❌ 两级下拉（省+市），明确不支持 |

**Gitee 的所在地写不了**：它是 `#user_province` + `#user_city` 两级下拉，不在字段表里 ——
传 `location` 会出现在 `unsupported`（明确告诉你不支持），不会静默失败。

不认识的站点**直接拒绝**，不猜选择器。

## 红线与隐私

- **只写资料字段**：档案里没有密码、邮箱、安全设置、支付 —— 插件也不会去点。
- **只动你自己的账号**：你在浏览器里登录谁，它就写谁（登录态由浏览器 profile 自持）。
- **不持有任何 API key**：文案由宿主的模型服务生成。
- **写前摊开**：dry-run 回执里能看到逐字段的"要写什么"，确认后才动手。

## 安装

市场收录后在 DSH 里搜 `dsh-profile-stylist` 安装。手动安装：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-profile-stylist" -Target "D:\dsh\projects\dsh-profile-stylist"
# profile 的 package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-profile-stylist": "link:D:/dsh/projects/dsh-profile-stylist"
# 并把 "dsh-profile-stylist" 加进 dsh.profile.bundles（漏了不加载）→ 重启 DSH
```

**用之前先做两步**：① 装好内置浏览器插件；② 在浏览器窗口里登录目标站点。

## 测试

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs      # 35 项：纯逻辑 / 站点档案 / 生成层（假 LLM）/ 写入层（假浏览器）/ 回执
```

测试**不联网、不碰真实浏览器、不读任何凭据**。在活代码树里跑会**直接退出**（先复制到 `D:\dsh\sandbox\`）。

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-visual-memory

Lossless visual memory for a DSH agent: store an image once, address it forever,
look at it closely, compare it with others, and find it again — with a measured
answer to whether the routed model can actually see.

**Why another memory plugin?** Text memory stores *descriptions*. This stores
*bytes*: the original file is committed verbatim, addressed by sha256, and every
later question is answered from that original — not from a vision model's
paraphrase of it. Two consequences: pixel values stay exact, and the answer does
not change when you switch models.

## Install

```sh
# from the public repository (npm publication pending)
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:xiciyang/dsh-visual-memory
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config   # expect a "# == dsh-visual-memory" layer
```

From a local checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xiciyang/dsh-visual-memory
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-visual-memory
```

Once published to npm, `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-visual-memory` will be the short form.

## Quick start

```js
// 1. store the screenshot you are looking at, and make it findable
visual_remember({ path: "./shot.png", text: "checkout page, CNY 199, two buttons", tags: ["ui","checkout"] })

// 2. later, find it without re-uploading
visual_recall({ query: "checkout" })            // or sha256 / id / tags / turn range / near-dup

// 3. read the exact colour of a cell (a vision model would round it off)
visual_read_pixels({ id: "VM-…", region: "120,40,200,80", rows: 2, cols: 4 })

// 4. assemble several past frames into one labelled sheet for comparison
visual_inspect({ views: [{ id: "VM-…", region: "0,0,800,600" }, { id: "VM-…" }], layout: "side-by-side" })
```

## Requirements

- DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** (declared as `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.0 <0.3.0"`); the bundle
  manifest is `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` activates the layer.
- Node.js **>= 22**.
- Python 3 with **Pillow** (`python3 -m pip install pillow`) — the pixel engine
  (`lib/imaging.py`) is a subprocess; the plugin does not vendor an image codec.
- **Desktop / server only** for now: the pixel engine spawns `python3`, so
  Android is out of scope (`dsh-plugin-lint` flags this as `A2-subprocess-tool`).
  A pure-JS fallback is the obvious next step if mobile matters.
- A model route that declares image input for the *observation* path. The
  plugin probes the live route (`visual_memory_status.routeCapability`) instead
  of assuming; on a text-only route, images are still stored and are reachable
  through the `sha256:xxxxxxxx` handle DSH emits.

## Configuration

There is no config file — three locations follow host conventions, and changing
the session workspace changes the store root:

| What | Where | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| store | `<session workspace>/.dsh-visual-memory/` | one per workspace; `index.jsonl` is append-only |
| registry | `$DSH_HOME/visual-memory-roots.json` | gallery routing; most recent 20 workspaces |
| originals | `$DSH_HOME/attachments/v1/files/<sha>/` | verbatim, content-addressed, not deleted with the index |

To move the store, change the session workspace. To clear memory, delete
`.dsh-visual-memory/` (the originals stay in `attachments/` and can be reclaimed).

## Compatibility

| DSH | Status |
|---|---|
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | verified on 2026-10-17 — `node verify.mjs` 11/11, real tools called end-to-end |
| < 0.2.0 | not tested; `engines.dsh` refuses installation |
| >= 0.3.0 | not tested; widen the range only after running `npm test` on that version |

Built to close the gap against **VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an
Interactive World** ([arXiv 2610.02200](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200), Han,
Hu, Qiu, Wu, **Kaiming He**, 2026-10-01), whose harness contributes three
things: *visual observation*, a *lossless visual memory* that "stores every
frame … in its original form" indexed by turn and frame, and *visual
inspection* that works "in space" (an enlarged view of any rectangular region of
the original frame) and "across time" (retrieve and inspect multiple frames from
arbitrary earlier turns).

## Capability map

| VISTA harness component | This plugin |
|---|---|
| Visual observation (model receives the pixels) | DSH native multimodal input — `read_image`; the model route's declared modalities are probed, not assumed |
| Lossless visual memory, original form, indexed by (turn, frame) | `visual_remember` → verbatim bytes in `ctx.attachments.saveFile` (content-addressed, never re-encoded) + an append-only index carrying `turn`/`step`/`seq`/sha256/dHash/dimensions/tags/text |
| Active retrieval of past observations | `visual_recall` — query / id / sha256 prefix / tags / turn range / chronological order / perceptual near-dup |
| Visual inspection *in space* (region of the original, enlarged) | `visual_inspect` views with `region` + `scale`; ad-hoc cropping stays with `vision_crop` |
| Visual inspection *across time* (several frames, one call) | `visual_inspect` assembles N views from N archived observations into one labelled sheet |
| Compare states / replay frames | `visual_compare` (labelled side-by-side / grid / stack); numeric diffs stay with `vision_pixel_diff` |
| Exact pixel values (VISTA `read_pixels`) | `visual_read_pixels` — rows×cols cell matrix of `#rrggbb` centre readings |
| — (hybrid routing, not in the paper) | `visual_memory_status.routeCapability` resolves the live route and reports `nativeImageInput`; text-only routes recover images through the `sha256:xxxxxxxx` handle DSH emits |

## Ownership boundaries

Each capability has exactly one owner, so there is no second implementation to
diverge:

* **bytes** → `ctx.attachments` (host service; verbatim `saveFile`, content-addressed)
* **crop / pixel-diff / palette / trace / OCR / Q&A** → `dsh-vision-toolkit`
  (`vision_crop`, `vision_pixel_diff`, `vision_dominant_colors`, `vision_trace`,
  `vision_glance`)
* **index / attention ledger / labelled composites / multi-view assembly /
  capability probe** → this plugin

`visual_attend` deliberately produces the *annotated overlay + attention ledger*
(what was looked at, made visible and durable) and leaves the crop itself to
`vision_crop`. `visual_inspect` cuts from archived observations because
assembling views out of memory is a distinct capability, not a second crop tool.

## Tools

| Tool | Answers |
|---|---|
| `visual_remember` | store this image losslessly and make it findable |
| `visual_recall` | which image was that / find it by text, hash, tag, turn, or similarity |
| `visual_attend` | draw the regions I examined onto the image and record them |
| `visual_inspect` | give me these N observations, these regions, enlarged, in one sheet |
| `visual_read_pixels` | what exactly is the colour of each cell |
| `visual_compare` | put these images side by side with labels |
| `visual_memory_status` | what is actually available, and can the current model see |

Web seam: `GET /_dsh/visual-memory/gallery` renders the memory (thumbnails,
attention ledger, indexed text, hashes); `/_dsh/visual-memory/raw?id=VM-…`
serves the exact stored original, and `&v=<variant>` serves one overlay or
comparison sheet that the record itself lists.

The web seam is not an Agent authority boundary. Every request is refused
unless the composition's `connection.requestRejection` accepts it (Host/Origin
fence + browser authentication), `root` must be a root this plugin registered,
and `v` is resolved only from the record's own listed variants and only when the
real path stays inside that store's `artifacts/` directory — a caller-supplied
path is never read.

## Storage layout

```
<session workspace>/.dsh-visual-memory/
  index.jsonl                 append-only; folded by id, last write wins
  artifacts/attention/*.png   attention overlays
  artifacts/compare/*.png     comparison sheets
  artifacts/inspect/*.png     per-view crops + assembled sheets
~/.dsh/visual-memory-roots.json   which workspaces have a store (gallery routing)
<DSH_HOME>/attachments/v1/files/<sha>/<name>   the verbatim originals
```

## Verification

```bash
npm test                       # = node verify.mjs
node verify.mjs [path/to/index.jsonl]
```

plugins.description: 输入框提示词联想插件：助手回复结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里，Tab 采纳、Esc 忽略 ｜ Codex-style composer prompt predictions for DeepSeek Harness: your next message ghosted into the composer, accepted with Tab.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-predict
Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness
After each reply, your next prompt is ghosted right into the composer — Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss, start typing and it's gone

🌏 中文 · English
`dsh-prompt-predict` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/) plugin: after every assistant turn it predicts **the message you are most likely to type next** and floats it into the composer as gray ghost text. The suggestion never enters the editor — only pressing `Tab` inserts it, and even then it stays undoable — so a wrong prediction costs you nothing. ## 📑 Table of Contents - [✨ Features](#-features) - [🚀 Installation](#-installation) - [⌨️ Usage](#-usage) - [⚙️ Settings](#-settings) - [🔌 HTTP API](#-http-api) - [🧩 How it works](#-how-it-works) - [🛠️ Development](#-development) - [🔐 Security and cost](#-security-and-cost) - [⚠️ Known limitations](#-known-limitations) - [📄 License](#-license) ## ✨ Features - **A suggestion the moment a reply ends** — gray ghost text rendered at the composer's first character, matching the editor's caret position, font size and line height - **Four interactions** — `Tab` to accept, `Alt+→` to accept piece by piece, `↻` for a different suggestion, `Esc` to dismiss; typing hides it, and clearing the draft brings it back - **Lightweight context** — only the most recent user/assistant *text*; tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave your machine - **Follows the current session model by default** — nothing is hard-coded to a provider, the prediction call reuses whatever model the session itself uses; you can also pin a cheaper model - **No repeats, no dead ends** — a repeat of the previous suggestion triggers an automatic "give me a different one"; a reasoning level the real model doesn't support falls back automatically, so you never hit "settings look fine but no suggestion ever appears" - **Everything is adjustable** — on/off, provider / model, response timeout, context size and budget, output cap, reasoning effort; changes apply immediately, no DSH restart - **The UI follows your language** — switch Settings → Language to 中文 and the whole plugin UI changes at once, including the ghost hint above the composer **and the validation errors inside Settings** (those are produced by the host, which answers in the language the client sends); no reload needed, and it falls back to Chinese when no locale service is present - **Zero runtime dependencies** — plain ESM on both the host and client side ## 🚀 Installation The plugin is published on npm. Options are ordered by convenience. ### Install inside DSH (recommended) **GUI**: open the plugins page → **Add plugin** → enter the package name `dsh-prompt-predict` → install. **Or the dsh CLI** — pin any published version with pnpm's `@version` syntax: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-prompt-predict@0.2.1 ``` Replace `--profile` with your own profile (usually `desktop` on the desktop app, `web` for the web build), then **restart DSH**. > ⚠️ **The CLI only installs the package.** DSH loads a plugin only when it is also listed in > `dsh.profile.bundles` inside `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json`. Verified: with the package > installed but not in that list, the plugin's routes answer `404` and nothing loads. The GUI route > above handles it for you; with the CLI add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to that array yourself, or just > run `scripts/install.sh` below, which does both steps. > You'll find the switch and all parameters under **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**. ### Install from a release tarball Every [release](https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict/releases) carries the exact tarball that is on npm (`shasum` matches the registry), which is handy for offline machines or for pinning an artifact you can verify: ```bash gh release download v0.2.1 --repo ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict --pattern '*.tgz' dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-prompt-predict-0.2.1.tgz ``` Same caveat as the CLI route above: add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` yourself, or run `scripts/install.sh` instead. ### Install from source ```bash git clone https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict.git cd dsh-prompt-predict bash scripts/install.sh ``` The script packs this repo on the fly, installs it into the profile's `node_modules`, and adds `dsh-prompt-predict` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The default target is `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`; for another profile: ```bash bash scripts/install.sh ~/.dsh/profiles/web ``` **Restart DSH afterwards**, then look under **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**. ### Manual install ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-prompt-predict # from npm # or link local source (symlink — handy while developing): pnpm add /path/to/dsh-prompt-predict ``` Then open that profile's `package.json` and add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array, and restart DSH. ### Requirements - Verified on **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`** (web build; the desktop app runs the same host and client code) - `node` / `pnpm`: the install script prefers DSH's own runtime under `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependencies` and only falls back to `PATH` - macOS / Linux; Windows untested ## ⌨️ Usage 1. Chat normally, wait for the assistant to finish its turn, and leave the **composer empty** 2. About 350 ms later a gray suggestion appears, with `Tab` / `↻` / `Esc` on its right 3. Pick what you need: | Action | Effect | |---|---| | `Tab` | Accept the whole thing (only now is it inserted, and it stays undoable) | | `Alt+→` | **Accept piece by piece** — a couple of characters at a time in CJK, one word in Latin; the rest keeps floating, stop whenever you like | | `↻` (button on the right) | **Reroll** — ask the model for a different suggestion | | `Esc` | Dismiss this one | | Just start typing | It disappears; **clearing the draft brings it back** (only `Esc` is a permanent dismissal) | Suggestions only appear when the composer is empty and the session isn't running. Switching sessions or interrupting a reply clears any pending suggestion. ## ⚙️ Settings **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**: | Setting | Description | Default | |---|---|---| | Enable predictions | Master switch | On | | Provider / model | Model used for the prediction call; pick "Follow current session model" to reuse the session's own model | Follow current session model | | Response timeout (advanced) | 1–60 seconds | 12 seconds | | Context size (advanced) | Small 3 / Standard 8 / Large 12 messages | Standard 8 | | Context budget (advanced) | Character cap sent to the helper call, 1000–20000 | 6000 | | Output cap (advanced) | Token cap per suggestion, 16–512 | 64 | | Reasoning effort (advanced) | Options are **generated from the model actually in use** (the session's model when following it); unsupported levels never appe

plugins.description: Restores opaque backgrounds on floating panels that the liquid-glass theme (dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine) made translucent — a copy-paste recipe, one selector per plugin.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-glass-opaque-fix 让被液态玻璃主题「玻璃化」的浮层恢复正常的不透明背景。 一个可照抄的样板：**改一处选择器**，就能修好另一个插件与玻璃主题的兼容问题。 > 本项目由 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 智能体开发。 --- ## 一、问题是什么 液态玻璃主题插件（`dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`）实现「透出壁纸」的方式，是**改写宿主自己的背景别名**。 它的样式表里有一组 `body[data-we-glass-page]` 规则，把宿主的 ``` --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1 --dsw-alias-bg-layer-2 --dsw-alias-bg-layer-3 ``` 重新映射成由 `color-mix(…, transparent)` 合成的**半透明膜**。 **这是主题的正当设计** —— 壁纸正是从这些膜下面透出来的。 **但它是一个全局改动。** 任何**用这些别名画面板**的插件，都会**跟着一起变半透明** —— 哪怕那个插件跟壁纸毫无关系。 ### 后果 | 现象 | 说明 | |---|---| | 浮窗/弹窗变半透明 | 文字压在壁纸上，难以阅读 | | **插件里没有开关可调** | 因为那个插件是按「宿主别名本来不透明」写的 | | 用户无解 | 只能二选一：要么关壁纸，要么忍受看不清 | **这不是谁的 bug，是两个正确设计撞在一起的结果。** 本仓库负责收尾。 --- ## 二、为什么改主题或改插件的设置都没用 我们实测过两条最直觉的路径，**都走不通**。 ### 路径一：找主题的「浮层不透明度」设置 `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` **确实有**「浮层玻璃 · 玻璃透明度」这个设置项（`浮层玻璃·独立配置` / `Popover glass · glass opacity`）。 **但它管不到第三方浮层。** 它的选择器只有三类： ``` body[data-we-glass-floaters] [data-install-registry] ← DSH 官方安装注册面板 body[data-we-glass-floaters] .we-update-notice ← 主题自己的更新提示 body[data-we-glass-floaters] .we-repo-panel ← 主题自己的壁纸仓库 ``` 全是 `we-` 前缀的自家组件，或官方组件。**没有 `[role=dialog]`、没有任何通用匹配** —— 所以第三方浮层不在它管辖范围内。 而且那条滑块在数学上也**到不了不透明**： ```js // wallpaper-engine 1.3.3 const glassAlpha = Math.max(0.10, 0.25 - (selection.glassAlpha / 100) * 0.15); ``` | 滑块 | alpha | 效果 | |---|---|---| | 0 | **0.25** | 最「实」，**但仍 25% 透明** | | 100 | 0.10 | 最透 | **下限锁死在 0.25** —— 这是主题的可读性铁律，不是配置失误。 ### 路径二：改被影响插件的文件 我们最初的做法，是把一条 CSS 规则**打进主题插件的 bundle**： ```css /* 曾经这样修过，现已失效 */ body[data-we-glass-page] .cm-stat-dialog { background: var(--we-panel-color) !important; } ``` **它撑到主题下一次更新就没了** —— 实测 `1.3.2 → 1.3.3` 把这条规则整个抹掉，浮层重新变半透明。 **为什么必然如此**：冲突的两边都是**第三方插件**，**两边都会更新**。 | 补丁位置 | 谁更新会抹掉它 | |---|---| | 主题插件的 `lib/client.js` | **主题**更新 | | 被影响插件的文件 | **被影响插件**更新 | **所以正确的做法是第三个位置：你自己的插件。** 它不属于任何一方，没人会覆盖它。 --- ## 三、修复原理 三步，**每一步都不能少**。 ### 第 1 步：用不会被改写的颜色变量 ``` ❌ var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1) ← 正是被主题改成半透明膜的那个 ✅ var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-00) ← 主题从不赋值，天然不透明 ✅ var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-875) ← 深色版本 ✅ var(--we-panel-color) ← 主题基于上面两个定义，色调更协调 ``` **实测依据**：在 `wallpaper-engine 1.3.3` 的 bundle 里搜索这两个 `--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-*`，**赋值次数为 0** —— 主题不碰它们。 所以它们是**构造上就不透明**的，装不装壁纸都可靠。 本插件用的表达式： ```css background: var(--we-panel-color, var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-00, #ffffff)) !important; ``` 优先用主题的面板色（与周围玻璃同色调），主题不在时退回静态中性色。 ### 第 2 步：加 `!important` **这是必需的，不是习惯性写法。** 主题的令牌映射挂在 `body[data-we-glass-page]` 下，**作用域优先级高于一个裸的 class 选择器**。不加 `!important` 压不过它。 ### 第 3 步：父与子一起写 如果浮层有独立的头部/主体，**它们也要列上**： ```css .cm-stat-dialog, .cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-head, .cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-body { background: … !important; } ``` **原因**：子元素自己的 `background` 会盖在父元素之上。只给父元素设不透明，子元素那块**仍会是半透明的** —— 表现为面板上一条条透光的带。 --- ## 四、怎么用它修另一个插件（给 AI 的操作指南） **整个流程改动的只有一处：`client.js` 里的 `RECIPES` 数组。** ### 步骤 ``` ① 打开那个半透明的浮窗 ② DevTools → Elements → 点选该浮窗 → 读它的 class 属性 ③ 把类名加进 client.js 的 RECIPES（形如 '.that-class'） ④ 重启 DSH（改动 client.js 需要重启才加载） ⑤ 复查：浮窗应不再透出壁纸 ⑥ 若头部/主体仍透光 → 把子元素选择器也加进去 ``` ### 要改的那一处 `client.js` 顶部： ```js const RECIPES = [ { id: 'cost-meter', plugin: 'dsh-cost-meter', note: '费用明细 dialog。已验证 1.8.32。', selectors: [ '.cm-stat-dialog', '.cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-head', '.cm-stat-dialog .cm-stat-dialog-body', ], }, // ← 在这里加新条目 // { // id: 'some-plugin', // plugin: 'dsh-some-plugin', // note: '设置弹窗；选择器取自 DevTools。', // selectors: ['.some-dialog'], // }, ]; ``` ### 怎么找到正确的选择器 | 目标 | 做法 | |---|---| | 定位浮窗元素 | DevTools → 左上角「选择元素」图标 → 点浮窗 | | 读类名 | 看 `class="…"` 属性，优先选**最外层**那个面板元素 | | 确认它真的透光 | DevTools → Computed → 看 `background-color` 的 alpha 是否小于 1 | | 确认生效 | 加完规则后，看 computed 里 `background-color` 是否变成不透明 | ### 排查：加了规则但没效果 按顺序查这三条： | 检查 | 方法 | |---|---| | **样式注入成功了吗** | DevTools → Elements → 搜 `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-glass-opaque-fix"]`，应能找到 | | **选择器匹配到了吗** | 在 Console 里跑 `document.querySelectorAll('.你的选择器').length`，应 ≥ 1 | | **优先级够吗** | 看 computed 的 `background-color` 值旁有没有被划掉（划掉说明被别的规则赢了） | --- ## 五、已收录的修复用例 | 插件 | 浮层 | 选择器 | 验证状态 | |---|---|---|---| | [`dsh-cost-meter`](https://github.com/) | 费用明细 dialog | `.cm-stat-dialog` + `.cm-stat-dialog-head` + `.cm-stat-dialog-body` | ✅ **实际使用中**（1.8.32） | **关于验证状态的诚实说明**：✅ 表示这条配方在开发机上**实际解决了问题**。其他条目若由他人补充，请在 `note` 里写清验证到哪个版本 —— **本仓库的价值在于配方可靠**，一条没验证过的选择器比没有更糟。 ### 为什么点名这些插件 因为**不点名就没法照抄** —— 「某个插件的某个浮窗」这种描述，AI 和人都无法定位到具体选择器。 **这些插件都没有错。** 半透明是玻璃主题的全局作用域导致的，被影响的插件只是按宿主的正常语义写了样式。本仓库做的是**在第三个位置收尾**，而不是指出谁的缺陷。 --- ## 六、安装 ### 方式一：本地目录（开发/自用推荐） 1. 克隆或用本地副本，放到任意目录 2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加两处： ```jsonc { "dependencies": { "dsh-glass-opaque-fix": "link:A:/你的路径/dsh-glass-opaque-fix" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // … "dsh-glass-opaque-fix" ] } } } ``` 3. 在 `profile/node_modules/` 下建目录链接（Windows 用 Junction）： ```cmd mklink /J "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-glass-opaque-fix" "A:\你的路径\dsh-glass-opaque-fix" ``` 4. **重启 DSH** ### 方式二：复制一个配方，不用装插件 如果你只想修**一个**插件、也不想装东西： 1. 读第四节，找到选择器 2. 把那段 CSS 加进**你自己已有的某个插件**里 3. 或直接加进任意会被加载的样式表 **代价**：以后主题或那个插件更新时，你可能要重新加一遍 —— 这正是本插件把规则独立出来的原因。 ### 环境要求 | 依赖 | 要求 | |---|---| | DSH | 能加载 `dsh.client` 插件的版本 | | 主题插件 | 可选。没装玻璃主题时，本插件不产生可见变化（规则仍注入，但底色本来就是不透明的） | **无需第三方依赖，无构建步骤。** --- ## 七、设计取舍 - **只加规则，不改别人的文件。** 这是它能活过插件更新的**唯一原因**。任何"顺手改一下主题插件"的做法都会回到原来的困境。 - **配方集中在 `RECIPES` 数组里。** 要改的地方只有一处，且改了哪条一目了然 —— 而不是散在几百行 CSS 里。 - **用 `ctx.effect` 绑定生命周期。** 卸载插件时样式随之移除。一个**已删除却仍在改页面**的插件，比它修的问题更糟。 - **没有配方时不注入空 `

# dsh-plugin-persona — DSH 人格管理器

给当前 DSH 客户端提供一套「模型人格（人设 / 人格提示词）」的完整管理：多套自定义人设、**每个会话独立绑定**、默认人格、随时切换（可选择立即生效或下个会话生效），并把同一套能力作为工具暴露给模型自己调用。

- Host 半（`lib/index.js`）：在会话自己的 agent scope 里覆盖 `deployment:persona-prefix` / `deployment:persona-suffix`，注册 HTTP JSON 桥，注册 3 个模型工具。
- Web 客户端半（`lib/client.js`）：设置页「模型人格」+ 输入框左侧的人设切换芯片。

## 功能

**设置页（设置 → 模型人格，`settings.section#persona-manager`，order 25）**

- 人设库：新建 / 编辑（名称、emoji、描述、前缀、后缀）/ 删除，`complete`（独占整个 system prompt）与 `suppressRuntimeContext`（抑制运行时上下文）两个开关。
- 设为默认 / 取消默认（默认人格只决定「没有绑定的会话」用什么）。
- 导入 / 导出 JSON；显示存储路径；显示模型工具注册状态（Host 半如果注册失败，这里会直接给出错误文本）。

**输入框芯片（`conversation.input.left#persona-manager.switcher`，order 120）**

- 一眼看到当前会话生效的人格（emoji + 名字，`跟随默认` / `临时文本` 也会显示出来）。
- 下拉即可切换：跟随默认、任选人设、`临时文本…`（只作用于本会话的一次性人格）、`仅对下一个会话生效`（只记账、不重注入，因此不动当前 KV 前缀）、`立即重注入`。

**模型工具（Host 半注册，模型可自行调用）**

- `persona_list` — 列出所有人设，并说明本会话当前生效的是哪个。
- `persona_switch` — 切换本会话人格；参数 `id` / `custom`（临时文本）/ `deferred`（true = 下次会话生效）。
- `persona_create` — 新建并保存一个可复用的人设。

**HTTP JSON 桥（客户端半使用，也可以脚本直接调）**

- `GET /dsh-persona/api/state?sessionId=<id>` → 完整视图（人设库、默认、本会话绑定、生效结果、`active`、`tools` 注册状态、`storePath`）。
- `POST /dsh-persona/api/call`，body `{"method": "...", "params": {...}}`，方法：`state` `create` `update` `remove` `setDefault` `switch` `activate` `import` `export`。失败返回 4xx + `{"ok":false,"error":"..."}`。

## 安装

推荐走 DSH 插件管理（需要 danger-full-access 或逐次批准）：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本目录的绝对路径>
```

它会 `pnpm link` 进 profile 并把包名写进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，同时激活 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 Loader 行 `persona-manager`。

也可以手动安装：把本目录放进（或链接到）profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-plugin-persona`，再在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加入 `"dsh-plugin-persona"`。

## 生效时机与 KV 缓存（重要）

- **只绑定 / 立即生效**：`switch` 默认只写绑定（下个会话或下个 agent 才生效）；`activate` 或界面上的「立即重注入」才会改写当前会话正在用的提示词。
- DSH 的 system prompt 走 `systemPromptUpdate: 'in-history'`：提示词变化会**追加在已缓存历史之后**，所以「立即生效」不会破坏已有前缀的缓存复用；代价是旧人格文本会留在历史里，直到 compaction 把它压掉。
- **重新加载**：客户端半（`lib/client.js`）的改动由 client-hmr 轮询自动热更新，刷新页面即可看到；Host 半（`lib/index.js` 等）的改动**必须重启 DSH 进程**（Node ESM 缓存，加载器不带 cache-busting 查询串）。

## 数据

- 默认 `$DSH_HOME/persona/personas.json`，可用环境变量 `DSH_PERSONA_STORE` 覆盖。
- 结构：`{version: 1, defaultId: string|null, personas: Persona[], bindings: {[sessionId]: {personaId?: string, custom?: string}}}`。
- 上限：200 条人设、名称 64 字符、单段文本 64 KiB、请求体 1 MiB。
- 写入是原子的（临时文件 + fsync + rename），读取永不抛（坏文件/缺失都当空库处理）。
- 首次运行会种入 3 个内置人设：精简架构师 / 严格评审员 / 耐心的讲解者。

## 实现要点（为什么这样做）

- DSH 的 `systemPrompt` **没有「改文本」接口**，只有 `section()` / `context()` 注册，而且注册是 per-context 的分层覆盖（`ScopedLayers`）。因此插件把人格注册进**该会话自己的 `agent.ctx`**，用它覆盖 preset 带来的人格 section；同一 scope 内重复注册同名 section 会抛错，所以每次切换都**先 dispose 旧的再注册新的**。
- **不能全局注册** persona section：会与 prompt registry 自带的全局 section 冲突并直接报错。
- `agent id === session id`，所以会话绑定直接用 sessionId 当键；新会话在 `agent/created` 时套用（绑定 → 默认 → 什么都不做，跟随 preset），插件被重新加载时也会给已存在的会话补注入一次。
- 不用自定义 session 事件（`SessionEventMap` 是仓库自有的，未知类型在读取时会被拒），也不依赖存储服务，插件自带原子 JSON 存储。
- 客户端半是**手写的 lazy-CJS bundle**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），只 `require` 平台 seed 表里的 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime`；bundle 模型里没有 `ctx.styles` 之类的服务，CSS 用原始 `<style>` 元素在 factory 阶段插入（由 client-modules 的 `claimStyles` 认领，HMR 时能正确回收）。
- 模型工具**不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`**（第三方插件解析不到 app.asar 里的包，会静默失败），改为手写等价对象：标准 JSON Schema 的 `parameters` + `output: {schema, render}`。

## 开发与测试

```bash
node test/check-persona.js    # 语法 + store/runtime 语义（原子写、resolvePersona 优先级、覆盖注册、释放、后缀 order 10200）
node test/verify-host.js      # 驱动真实 HTTP 路由 + 三个模型工具（含 deferred 不改写当前提示词的回归断言）
node test/verify-client.js    # 在假 window/document 里加载 bundle，真的渲染并点按钮，断言发出 switch 调用
npm test                      # 三个一起跑
```

三个 harness 都是纯 Node、无子进程（当前沙箱禁止管道），失败会打印 `FAIL …` 并以非 0 退出。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js        Host 半：HTTP 路由 + 3 个模型工具 + agent 生命周期 + 视图
lib/store.js        原子 JSON 存储、规范化与限额
lib/runtime.js      在 agent scope 内注入/释放 persona section
lib/client.js       Web 客户端半：设置页 + 输入框芯片（手写 bundle）
cordis.patch.yml    注入 Loader 行 persona-manager
test/               check-persona.js / verify-host.js / verify-client.js
```

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.

DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.readme_text:
# Chatgpt-DSH

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that signs in with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro account
and exposes its ChatGPT models in DSH on the subscription quota. No API key needed.

The plugin package lives in `chatgpt-plus-dsh/`. This repository contains the
package plus top-level documentation; the package directory itself ships only
runtime files.

## How it works

The plugin registers a `chatgpt-plus` provider route with DSH's `llm` service, so
the account's ChatGPT models show up in the DSH model picker. Requests go to the
ChatGPT backend used by the Codex CLI (`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api`), billed
against the ChatGPT subscription rather than API usage.

Sign-in uses OpenAI OAuth (Authorization Code + PKCE S256) with the Codex CLI's
public client. A short-lived listener on `127.0.0.1:1455` receives the redirect;
if that port is busy, the settings page offers a paste-the-URL fallback. The
resulting grant (access, refresh and ID tokens) is kept in DSH's credential store
under `chatgpt-plus/account` and refreshed automatically before it expires.

## Features

- Sign in / sign out with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro account from the DSH settings page.
- Account models listed from the ChatGPT backend, with periodic refresh and usage
  figures shown in the settings UI.
- Streaming chat completions via the Codex Responses endpoint, including tool
  calls and reasoning items where the model returns them.
- Background token refresh plus single-flight refresh shared across concurrent
  requests and DSH processes sharing one home.
- Settings page served from DSH's own web server (same-origin JSON endpoints);
  responses never contain token material.
- Runs alongside `dsh-chatgpt-sub` in one profile: provider route, credential
  key, HTTP prefix and data directory are all distinct.

## Technology stack

- JavaScript (ES modules), Node.js `>= 20.11`.
- Zero runtime dependencies — `lib/` imports only Node built-ins and sibling
  modules. The settings UI (`lib/client.js`) is a module-loader factory using
  `react` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` supplied by the host.
- Tests run on Node's built-in test runner, no test dependencies.
- Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer (`llm.registerAdapter` and
  credential records APIs).

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 20.11 or newer (`node --version`).
- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2+.
- A ChatGPT Plus or Pro account for sign-in.

## Installation

No `npm install` is required — the package declares no dependencies or peers.

1. Place the `chatgpt-plus-dsh/` directory where DSH loads plugins from
   (for example a `link:` install, or `dsh plugin add <path>` — see your DSH
   docs for the exact command in your setup).
2. Add the bundle row to your profile so the plugin is mounted. The stock row
   from `chatgpt-plus-dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: chatgpt-plus
      name: 'chatgpt-plus-dsh'
```

3. Start DSH, open Plugins → ChatGPT Plus, and click **Sign in with ChatGPT**.

Optional row config keys (all may be omitted): `callbackPort`
(OpenAI only accepts `1455` for this client), `signInTimeoutMs`,
`requestTimeoutMs`, `streamIdleTimeoutMs`, `clientVersion`.

## Configuration

There is no `.env` file. Secrets live only in DSH's credential store
(`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, record `chatgpt-plus/account`, file mode 0600);
non-secret preferences and the cached model list live under
`$DSH_HOME/chatgpt-plus-dsh/` (directory 0700, owner-only ACL on Windows).
All tunables are row config keys (see above) with defaults in
`chatgpt-plus-dsh/lib/constants.js` (`DEFAULTS`).

## Running locally

```powershell
node --version            # needs >= 20.11
cd chatgpt-plus-dsh
node tests/run-all.mjs    # offline test suite, no network access
```

To exercise the plugin against a real DSH build, install the package into a DSH
profile as described above and open the ChatGPT Plus settings page.

## Building and testing

There is no build step. The supported check is the offline suite:

```powershell
cd chatgpt-plus-dsh
node tests/run-all.mjs
```

It runs every `tests/*.test.mjs` in its own process and exits non-zero on any
failure. Last verified: 93 passed, 0 failed (Node 24, Windows).

## Project structure

```text
chatgpt-plus-dsh/
  lib/
    index.js       # plugin entry: registers provider route, token lifecycle, settings endpoints
    controller.js  # sign-in flow, token refresh, preferences, usage/model fetching
    provider.js    # `chatgpt-plus` LLM adapter (Codex Responses endpoint)
    oauth.js       # PKCE helpers, token exchange/refresh, grant payload
    models.js      # model catalog fetch, quota/usage parsing
    rpc.js         # same-origin settings-page endpoints
    client.js      # settings page UI (host module-loader factory)
    store.js       # credential-store + $DSH_HOME persistence
    errors.js      # error taxonomy and user-facing messages
    util.js        # file, time and platform helpers
    constants.js   # identifiers, OAuth/backend endpoints, defaults
  tests/           # offline suite (`run-all.mjs` + `*.test.mjs`)
  locale/en.json   # plugin card title/description
  cordis.patch.yml # bundle row mounting the plugin
  package.json     # manifest (no dependencies, no peers)
```

`verify/` (local only, not published) holds sandbox QA harnesses and screenshots.

## Troubleshooting

- **Plugin fails to load with a message about missing APIs**: update DSH to
  0.2.0-rc.2 or newer (`assertHostSupport` in `lib/index.js` names the missing API).
- **Sign-in listener can't bind port 1455**: another process (or a second DSH
  profile signing in) holds it. Use the paste-the-URL fallback the settings page
  shows, or free the port and retry.
- **"Refresh token was rejected" / signed out unexpectedly**: the grant expired
  or was revoked (including by signing in elsewhere, since rotation invalidates
  the old family). Sign in again from the settings page.
- **Requests fail after the token expires though auto-refresh is off**: either
  enable "Refresh tokens automatically" or use "Refresh token now" in
  Plugins → ChatGPT Plus.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
