# dsh-grok-byapi

Native Grok integration for DeepSeek Harness: model discovery, chat, image/video generation, TTS and durable local media tasks.

在 dsh 中统一使用 Grok：原生聊天提供方、自动分类模型、媒体生成和持久任务。

**Early alpha / 早期开发版：`0.2.0-alpha.1`。尚未发布 npm 包，当前从仓库安装（见下）。先使用独立测试 profile。实际验证情况见 [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md)，逐版变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。**

## 定位与功能

安装一个插件，配置一套网关连接。聊天选择器只显示聊天模型；图片、视频、TTS 由对应工具调用。聊天模型调用媒体工具，无需切换成 Imagine 或 TTS。

第一版连接用户运行的兼容网关，优先适配 CLIProxyAPI 的 `/v1` 接口，不共享或读取 Grok CLI 的 OAuth 刷新令牌。不提供账号、模型服务或免费额度。名称表示通过 API 接入，不表示已支持 Grok 官网全部产品功能。

| 功能 | 当前实现范围 |
| --- | --- |
| 模型目录 | `/models` 自动发现，分类为聊天、图片、视频、TTS、研究或未知，支持覆盖 |
| 聊天提供方 | `xAI-CLIProxyAPI` 路由，复用 dsh 官方 pi-ai 适配器处理流式响应与工具调用 |
| 图片 | `grok_generate_image` 生成并保存 |
| 视频 | `grok_generate_video` 提交，`grok_media_status` 查询并保存 |
| 语音 | `grok_speak` 文字转语音并保存 |
| 任务 | `grok_media_list`、`grok_media_retry_download`，会话隔离与持久记录 |
| 展示 | 工具结果卡片；点击文件进入预览；MP4、MP3、WAV 侧栏播放器 |
| 设置 | 插件详情页维护连接、密钥、对话模型与媒体模型；对话模型表格即聊天选择器名单 |

类别识别不等于验证可用，未知模型不自动进入聊天选择器。工具卡片显示该次调用记录，新视频状态需要再次查询。

**尚未实现：** 图片编辑、视频编辑/延长、自动后台轮询和完成通知、实时任务面板、语音识别、实时通话、直接 OAuth。实施方案见 [PLAN.md](PLAN.md)。

## 安装与配置

兼容目标：dsh `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`、Node.js `>=22.19.0`。dsh 加载插件时以 `engines.dsh` 判定兼容性（预发布版本参与比较），`peerDependencies` 只声明源码用到的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` SDK 范围、不参与该门禁。自动测试基于 dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` 的 SDK；本版已在 dsh `0.2.1-rc.1` 桌面 profile 实际加载并调用工具，其他 0.2.x 版本尚未逐个验收。npm 账号注册受阻，「发布到 npm」已推迟，`npm install dsh-grok-byapi` 目前不可用。

**方式一：从仓库安装（推荐，不需要 npm 账号）**

```powershell
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "git+https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi.git"
```

**方式二：本地源码调试**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi.git
cd dsh-grok-byapi
npm install --ignore-scripts
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "$PWD"
```

`--dump-config` 只创建 profile 目录并打印组合后的配置，不启动服务。`dsh plugin add` 会自动把插件写进该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不需要手动编辑；卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test remove dsh-grok-byapi`。需要固定版本时，把仓库地址写成 `git+https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi.git@<commit>`，或用 `npm pack` 产物安装。

在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 添加配置覆盖：

```yaml
- id: grok-byapi
  name: dsh-grok-byapi
  config:
    connection:
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1
      api: openai-responses
      apiKeyEnv: GROK_ALL_API_KEY
      timeoutMs: 60000
    media:
      imageModel: grok-imagine-image-2.0
      videoModel: grok-imagine-video-1.5
      speechModel: grok-tts
      dataDir: ''
```

调用密钥存入 dsh 凭据服务，或在启动进程的 `GROK_ALL_API_KEY` 环境变量提供。配置只填凭据引用，也可使用已有引用名称。不要把密钥写入 YAML 或仓库。连接和媒体字段可供 dsh 插件设置编辑。

旧版配置里的 `media.defaultModel` 已废弃：残留不影响启动，在设置页保存一次对话模型或媒体模型后会被清掉。

```powershell
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --no-open
```

聊天模型选择 **Grok** 下的模型；`grok_models` 查看分类或刷新。设置页里「对话模型」表格就是选择器内容，删掉行并保存后该模型从选择器消失；媒体模型选中 ID 即启用。公网使用自己的 HTTPS 网关地址；`127.0.0.1` 指 dsh Host 所在电脑。

## 任务与文件

- 创建请求不自动重试；提交超时标为未知，不盲目重复生成。
- 视频保留原任务 ID；用查询工具获取进度并保存结果。
- 临时结果及时下载，先写 `.part`，校验完成后改正式文件。
- 下载失败使用重试下载工具，不重新生成。
- 当前会话只看到自己的任务；重启保留记录。
- 默认目录是 dsh home 下 `plugins/dsh-grok-byapi`，按连接和任务隔离，可改 `media.dataDir`。
- 第三方媒体下载不携带网关密钥。任务记录可能保存签名 URL，请视为私有数据，不公开同步。
- 文件删除、链接过期可能无法恢复。播放器加载完整字节，大文件受 dsh 预览限制，可用系统应用打开。

## 许可证

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。Copyright (c) 2026 NingYuanLee。

## 开发与社区

```powershell
npm test        # 51 项自动测试
npm run check
npm run build   # 由 src/client.js 重新生成 lib/client.js
npm pack --dry-run
```

CI 在 Linux 与 Windows 上跑测试、语法检查、构建，并要求 `lib/client.js` 与构建产物一致。npm 发布待账号可用后进行：`package.json` 的 `publishConfig` 已把目标固定为官方 registry 与 `alpha` 标签，届时 `npm login` 后 `npm publish` 即可。离线分发用 `npm pack` 产物，用户侧 `dsh plugin add <tgz>` 实测可安装。

待办见 [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md)。仓库按 [dsh 官方社区指引](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#community-and-support) 添加 `dsh-plugin` Topic；欢迎通过 Issues 反馈。

Third-party community project, not an official DeepSeek or xAI product. 非 DeepSeek 或 xAI 官方产品。npm 包名尚未发布或保留。

plugins.description: 百通官方DSH插件市场
plugins.readme_text:
# @baitongserver/dsh-plugin-market

在 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 中浏览、搜索并安装**百通插件市场的 DSH 插件**与**百通技能库技能** —— 侧栏一个「百通插件广场」面板，或直接对 Agent 说话。

- 兼容 DSH **web 与桌面端（GUI）**，装完即用
- 支持私有化部署，改配置即可，无需重新编译（见[配置](#配置)）

源码：[github.com/imyasonly/dsh-plugin-market](https://github.com/imyasonly/dsh-plugin-market) ·
遇到问题请提 [issue](https://github.com/imyasonly/dsh-plugin-market/issues)

## 目录

- [功能](#功能)
- [环境要求](#环境要求)
- [安装](#安装)
- [使用](#使用)
- [配置](#配置)
- [数据与网络](#数据与网络)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [安全](#安全)
- [开发](#开发)
- [许可证](#许可证)

---

## 功能

**侧栏「百通插件广场」面板**

- 插件 / 技能双分类页，全部 / 已安装切换、类目筛选、排序
- 面板头部显示**当前插件版本号**与通知喇叭图标；当前版本低于线上版本时点亮红点并提示可更新到的版本
- 插件卡片：详情直达 GitHub、一键安装、实时进度（准备中 → 下载 → 完成）
- 已安装视图：本机只读预览已安装插件与技能（来源 spec、版本、体积、更新时间），可卸载

**Agent 工具**

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `baitong_plugin_search` | 搜索百通插件市场的 DSH 插件 |
| `baitong_plugin_install` | 安装指定插件（`owner` + `name`） |
| `baitong_skill_search` | 搜索百通技能库（公共 + 团队） |
| `baitong_skill_install` | 安装指定技能 |
| `baitong_skill_list` | 列出本机已装技能 |
| `baitong_skill_uninstall` | 卸载指定技能 |

**其他**

- 安装完成后可**一键重启 DSH**（桌面端走应用级重启，web 端走进程重启）
- 图标支持站内相对路径（如 `/baitong_ai/static/skill-icons/icon-02.png`）与 https 外链，
  统一经本机图标代理加载（离线/内网不裂图）；加载失败降级为首字色块
- 界面跟随 Harness 的中英文语言设置

---

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness（web 或桌面端）
- Node.js ≥ 22（由 DSH 提供）

`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`react` 等均由 DSH 提供，**无需自行安装**。

这些依赖在 `peerDependencies` 里写成**发布轨道范围**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 是
`^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`），而不是钉死单个版本 —— DSH 在装包前会把该范围与
**正在运行的 DSH 版本**做匹配（`semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true })`），
不匹配就在跑 pnpm 之前直接拒装。所以 DSH 跨到新的 0.x 线时，本插件需要跟着补一版范围。

---

## 安装

**Web（CLI）**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @baitongserver/dsh-plugin-market
dsh web
```

**桌面端（GUI）**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @baitongserver/dsh-plugin-market
```

装完**需要重启 DSH** 才生效。web 端重启进程并强制刷新浏览器；桌面端可点安装完成横幅上的「立即重启」，或从系统托盘完全退出后重新打开。

**几条容易踩的坑**

- ⚠️ **必须带 `@baitongserver/` scope**。npm 上无前缀名的 `dsh-plugin-market` 是**另一个项目**（`veloce-ailab`），不是本插件。
- `dsh web` 请绑定 `127.0.0.1`，不要监听 `0.0.0.0`。
- 从源码本地安装（`link:` 方式），以及构建 / 自检 / 发布流程，见 [开发](#开发)。

**npm 与 `github:` 两种源都支持**

- **npm（推荐）**：装的是预构建产物，无需任何额外配置。
- **`github:` 源**：安装时会在本机现场构建（`prepare` 脚本），所以目标 profile 要先允许依赖的构建脚本：

  ```yaml
  # ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml
  dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: true
  ```

  放行后重新执行 add 即可。用本插件安装**其他**插件时若遇到同类拦截，会自动写入这一项并重试，无需手动配置。

---

## 使用

直接对 Agent 说即可，例如：

- 找个能处理 PDF 的 skill
- 百通插件里搜一下浏览器自动化的
- 我装了哪些技能
- 把刚才那个卸载掉
- 装一下第一个插件

搜索完成后，对话中会出现可点击卡片；点开详情后再安装。**插件卡片也可以在对话流里直接点「安装」**，进度就地显示，装完按横幅提示「立即重启」。

侧栏底部的**「百通插件广场」**会在聊天区打开独立面板（可切换 插件 / 技能），面板盖在会话列上，关掉后直接回到对话。

> Agent 已被约束为只调用本插件的工具，不会打印 `dsh plugin` / `npm` / `curl` 命令。

---

## 配置

设置页中本插件的配置项 id 为 **`baitong-plugin-market`**（路径：设置 → 插件 → 插件配置）：

| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `apiBase` | 百通 API 根地址（不含 `/api`），用于指向私有化部署 |
| `skillsDir` | 技能安装目录，默认 `$DSH_HOME/skills` |
| `timeoutMs` | 上游请求超时（毫秒），默认 `20000` |
| `maxResults` | 搜索结果上限，默认 `12` |
| `userAgent` | 请求 UA |

保存后立即生效。配置写入 `$DSH_HOME/baitong-market.json`，不会进入 git。

### apiBase 覆盖链（高 → 低）

| 优先级 | 来源 | 适用场景 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 环境变量 `BAITONG_API_BASE` | CLI 启动，最高 |
| 2 | 设置页保存 → `$DSH_HOME/baitong-market.json` | GUI，⚠️ 会覆盖下面几项 |
| 3 | `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` | **GUI 启动唯一入口**（自动加载 + 支持热重载） |
| 4 | 仓库内 `cordis.patch.local.yml` + `--patch` | 本地联调，不随包发布 |
| 5 | 默认值 `https://ts.1100111.cn/baitong_ai`（0.1.9 起临时指向测试环境；生产为 `https://s.1100111.cn/baitong_ai`） | 无需配置 |

### 私有化部署示例

GUI 启动无法传 `--patch`，配置写在 profile 层（改这层支持热重载，不必重启）：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml
- id: baitong-plugin-market
  name: "@baitongserver/dsh-plugin-market"
  config:
    apiBase: https://your-private-host/baitong_ai
```

> patch 的非 insert 项**必须带 `id`**，否则报 `patch: id is required for non-insert patches`。

### 临时换地址（不改文件）

```sh
BAITONG_API_BASE=https://your-private-host/baitong_ai dsh web
```

地址可写裸 `host:port`（自动补 `http://`），尾部斜杠自动去除。

### 确认当前生效地址

不确定连的是哪个地址时，直接查诊断接口（返回里的 `apiBase` 就是实际生效值）：

```sh
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:<port>/baitong-market -d '{"method":"pluginInstallStatus"}'
```

---

## 数据与网络

| 用途 | 请求 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件目录 / 类目 | `GET {apiBase}/api/bt/dsh/plugins`、`/categories` |
| 插件安装计划 | `GET {apiBase}/api/bt/dsh/plugins/{owner}/{name}/install-plan` |
| 技能搜索 / 详情 | `GET {apiBase}/api/v1/search`、`/api/v1/skills/{slug}` |
| 技能安装包 | `GET {apiBase}/api/v1/download?slug=`（302 → COS 预签名） |
| 版本自检 | `GET registry.npmjs.org` / `registry.npmmirror.com` 的 `@baitongserver/dsh-plugin-market/latest`（成功缓存 1h，失败 5min） |
| 本机面板 | `/baitong-market`（安装进度轮询、图标代理、同源重启） |

- 上游请求有超时（默认 20s），超时与网络失败会给出可读的错误原因
- 网络走**使用者自己的系统配置**，插件不内置任何代理
- 版本自检**只读且不阻塞**：查不到线上版本时徽标只显示当前版本，不报错、不影响任何功能
- 自定义 `apiBase` 应只指向你信任的服务

---

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 点安装后要等一会儿才动 | 正常。服务端要先拉安装计划并做依赖冲突预检，期间显示「正在准备安装…」。**不要重复点击** |
| 提示「已有安装任务在进行中」 | 已有安装任务在跑，看进度条即可；重复点击不会加快 |
| 点「立即重启」没反应 / 提示无法自动重启 | 桌面端从**系统托盘**完全退出 DSH 后重开（只关窗口不够，托盘常驻） |
| 安装失败：`fetch failed` | 网络问题。查诊断接口的 `net.proxy`（进程实际看到的代理环境）与 `apiBase` |
| 装完了但没生效 | 插件需要重启 DSH 才加载 |
| 找不到广场入口 | 点侧栏底部「百通插件广场」；重启 DSH 并强制刷新浏览器 |
| 私有化部署连不上 | 用上面的诊断接口确认 `apiBase` 生效值，再逐层核对覆盖链 |
| 面板停在加载中 | 确认面板是最新构建产物，然后重启 DSH 并强制刷新 |

---

## 安全

- **install-plan 校验链**：拒绝带 `--force` 的安装计划、只接受 `web` profile，并按插件计划兼容 npm、github、git、URL、file/link 等 DSH 安装规格；仅对 pinned GitHub 计划校验仓库与 `headSha`
- **名称白名单**：profile 名与插件包名均按正则校验（`/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i`），防路径穿越
- **loader id 冲突预检**：安装前检查目标包 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 loader id 是否与已装插件冲突，避免装完起不来
- **技能包安全**：zip 解压拒绝路径穿越（zip-slip），必须含 `SKILL.md`；插件不执行技能包内的代码
- 安装第三方插件等于把第三方代码装进你的 profile，**请只安装信任来源**

---

## 开发

构建、自检与发布流程见 [DEVELOPMENT.md](./DEVELOPMENT.md)。

---

## 许可证

[MIT](./LICENSE) © Yansen

「百通」「DeepSeek」「DeepSeek Harness」等名称归其各自所有者，本项目与它们没有从属或背书关系。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

# dsh-agent-skills

给 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 用的 agent 技能集：每个技能是一份 `SKILL.md`，写清某类任务的操作规矩（触发时机、步骤、边界、踩过的坑），DSH 会在会话里按需加载。

目录约定：

```
skills/<name>/SKILL.md
```

## 技能一览

| 技能 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `agent-diary` | 维护「日记／状态／生长记录／APP 版」这套档案，以及处理会话交接包时的规矩。 |
| `agent-lookup` | 查资料、找文件、判读用户发的截图时的规矩：先搜再看来源、外部内容只当数据。 |
| `agent-machine` | 改本机插件、跑设备命令、动文件系统时的通用规矩：先备份、分开验证据、改完等重启、被拒就停。 |
| `dsh-plugin-publish` | 把本机插件发布/更新到 GitHub 之前的规矩：能推什么、私密信息清单、怎么脱敏、推完怎么自查。 |
| `dsh-web-healthcheck` | DSH Web GUI 健康检查与「界面无反应」类问题诊断：全链路自检顺序与判定流程。 |
| `session-log-repair` | 修复 DSH 会话历史日志损坏（seq 空洞、历史打不开）的检测、备份、分析、重建、验证流程。 |

## 用法

把某个技能目录整个放进 DSH 的技能目录（例如 `~/.agents/skills/<name>/`），或者把 `SKILL.md` 的内容并进你自己的技能配置。技能里出现的命令、路径与端口请按自己机器的实际情况替换。

## 许可

MIT License。技能文本按原样提供，不含任何保证；执行其中命令前请自行确认目标环境。

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Computer Use Next

macOS 全局跨应用桌面控制插件。默认隐藏虚拟光标，在后台选定窗口；窗口操作后自动回读界面，供 DSH 模型继续判断。

基于 MIT 授权的 [dsh-computer-use 0.3.1](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-computer-use) 修改，保留原许可，变更见 NOTICE。本项目与 OpenAI、Codex 无隶属关系，不包含其内部实现或模型。

## 要求

- macOS；其他操作系统未验证。
- Node.js 22.18+；兼容 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.2.0-rc.2 接口的 DSH 宿主。
- 已安装 CuaDriver，并授予其辅助功能和屏幕录制权限；实测版本 0.35.2。
- 原生图片和整屏观察需要对话模型支持图片输入，否则使用窗口 AX 控件树。

## 安装

发布后可通过 GitHub Release 中的 dsh-computer-use-next.tgz 安装，或由收录后的 DSH 插件市场安装。仓库自带 dsh.bundle manifest 和运行时 JavaScript，不需要编译。

本机桌面 profile 的手动安装：

```sh
python3 install.py
```

脚本只针对已有 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop 的桌面版，复制插件、备份并追加配置，不重启应用、不更改模型账号。其他 profile 使用宿主的插件安装方式。

如已启用旧版 dsh-computer-use，先禁用旧版，避免同名工具重复注册；本插件不会擅自禁用其他插件。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| desktop_windows | 全局应用窗口列表及精确窗口 ID。 |
| app_switch | 后台选定并观察目标窗口，不主动前置。 |
| desktop_observe | 主显示器整屏图片，包括 Dock 和菜单栏。 |
| desktop_click | 全局坐标点击及回读；后台模式默认禁用。 |
| screen_observe | 窗口 AX 控件树及可用截图。 |
| screen_zoom | 局部截图。 |
| computer_click / computer_double_click / computer_right_click | 窗口点击、双击、右键。 |
| computer_type / computer_key | 目标窗口文本输入及快捷键。 |
| computer_scroll / computer_drag | 窗口内滚动及拖拽。 |
| computer_wait | 等待加载。 |
| app_list / app_launch | 应用列表及启动。 |

合计 16 个工具。窗口点击、输入、按键、滚动和拖拽后自动回读原窗口，模型需要检查实际变化。不同 agent 的观察缓存隔离，插件内调用串行执行。

示例：

> 使用 desktop_windows 查看窗口，选定计算器计算 12+34，再观察另一个应用，最后回到计算器核对结果。保持后台，每步检查界面，不重复执行结果未知的动作。

## 后台与前台

默认 backgroundOnly=true、animateCursor=false。驱动会话初始化和恢复时关闭虚拟光标，不隐藏用户自己的鼠标。

后台模式禁止主动前置及 desktop_click；使用 app_launch 和 app_switch 跨应用工作。不支持后台的操作会失败，不自动前置重试；应用自身弹窗仍可能改变焦点，不能保证所有软件完全后台运行。

如需 Dock/菜单栏点击，可显式设置 backgroundOnly=false，允许前台交互。整屏坐标和窗口坐标不能混用。

未验证多屏、其他 Space、最小化窗口及完整模型驱动的跨应用长任务；未实现跨窗口拖拽、视频流或独立无人值守规划。

## 数据和权限

截图经 DSH attachments 服务处理，可能按模型路由发送给模型服务商。显式 vision 模式继承上游观察者及可选 GLM fallback，其密钥查找和请求见 lib/vision.js。默认 native/AX 路径不新增密钥。

快照 TTL、应用白名单和部分按钮审批规则不是完整安全保障，坐标点击及快捷键不能可靠推断业务后果。详见 PERMISSIONS.md。

## 验证和卸载

```sh
node --test tests/*.test.mjs
python3 install.py --uninstall
```

16 项自动测试通过。实际验证了计算器点击与截图回读、计算器与 DSH 的后台窗口观察、1568×1014 整屏读取及虚拟光标关闭。完整模型任务尚未验证。

卸载只移除本插件的配置块，保留其他配置及插件文件。下一次启动或宿主重新加载配置后生效。

plugins.description: DSH 超级工作台：1/2/4 窗会话与自主智能体团队 | Multi-pane conversations and autonomous agent teams for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Team Workbench · 超级工作台

[English](README.en.md) · [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md) · [配置](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) · [架构](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

DeepSeek Harness 的非官方插件：在一个主窗口中以 **1／2／4 窗**查看真实会话，并用持续存在的模块成员组织并行工作。

团队组织方式是 **leader → 模块成员 → 成员自己的子智能体**。leader 给目标和边界，成员自己规划、拆解与授权派发；Host 调度器在依赖满足、容量释放后继续启动已授权工作。

本仓库独立提供工作台与团队运行时，**不包含、也不要求安装 myworkflow 技能包**。

## 能做什么

- **多会话工作台**：切换 1／2／4 窗，保留各会话的草稿与阅读位置，使用 DSH 原生对话组件。
- **模块成员自治**：持久模块委托、成员计划、版本化派发授权、成员收件箱与成果验收。
- **持续补位**：已授权的独立工作按依赖和容量推进，不等待整批结束；保留恢复和交互余量。
- **可追溯交付**：区分产出与验收，关联执行记录、产物哈希、验收条件和未完成事项。
- **运行状态**：查看成员决策、等待原因、任务、用量、费用估算及错误记录。未配置价格或缺少数据时显示未知。

窗格直接绑定工作区主会话；成员和子智能体通过该会话的“子会话”菜单进入。窗口数与并发执行数相互独立。写范围协调也不等于文件系统隔离。

## 兼容范围

已调查的接口基线是 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**。前端依赖该版本的 Session、slot、原生对话组件与布局接口；后续版本需重新核对。

团队执行要求当前 profile 已启用 DSH 原生实验性 Agent Team，并提供可用的 continuable 子智能体 provider。缺失能力时插件会给出诊断，不能把“插件加载成功”视为团队可运行。

此发布提供生产模块的自动化测试、模拟原生接口的集成检查、打包检查及 CI 配置。**它们不构成所有 DSH 版本、操作系统或真实模型的运行认证**。真实安装、多窗和团队行为按[验收说明](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)另行核实。

## 安装

在装有 DSH CLI 的环境中：

```sh
dsh plugin add github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0
```

如需指定已有 profile，例如 `desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0
```

请确认安装目标与实际启动的 DSH profile 相同。安装方式遵循 [DSH 官方 bundle 文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish)。

也可安装本地源码目录或已打包的 `.tgz`。在 DSH 创造模式中，使用原生插件管理工具：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0")
```

本地安装时将 `target` 替换为本机源码目录的绝对路径。工具行为以[官方 plugin-manager 说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/boot/plugin-manager/README.md)及当前 DSH 版本为准。

**配置影响**：本 bundle 将原生 `subagent` 行设为 `maxDepth: 2`、`maxActiveSubagents: 40`。这会影响同一 profile 中使用该服务的其他任务，不只是工作台。安装前核对已有覆盖配置；详见 [配置说明](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)。没有模型配额或速率限制随安装自动增加。

安装后查看插件加载结果，在侧栏打开“超级工作台”。若当前版本要求重载或重启，应先保存并妥善结束活跃任务，再按 DSH 提示操作。

## 开始使用

可在一个新的 DSH 会话中提出完整目标，例如：

> 创建一个小型游戏内容包。建立敌人内容与装备内容两个模块成员，每个成员交付四个完整对象。成员自行决定对象设计、计划和子任务，独立交付设计说明、结构化数据及验证结果。按完整对象并行，不拆成调研、开发、检查接力。先限制并发，确认流程正常后再调整。

模型侧的推荐路径：

1. leader 用 `team_define`、`team_member_create` 建立团队，再用 `team_mission_assign` 委托模块目标。
2. member 用 `team_plan_submit` 决定自行执行或委派，提交自己的计划，再用 `team_dispatch_authorize` 授权需要派发的工作。
3. Host 调度器启动可执行项；成员通过收件箱和回执继续处理自己的模块。
4. 产物提交后，由 owner 核验。需要可执行验证时使用 `team_exec_check` 记录结果，再由 `team_work_verify` 对照验收条件作出结论。

简单请求可以直接完成，不必创建团队。完整说明见 [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md)。

## 开发与贡献

开发需要 Node.js **22 或更新版本**。源码目录中运行：

```sh
npm run build
npm test
npm run check:package
```

修改前阅读 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。测试在完整源码 checkout 中运行；发布的 `.tgz` 是运行时包。前端生成文件应由构建脚本生成；不要只修改 `client.js`。公开问题报告请去除私有路径、会话正文、账号标识和凭据。

## 文档

- [使用指南与工具分工](docs/USAGE.md)
- [配置、容量和数据位置](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)
- [架构与运行约束](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [真实 DSH 验收清单](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)
- [发布流程](docs/RELEASE.md)
- [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)。本项目由社区独立维护，与 DeepSeek 官方没有隶属或背书关系。

# dsh-hud > 一个只读的工作区 Git 面板：分支、ahead/behind、改动清单与差异，外加「这个会话改过哪些文件、审到哪了、跑了什么工具」。 > A read-only workspace Git panel for DeepSeek Harness, with per-session change attribution. ![输入框上方的三枚胶囊：最左边是本次会话运行时长，中间是 Git 状态，右边是工具与技能](docs/images/capsules.webp) *左：工作区名 · `git:(分支*)` · ahead/behind · 改动计数 · 本会话改过几个文件。右：每个工具的调用次数、正在跑什么、以及会话调用过哪些技能 —— 图中 `aihot ×1` 是红的，因为那次调用失败了。* ## 安装 桌面端「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」里填 `@konnga/dsh-hud`。 本地开发时把 profile 的依赖指向仓库（改动即时可见；客户端代码要重启应用才重读）： ```json "@konnga/dsh-hud": "link:/path/to/dsh-hud" ``` ## 你会看到什么 ### 会话计时胶囊（同一行的最左边，单独一枚） ``` ⏱ 2h 14m ``` **本次会话已经运行了多久** —— 口径与 [codex-hud](https://github.com/konnga/codex-hud) 的会话时长完全一致：**挂钟时间 = 现在 − 会话创建时刻**（含等待与空闲），格式也是同一套（`<1m` / `45m` / `2h 14m` / `3d 2h`，不足一分钟写 `<1m`，只列非零项）。 悬停补齐"这段时间里真正在干什么"： ``` 本次会话运行时长 · 创建于 2026-10-14 17:58 · 其中模型 1h 29m、工具 23m · 27 轮 / 380 步 ``` - 模型 / 工具墙钟与轮次、步数来自内置 **`sessionStats` 投影**（它从完整持久日志折叠，分页与压实都不会让数字跳变）；那个投影没注册（插件被组合掉 / 旧宿主）时**只显示挂钟时长**，不编造后两项。 - 数字一分钟取一次（宿主侧同样带 60 秒缓存），显示每 4 秒自跳一次 —— 跨分钟不用等下一次请求。 - 会话不在（归档、子会话已回收）或宿主没有 `sessions` 服务时，**整枚不渲染**，不留空壳。 - 只读读数，指针不是"可点"；数字用等宽数字，跳动时宽度不抖。 ### 胶囊（输入框上方） ``` dsh-hud · git:(main*) ↑1 ↓2 M4 A1 ?1 │ ●3 ``` - `dsh-hud` —— 工作区名（当前会话的目录名）。太长从中间省略，完整路径看悬停。 - `git:(main*)` —— 分支。`*` 表示工作区不干净；detached 时是 `git:(detached abc1234)`。 - `↑1 ↓2` —— 与上游的领先 / 落后（为 0 不显示）。 - `M4 A1 ?1` —— 改动计数，只列非零项：`M` 修改 · `A` 新增 · `D` 删除 · `R` 重命名 · `C` 复制 · `T` 类型改变 · `?` 未跟踪 · `!` 冲突。 - `●3` —— 本会话改过 3 个文件（没有就不显示）。 点它开面板；悬停给出完整路径、上游与各类计数。**不在 git 仓库里也会显示**（只有工作区名 + `git:(非 git 仓库)`）。 ### 工具胶囊（同一行的右边，只在跑过工具后出现） ``` ◐ bash: pnpm test 1.2s ← 正在跑（秒数实时跳） ✓ bash ×16 │ ✓ apply_patch ×6 │ skills: office-xlsx ×2 +2 ← 空闲 ``` - 每个工具一个计数；前面的 `✓` / `✗` 是**它自己最近一次调用**的结果。 - `skills:` 后面是会话调用过的**技能名**（不是"技能调了几次"—— 看得出是哪一个）。 - 最多铺 3 个工具、2 个技能，其余收成 `+k`；悬停里有完整清单与最近几条的执行结果。 ### 面板（点胶囊打开） ![面板：左边是改动概览与本会话改了哪些、改动清单、最近提交、标签；中间是这次提交的明细；右边是差异](docs/images/panel.webp) *上图是「看某次提交」时的样子：左边是面板本身，中间是这次提交改了哪个文件，右边是差异。标题栏可拖动，`⟳` 刷新 · `⌖` 复位位置 · `✕` 收起。* 1. **仓库路径 · 上游 · 短 oid** 2. **改动概览** —— 按类型分组的彩色计数；干净时写「工作区干净」。 3. **本会话改了哪些** —— 一行计数（`本会话改过 3 个文件 · 另有 2 个可能相关 · 1 个已不在 git 现状里`）加开关：`只看本会话改的`、`只看最近一轮`（拿得到回合信息时才出现）；有已审标记时还有 `已审 3/8` 与 `清空已审`。 4. **改动清单** —— 每行 `标记 状态字母 路径`，重命名读作 `旧 → 新`。 - 行首：`●` 确定改过 · `◐` 可能相关（从命令里看出来的，悬停给出那条命令）· `○` 与本会话无关。 - 行尾：`○` / `✓` 是审阅标记 —— 点一下或按 `v` 切换；`✓` 变黄表示改动又变了，需要重看。 - 点任意一行看这个文件的差异。 5. **最近提交** —— `短sha 标题 [HEAD] 2026-10-16 14:18`；点一行看这次提交，再点一次收起。 6. **标签** —— `tag 名 短sha [HEAD] 时间`，新的在前；点一行看它指向的提交。仓库没有标签时会写一行「这个仓库还没有标签」。 时间一律是**完整年月日 + 时分**（本地时区），提交与标签两处一样。 ### 差异与提交明细 - **看差异**：两栏 —— 左边还是面板，右边是差异。工具栏有 `未暂存` / `已暂存` 页签、`自动换行`、`复制差异`。点 hunk 头可折叠那一段。 - **看提交**：三栏 —— 面板 │ 这次提交 │ 差异，并自动打开这次提交的第一个文件。`Esc` 或 `✕` 收起。 - **两条抓握可以拖**：右边缘那条调差异栏宽度（默认 470px）；提交明细栏右边那条调提交明细栏（默认 240px）—— 路径被截断就往左拖。两条宽度都会记住。 - **看图片改动**：二进制文件里认得出是图片时（PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP / BMP，**按文件头认，不看扩展名**），差异栏画成两张图并排 —— 也可以切成单张来回看 —— 并给出尺寸变化与字节变化（`1024×768 → 1024×512`、`2.0 KB → 1.0 KB`）。两侧各自说明"为什么画不出来"：超过单侧 4 MB 预览上限、不是可预览的图片、或缺这一侧（新增 / 删除）。未暂存看「索引 → 工作区」，已暂存看「HEAD → 索引」，提交明细看「父提交 → 这次提交」—— 与文本 diff 的页签语义完全一致。 - **图片缩放**：工具条上是常显的 `−` / 档位 / `＋`：默认「适应宽度」，档位走 25% / 50% / 100% / 150% / 200%（200% 封顶），点档位本身回到「适应宽度」。固定档位按**图片固有像素**算宽度（宽高由宿主一并给出，第一帧就算对，不用等图片加载），超出部分由差异栏横向滚动。档位**会记住**（与「自动换行」一样落盘）。
内置的右侧文档预览也有缩放，但它的控件是**藏在"预览区底部 72px 的悬停感应带"里的浮层**（CSS 默认 `opacity:0`，指针离开 420ms 收起），滚轮缩放还必须按 Ctrl/⌘ —— 看不见按钮是正常的；这一排按钮就是为了不依赖它。 ![差异栏里的图片改动：工具栏是未暂存/已暂存/自动换行/复制差异，下面是「并排」与 − 100% ＋ 缩放按钮，橙色高亮写着「尺寸 190×140 → 230×160」和「8.8 KB → 11.4 KB」，两张图左右并排，左标「索引」右标「工作区」](docs/images/image-diff.webp) *上图：定了 100% 档位的两张图（左＝索引里的旧版，右＝工作区的新版），尺寸与字节的变化在标题行上一眼可见。* ### 轮尾的「本轮图片改动」（在内置改动卡片旁边） 内置那张「已编辑 N 个文件」的卡片，点一行是打开本轮的 review tab —— 图片在那里看不见（内置正文对二进制只给一句文案，而且没有给插件留正文槽位）。所以本插件在同一处轮尾放了一条自己的门： ![轮尾的「本轮图片改动」：三张缩略图，命令行旁听来的两张带 ◐ 标记，每张后面跟着一个 ⇄，末尾写「还有 3 个」](docs/images/turn-images.webp) - **点缩略图 → 在右侧内置文档预览里打开这张图**（图片原生渲染、可缩放）； - 右边那个 `⇄` → 打开本插件的面板，看这张图的**前后对比**（内置预览只有当前这一版）； - 只列**这一轮**改过的图片（按会话归因里的回合号收窄），最近改的在前，最多 4 张 + `还有 N 个`；这一轮没动过图片时整条不渲染； - 归因**两档都收**：写文件/编辑工具改的算确定（不标符号），从 shell 命令里认出来的标 `◐`、悬停给出那条命令 —— 图基本是脚本产出的（`python gen.py`、`cp`、`curl -o`），只收确定档等于收不到东西。 ### 侧栏会话行（悬停或点行尾 `⋯`） 侧栏那一行本身没有标记；信息在按需展开处，都是文字： ``` main* ↑0 ↓0 · 已修改 7 未跟踪 2 本会话改过 3 个文件 · 命令旁听到 4 个可能改动的路径（1 个现在有差异） ``` 干净时写明「工作区干净」「本会话没有改动记录」。 ## 键盘 **先在面板里点一下**（或 Tab 进去）才接管按键；点到面板外就交还。Cmd/Ctrl/Alt 组合键与输入框里的按键一律不碰。 | 键 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `↑` `↓` | 上下移动选中行（只移动，不打开） | | `Enter` | 打开选中的那条 | | `[` `]` | 上一个 / 下一个文件，并直接打开 | | `n` `p` | 下一个 / 上一个 hunk（折叠着的会展开） | | `Space` | 折叠 / 展开当前 hunk | | `v` | 把当前行标成「这一版我审过了」（再按取消） | | `r` | 重新读取 | | `Esc` | 退一层：先收右栏（差异 / 提交明细），再按才收面板 | 看提交明细时，`↑ ↓ Enter [ ]` 作用于明细那一栏的清单。 ## 它不做什么 - **只读**：不写 index、不动工作区与 git 配置，不执行 `add` / `commit` / `checkout` / `fetch`；不显示凭证。**读文件内容只有一种情形**：看图片改动时读那两侧的字节 —— 只读、只在内存里、走数据 URL 画出来，不落盘、不外链。 - **归因是两档估计**：经写文件 / 编辑工具的算「确定改过」；从 shell 命令里认出来的算「可能相关」（`>` `>>` `tee`、`sed -i` / `perl -i`、`mv` / `cp` / `rm` / `touch` / `dd of=`、`git checkout|restore <路径>`）。**会漏也会多报**，所以永远标 `◐`，不冒充 `●`；其余命令只记进命令历史，不猜路径。 - **记录不落盘**：会话改动与工具活动都活在宿主进程里，重启归零；每个会话会写明「自 … 起记录」。 - **上限**：改动清单 200 条、单会话归因 500 个文件、标签 100 个、最近提交 10 条 —— 超出只计数并标 `truncated`。 - **图片预览的边界**：只认 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP / BMP（按文件头，不认 SVG）；单侧超过 4 MB 只报大小不画图；**只在本插件的差异栏里生效** —— DSH 自带的改动对比页（内置 `deliverables` 的 `changes-review` 页签）没有给"文件正文"留槽位，插件改不了那一页。 - **审阅签名用 `size + mtimeMs`**：`touch` 一下（内容没变）也会让「已审」失效 —— 宁可让你多看一眼。 - **计数按文件算**：未跟踪不折叠目录（与编辑器一致）；同一个文件「既暂存又改动」算 1 条。 ## 存在浏览器里的东西 | 键 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `dsh-hud.ui.v1` | 面板展开状态、拖动位置、两条拖出来的宽度、开关 | | `dsh-hud.reviewed.v1` | 「已审」标记（按工作区 + 文件记签名，最多 200 条） | | `dsh-hud.debug` | 最近 24 行自诊断 —— 排查「界面没反应」用，可随手删 | ## 开发 - `lib/index.js`：宿主半（跑 git、提供 `/dsh-hud-rpc`）。 - `lib/client.js`：浏览器半（**无构建步骤**，手写 JS，只依赖种子模块 `react`）。 - `npm test`：全部用例（`node --test test/*.test.mjs`）。 - `docs/dock-slot-host.md`：把输入框上方那一行做成「可注册行内宿主」的提案，给上游看的。 - **发版**：`npm run tag && npm publish`。`prepublishOnly` 先跑测试，再校验「版本号 ↔ git tag」（工作区要干净、`v<版本>` 要存在且指向 HEAD），对不上就发不出去。 ## 许可 MIT

plugins.description: A per-turn token usage strip for DeepSeek Harness: a segmented bar plus a written legend under every reply, showing this turn's uncached input / cache read / output split.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-bar

[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Web 界面加一条**单轮 token 用量条**：每条回复末尾一行，把这一轮的缓存结构画成灰 / 黄 / 绿三段条，配一条带百分比的完整图例。

![单轮用量条：灰=未缓存输入、黄=缓存读取、绿=输出，后面跟带百分比的图例](docs/screenshot-turn-bar.png)

**极轻量**：纯客户端展示，不联网、不落盘、不注册任何 Host 路由、不写会话日志、不改任何官方包。
**零依赖**：一个手写 bundle，只用平台提供的 React。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

---

## 它解决什么

官方在每条回复末尾的用量气泡里，点开能看到「本轮用量」的精确数字。但**数字是列表，要读；结构是形状，一眼就懂**：

- 这一轮是不是全命中缓存？
- 有没有跑出大量未缓存输入（意味着前缀失效、成本变高）？
- 输出占比是否异常？

`dsh-token-bar` 把这三个数字变成一条可扫视的带状图，并且带图例——**不需要悬停也知道每段是什么、占多少**。

## 外观

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 段序 / 图例序 | **灰（未缓存输入）→ 黄（缓存读取）→ 绿（输出）**，条与图例完全同序 |
| 条宽 | 132px |
| 最小段宽 | 只要有 token 就至少 **6px**，再小的占比也看得见，不会和图例对不上 |
| 图例 | 色点 + 名称 + 本轮占比百分比 |
| 字号 | 比正文小一号：`calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary, 13px) - 1px)`，跟随设置里的字号 |
| 配色 | 全部取自 `--dsw-*` 主题 token，浅色 / 深色自动跟随 |
| 对齐 | 靠左，不居中 |

悬停显示本轮完整明细：缓存命中率 + 每段精确 token 数与占比。

> 缓存写入未单独成段——当前路由上该值恒为 0。

## 数据来源

读 `turn.data.get('turn-tail').tokenUsage`，即**本轮**的用量（和官方「本轮用量」弹窗同源），**不是**会话累计。

`conversation.chat.turnTail` 插槽的 owner（ui-chat 的 `TurnTailNodeView`）会把 Turn 位置作为 owner props 直接传入，Conversation 已把本轮账目折进 `turn-tail` 这份 location data。感谢 [dsh-token-counter](https://github.com/OkliaoliO/dsh-token-counter) 提供的实现参考。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-bar
```

或从本地目录安装（开发时）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-token-bar
```

安装后**重启 `dsh web`** 生效。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-token-bar
```

## 兼容性

| 组件 | 支持 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测 |
| Node.js | `>=20` |
| 界面 | DSH Web（依赖 `conversation.chat.turnTail` 插槽） |
| 系统 | macOS / Linux / Windows（纯 JavaScript） |

## 开发

```sh
npm run check   # 语法检查
npm test        # 纯函数测试 + 渲染测试
```

`npm test` 默认测试**源码** `client.js`。想验证浏览器实际收到的那份构建产物，从运行中的 `dsh web` 抽一份快照：

```sh
node scripts/snapshot-bundle.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=<启动时打印的 token>"
npm test        # 检测到 verify-module.js 后，自动改为测试服务端下发的产物
```

### 网络受限时推送

如果所在网络访问不了 `github.com:443`（`git push` 卡住超时）但 `api.github.com` 可以访问，用 REST API 推送：

```sh
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo> --dry-run   # 先看要推什么
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo>             # 真正推送
```

它会按 blobs → trees → commits 重放本地历史，并把分支指向**远端生成的**新 commit SHA（API 创建的 commit 与本地 SHA 不同，这点最容易踩坑）。

## 可调参数

都在 `client.js` 顶部：

| 常量 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `BUCKETS` | 三段（顺序、名称、颜色） |
| `MIN_SEGMENT_PX` | 最小段宽，默认 `6` |
| `TRACK_PX` | 条宽，默认 `132` |
| `FONT_SIZE` | 字号，默认比正文小一号 |

## 已知限制

- 只覆盖完成（`turn/end`）的轮次；正在流式输出的那一轮没有条。
- 依赖官方 `turn-tail` 的 location data 结构；DSH 若改动该结构，需要跟随适配。
- 没有设计器 / 配置界面，改样式需要编辑源码。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: A Kanban board for DSH: one SQLite board shared by a human and their agent sessions, in the desktop app's sidebar. Two gates (Definition of Ready, Definition of Done) are enforced by the board itself, and every move is an event, so cycle time and throughput come from what happened.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-kanban

One task board for the whole home directory, shared by Dhira and by every agent session: the panel is
the human's view, the `kanban_*` tools are the agents', and `bin/kanban.mjs` is the scripted one — all
over one SQLite store, through one policy engine, so **the gate that refuses an agent is the gate that
refuses the human**.

| surface | who uses it | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Kanban panel** (`sidebar.panellist` → `main`) | the human | every state as a lane (`dropped` last), drag-and-drop with a keyboard path, a search box, a `New card` button that opens a minimal create dialog, the card drawer with both checklists, the flow metrics and a collapsible history |
| **`kanban_*` tools** (9) and the `kanban` skill | agents | list, read, create, update/fill, move, drop, sprint, board, metrics — including the card's write scope |
| **`bin/kanban.mjs`** | the human, scripts, checks | the same verbs from a shell, with distinct exit codes |

## Why

Task state used to live in a hand-authored Markdown table and in whatever each session remembered,
and no surface could be trusted to agree with another: nothing enforced a gate, and nothing recorded
that a move had happened. The figures were the giveaway. An import stamped
`started_at = finished_at = now` on eleven migrated cards, and the generated view advertised

> Throughput 11 in 7 days · Cycle time median 0d · SLE … (history, from 11 finished)

while the event log held two moves. A board that asserts history it does not have is worse than no
board, because the number is read as evidence.

`dsh-kanban` replaces that with one SQLite store below all three surfaces and one policy engine above
it, at `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db`. The gates — Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, WIP limits,
priority and class of service — live in the store; every mutation appends an event. The store is the
only copy: the Markdown mirror and the per-card folder tree it once rendered are gone. The four flow
metrics are recomputed from what happened rather than read off a column.

## Agent Skills

The host half registers the **`kanban`** skill at runtime, so an agent session can work a card without
reading this source: list and read the board, create a card, refine it until the Definition of Ready
is ticked, move it through the gates, comment, block and unblock — and be refused with the names of
the items that are missing. The skill carries the DoR/DoD item names and the rule that a write scope
is data the agent must pass.

## Quick Start

The plugin lives inside the profile it serves, so "install" means *register it and restart the app*.
Either route ends the same way: a `link:` dependency, a bundle row, and a restart.

### Option A — the script

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-kanban
./install.sh            # registers the bundle in the profile and links it
./install.sh --check    # what would change
./install.sh --remove   # unregister
```

### Option B — by hand

1. **Clone it to a stable path** — the path becomes the install path.
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-kanban.git ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-kanban
   ```
2. **`pnpm install`** — this plugin's own toolchain, not the profile's. Its `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
   allows esbuild's build script, which pnpm 11 blocks by default. The `prepare` script runs
   `node build.mjs`, which writes `lib/**` (the host half, the store and the client half) and
   `bin/kanban.mjs` — what `main` and the bundle point at.
3. **Register the dependency *and* the bundle name** in the profile's `package.json`
   (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`):
   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": { "dsh-kanban": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-kanban" },
     "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-kanban"] } }
   }
   ```
4. **Install the profile link, then restart DSH** — `pnpm install` in the profile directory creates
   `node_modules/dsh-kanban`, the symlink the Loader resolves the package name through. A new bundle
   row is a composition change, so **a host-half change needs an app restart**. A client-half change
   needs only a page reload: the Loader picks up a new bundle row by itself, but a module inside a row
   that is already loaded does not reload (T-008).

### Configure

A fresh install needs **nothing**: the board defaults to `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` (its parent is
created on first open), and the Definition of Workflow ships with the guide's limits. The
bundle row is created with an empty `config` on purpose — Cordis validates a row's config before the
plugin activates, and the host half exports no schema to validate against, so it reads every field
defensively and applies its own defaults.

| setting | default | effect |
|---|---|---|
| `dbPath` | `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` | where the board's SQLite file lives |
| `pollMs` | `5000` | the panel's refresh interval while it is visible |

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: kanban
      name: dsh-kanban
      config:
        dbPath: /absolute/path/board.db
        pollMs: 5000
```

A field the patch does not mention keeps the default above, so declare only what you mean to change.

## How it Works

Three surfaces read and write **one** store through **one** policy engine: a rule enforced in the
panel is enforced in the tools and the CLI, because there is only one implementation of it. The board
is `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` (SQLite), and its history is the append-only `events` table — one row
per mutation. It is the only copy: no Markdown view and no folder tree, so never hand-edit it.

A profile plugin **cannot import anything but Node builtins** (`@deepseek-ai/*` does not resolve from
a profile directory). That is why the DSH contracts are vendored in `src/types/dsh.ts`, the store is
our own SQLite, and the browser half talks to the host over this plugin's own HTTP route rather than a
typed Remote. `DESIGN.md` is the full design record and `PRODUCT.md` the product brief.

`/api/kanban` serves `health`, `board` (with `?since=<rev>` → `304`), `task/:id`, and `POST mutate`
with an op. The route is registered as a prefix on the app's own web server, so it wins
the longest-prefix match over the app's `/api` bridge and therefore **does not carry that bridge's
browser-session fence**: a request from this machine is believed, including an
`x-kanban-actor: human`. The server binds loopback only.

That is a deliberate, recorded trade for a single-user local tool. The boundary that matters — an
agent may not set a priority — is enforced at the *tool* boundary, where an agent's identity is its
session and not a header it can choose. A per-launch token is the obvious hardening and is deferred
until the index-injection question for a `file://`-loaded window is answered.

### What it looks like

The board, six lanes and every state reachable, in the app's own two themes. Nothing is styled against
the app: every colour is one of its theme tokens with a literal fallback.

| light | dark |
|---|---|
| ![The board in the light theme](docs/screenshots/board-light.png) | ![The board in the dark theme](docs/screenshots/board-dark.png) |

A card's drawer: one primary move, the rest behind a disclosure, the Definition of Ready as checkable
rows, and the history collapsed until asked for.

| light | dark |
|---|---|
| ![A card's drawer in the light theme](docs/screenshots/drawer-light.png) | ![A card's drawer in the dark theme](docs/screenshots/drawer-dark.png) |

### The flow

A card moves through five states, and two gates decide whether it may. `dropped` is off the workflow —
it is where a card goes when it leaves, and the way back is the drawer's own primary move.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  B[backlog] -->|"DoR complete"| R[ready]
  R --> I[in-progress]
  I --> V[review]
  V -->|"DoD complete"| D[done]
  B -.->|"dropped, with a reason"| X[dropped]
  R -.-> X
  I -.-> X
  V -.-> X
  X -->|"the drawer's move"| B
```

- **Definition of Ready** — outcome, acceptance, write scope, estimate. A card in `backlog` cannot be
  pulled into `ready` until every item is ticked, and the refusal names the ones that are missing.
- **Definition of Done** — evidence, tests, docs, links, and no unverified

plugins.description: DSH 插件市场控制台：在「设置 → 插件」里搜索、安装、启停、卸载第三方插件，全程走官方 plugin-manager 远程接口。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-market-console —— DSH 插件市场控制台

在 DSH 的「**设置 → 插件**」分区里，加一个能**搜索、安装、启停、卸载**第三方插件的标签页。

- 目标客户端：`DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.1`（desktop profile）
- 一个包，两个半边：Host 半边是空的（只为占一条 Loader 行），全部逻辑在 Client 半边
- 所有真实操作都走官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` 的 Typert 远程接口
- 本插件自身**不会**出现在被管理列表或搜索结果里

---

## 1. 目录结构

```
dsh-market-console/
├── package.json          # 声明 dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载声明（自己插入自己）
└── lib/
    ├── index.js          # Host 半边：空 apply()，只为占一条 Loader 行
    └── client.js         # Client 半边：设置标签页 + 全部 UI
```

---

## 2. 安装

### 2.1 解析目标 profile（**绝不写死 `web`**）

```
profile = DSH_DESKTOP_PROFILE  →  DSH_PROFILE  →  web
```

实测：`DSH_PROFILE=desktop`，`DSH_PROFILE_DIR=%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`。

### 2.2 一键脚本（推荐）

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts\install.ps1     # 或者直接双击 scripts\install.cmd
```

脚本按 §2.1 的规则解析 profile，幂等地做完下面三步（重复跑不会重复追加），
并在改动前把 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 备份成 `*.bak-<时间戳>`。

卸载：`scripts\uninstall.cmd`（支持 `-WhatIf` 预览、`-KeepPackage` 只摘挂载）。

> **两个已踩过的环境坑：**
> 1. 本机执行策略禁止直接运行 `.ps1`，所以附带的 `.cmd` 包装器带了
>    `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`，双击即可。
> 2. 脚本文件必须存成**带 BOM 的 UTF-8** —— PowerShell 5.1 对无 BOM 的文件按 ANSI
>    解析，中文注释会直接导致语法错误。而**写出去的数据文件必须无 BOM**，
>    否则 DSH 的 `JSON.parse` 会炸。仓库里的文件两种情况都已处理对。

### 2.3 手工三步

```powershell
$DSH_HOME   = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"
$SRC        = "<本包所在目录>"
$PROFILE    = "desktop"                       # 来自上面的解析

# ① 放进 Node 解析路径（desktop 没有自己的 node_modules，靠父层解析）
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules\dsh-market-console" -Target $SRC

# ② 在 profile 的 dependencies 里登记（满足「实例只认 package.json dependencies」）
#    编辑 $DSH_HOME\profiles\$PROFILE\package.json → dependencies 加：
#      "dsh-market-console": "0.1.0"

# ③ 在 profile 的挂载文件末尾追加 insert 行
#    编辑 $DSH_HOME\profiles\$PROFILE\cordis.patch.yml → 末尾追加：
#      - insert:
#          - id: market-console
#            name: dsh-market-console
```

### 2.4 重启客户端（或者先试只刷新页面）

`cordis.patch.yml` 是启动时读的，所以**刷新页面不够**——但前提是 profile 没启用 HMR。

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` 会监听 profile manifest 和两份用户 patch；启用 HMR 时，
改完 patch 会触发**热重载**：重新组合 Loader 图，浏览器跟随更新，**不需要重启**。

本机实测（0.2.0-rc.1 / desktop）：改完 patch 后未重启，`/plugins` 路由已经能提供
本插件的 bundle，内容与源文件逐字节一致。判断办法（无需认证）：

```powershell
# rev = sha1("plugin-artifact" + "\0" + 各字段长度前缀式拼接) 取前 12 位
# 字段依次是 String(mtimeMs), String(ctimeMs), String(size)
# 命中则 HTTP 200，否则 404
```

**首次安装与卸载仍建议重启**，因为这两个动作还会改动 profile 的 `package.json`。

---

## 3. 两条必须记住的契约（踩过的坑）

### 3.1 `dsh.client.inject` 填的是**包名**，不是 cordis 服务名

`package.json` 里：

```json
"dsh": {
  "client": {
    "platform": "web",
    "inject": [
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules",
      "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings"
    ]
  }
}
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 的 `parseDshClient()` 只校验这是 `string[]`，但组合阶段会把每一项当作**模块图的排序边**（"让动态提供方先于其消费方加载"）。填 `"slots"` / `"locale"` 这类服务名，图里找不到对应 row。

**服务名写在另一个地方** —— Client 半边的 `exports.inject`：

```js
const inject = ['slots', 'locale', 'remote', 'remote.pluginManager', 'modules'];
```

两者同名不同义，别搞混。官方 69 个客户端包的 `dsh.client.inject` 全是包名。

### 3.2 Client 半边的组件 props 来自 `inject` 的**展开**

`ctx.slots.register({ ..., inject: injected }, Component)` 里，`injected()` 的返回值会被
**展开成组件的 props**：

```js
// 官方 ui-settings-plugin-inventory 的写法
function PluginInventorySettingsTab({ list, presetName, resolveText, t, useClientSync, retryClient }) { ... }

// 于是本插件也直接解构
function MarketConsoleTab({ t, data, resolveText, availableRegistries }) { ... }
```

**不要**写成 `function Tab(props) { const x = props.injected() }` —— 那样 `t` 是
`undefined`，`t('...')` 直接抛 TypeError，标签页白屏。

另外 `hooks: { clientSync }` 会被系统转成 `useClientSync` 这样的 **hook prop**；普通字段原样传递。

---

## 4. 功能

### 已安装视图

- 插件条目（`listPlugins`）与组合包（`listBundles`）分组展示
- 每条显示：标题、模块名、版本、描述、启用状态、fiber 阶段（等待/加载/运行中/启动失败/卸载中）
- **插件条目**：开关直接调 `setPluginEnabled(entryId, enabled)`
- **组合包**：开关调 `setBundleEnabled(name, enabled)`；卸载调 `removeBundle(name)`，**二次确认**后才执行
- 本地过滤框（名称 / 模块 / 条目 id）

### 官方标记与筛选

- **「官方」徽章** —— 标题旁边标出 DSH 自带的插件。判定规则（`isOfficialPackage`）：
  - `@deepseek-ai/*` —— DSH 自家发布的包；
  - `cordis:*` —— cordis 框架内置插件，**协议限定名**，磁盘上没有对应目录，只能按前缀认；
  - 第三方（`dsh-whale-widget`、本插件自己）不带徽章。
- **「隐藏官方」开关** —— 已安装视图工具栏里。打开后列表只剩自己装的第三方插件，
  下方给出「已隐藏 N 个官方插件」，分组计数变成 `已显示 / 总数`。
- **偏好持久化** —— 开关状态写进 `localStorage`（`dsh-market-console/prefs`），重开不用再点一次。
- **搜索视图同样带官方徽章，但不受这个开关影响** —— 发现新插件时把官方包一并藏掉没有意义。

### 插件备注

每张卡片（插件条目与组合包）底下都有一条备注行：

- **内置说明** —— **196 条**一句话中文描述，覆盖**全部 loader 条目**（脚本核过零遗漏）：
  - **客户端包**（67 个）逐条人工精简，从各包 `README.zh.md` 的 `description` frontmatter 出发，
    把「面向用户与维护者的 web GUI 客户端模块系统说明：宿主侧组合启动图并提供插件 bundle…」
    压成「客户端模块系统：扫描已启用的插件，把它们的浏览器代码组合起来送进页面。」
  - **host 侧插件**（128 个）批量提取后按规则收紧：剥掉「面向 XXX 的 YYY 说明，用于选择、配置或排查…」
    这类模板腔，只留主干。
  - **cordis 框架内置插件**（`cordis:include` / `cordis:group` / `cordis:timer` / `cordis:loader`）——
    它们是协议限定名，不对应磁盘上的包，只能手写。
  - 外加鲸鱼挂件与本插件自身。
  - 数据是代码里的 `BUILTIN_NOTES`，key 用 Loader 条目的 moduleName。
- **自己改** —— 点「编辑」写自己的备注，保存立即生效，标注为「我的备注」。
- **恢复内置** —— 改过的备注可一键恢复成内置说明。实现上是**直接删键**而不是存空值，
  这样以后内置文案改版还能重新显示出来。
- **存储** —— `localStorage` 的 `dsh-market-console/notes`，纯本机界面偏好：
  不碰插件本身、不碰 profile、不产生任何 Host 侧写入。
- **优先级** —— 用户备注 > 内置说明 > 提示添加。内置文案改版不会覆盖你写的东西。

### 发现视图（npm 搜索）

- 客户端直连 npm registry 的 `/-/v1/search`（该端点返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`，无需 Host 代理）
- 关键词：`keywords:dsh-plugin <你的词>`
- registry 可切换，兜底顺序：`registry.npmjs.org` → `registry.npmmirror.com`，失败自动换下一个
- 400ms 防抖
- 已安装的包标记「已安装」，不显示安装按钮

### 安装链路（M2）

```
inspect(spec)  →  人话化 problem  →  installBundle(spec, { requestId, registry, approvedBuilds })
                →  waitForInstall(requestId)  →  application 处理
```

- `refused` 的 7 种 `problem` 全部映射成中文人话
- `restart-required` 会**显式提示重启**（并说明刷新页面无效）
- 构建脚本待批准（`packageResult.pendingBuilds`）→ 列出准确包名 → 用户确认 → 带 `approvedBuilds` 重试
- 安装中可 `cancelInstall(requestId)`
- 版本门控拒绝时列出不兼容的依赖

### 写操作错误码（12 种）

`management-required` · `unaddressable` · `unknown-plugin` · `invalid-spec` · `ambiguous-install` ·
`not-bundle` · `not-removable` · `stop-profile` · `bundle-in-use` · `stale-approval` ·
`incompatible-version` · `operation-error` —— 全部有中文映射。

---

## 5. 自身排除（C4）

`SELF_PACKAGE = 'dsh-market-console'`，并且下列模块在列表和搜索里都标记为**只读**：

| 类别 | 模块 |
|---|---|
| 自身 | `dsh-market-console` |
| 其他市场 | `dsh-unified-market` · `dsh-plugin-shop` |
| 插件管理基础设施 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` · `dsh-host-plugin-inventory` · `dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` · `dsh-client-ui-settings-plugin` · `dsh-api-remotes` · `dsh-client-modules` |
| DSH 运行底座 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` · `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` · `@deepseek-ai/cordis` |

只读项的开关与卸载按钮是禁用的。判定用**段边界匹配**，所以 `dsh-baseball` 不会被误判成 `dsh-base`。

---

## 6. 故障排查

### 界面里没有「插件市场」标签页

按顺序查：

1. **挂载行在不在**

   ```powershell
   Select-String -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml" -Pattern "market-console"
   ```

   没有 → 补上 §2.2 的第 ③ 步。DSH 大版本更新时可能重写这个文件（鲸鱼插件中过这招）。

2. **包在不在 Node 解析路径上**

   ```powershell
   Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\dsh-market-console\lib\client.js"
   ```

3. **重启了没有** —— `cordis.patch.yml` 只在启动时读取。

4. **看 Host 启动日志**里有没有 `client-modules: ... failed to compose` 或
   `client bundle not found` / `declares dsh.client but exports no "./client" bundle`。

### 标签页出现了但一片空白

多半是 Client 半边抛异常。在 DSH 窗口按 `Ctrl+Shift+I` 打开开发者工具看 Console。
最常见的是 §3.2 的 props 契约问题。

### 装完没反应

`application: 'restart-required'` —— 需要重启客户端。UI 里会明确提示。

### 搜索搜不到东西

registry 不可达。UI 里换 registry，或检查该 registry 是否支持 `/-/v1/search` 端点。

---

## 7. 卸载

1. 从 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 删掉那个 `insert` 块
2. 从 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 删掉 `dsh-market-console`
3. 删掉 `profiles/node_modules/dsh-market-console` 链接
4. 重启客户端

---

## 8. 自检与诊断

`scripts/diagnose.cjs` 一条命令走完「静态安装 → host 运行实例」全链路，逐项给结论和修复建议：

```powershell
node scripts\diagnose.cjs              # 全量
node scripts\diagnose.cjs --offline    # 只做不依赖运行实例的检查
node scripts\diagnose.cjs --url http://127.0.0.1:19387
```

它检查四组内容：

1. **C1 / C3** — profile 按 `DSH_DESKTOP_PROFILE → DSH_PROFILE → DSH_PROFILE_DIR → web` 解析，包在 Node 解析路径上
2. **包清单** — `package.json` 可解析、`dsh.client

plugins.description: A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking: durable message log, attention routing, and cross-workspace membership.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-attention-group

**A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking.**

A durable room for several DSH sessions — plus your own — where a message is written down
first, routed second, and only then allowed to wake anyone. An irrelevant message costs
**zero turns**.

---

## Why this is not another group chat

Every group chat spends its budget at delivery time: it wakes everyone, and each woken
member then discovers the message was not for them. That is N turns for one message nobody
needed.

This plugin moves the decision *before* the wake. Posting a message returns a routing plan

```
routing: SILENT — nobody matched, zero turns spent
```

or

```
routing: 1 recipient(s) — plan only, nothing woken
  room-admin	mention	not-woken (dry run)
```

Waking is a second, explicit step, and it needs **two** switches to agree (see
[Two switches](#waking-is-two-switches)).

Three consequences that are design rules here, not accidents:

- **Creating a room, adding members, reading history, exporting and summarising never wake anybody.**
- **A panel message that names nobody wakes nobody** — only NAMING somebody (`@name`, or `@所有人`
  while the room has 「允许 @所有人」 on) **and** the room's 「唤醒」 switch being on makes the panel
  wake those people. Beyond that, the only panel action that starts a turn is 「生成群史摘要」 (also
  gated on 「唤醒」 — see [Room-history summaries](#room-history-summaries-r9)). No name, no event:
  a person typing in their own panel is not a reason to run somebody else's session.
- **Nothing calls another plugin.** Rooms, transcripts, conclusions and exports are plain
  files, so this works on a bare DSH and survives this plugin being uninstalled.

---

## Quick start

### What you need

- DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (this is the version every interface here was last verified against; it was
  first built against 0.2.0-rc.2, re-verified on 0.2.1-rc.1, and re-checked on 0.2.1-rc.2).
- A profile to install into. The examples below use `--profile desktop`.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group
```

That is the whole install. It was **verified end to end from a clean profile** on 2026-10-17:
the command exits 0, DSH initializes the profile, and the package lands with all seven
source files, its bundle patch and its `cordis.patch.yml`.

The bare-name form `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-attention-group` does **not** resolve
yet, because there is no npm release. Use the `github:` form above.

Any of a directory path, a tarball, or a git URL works, because `dsh plugin` **is** package
management: it delegates to `pnpm` in the profile directory (run `dsh plugin --profile <name>`
with no subcommand and pnpm's own help comes back). What makes the package a *plugin* is that
`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`.

A fresh profile gets **both halves** of the contract written for it automatically — the
dependency *and* the bundle layer — which is what makes the plugin actually load rather than
merely be installed:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

### Offline / from a checkout

Installing by path works too, and a packed tarball is verified end to end:

```bash
npm pack --pack-destination /tmp
dsh plugin --profile some-fresh-name add /tmp/dsh-attention-group-0.1.0.tgz
# → dsh: initialized profile some-fresh-name at ~/.dsh/profiles/some-fresh-name
```

Afterwards the new profile's `package.json` contained **both** halves of the contract on its
own — the dependency *and* the bundle layer:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "file:...tgz" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

and importing the installed copy from inside that profile succeeded, resolving
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` from the shared `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules`. So **a brand-new
profile can load this plugin** — that is what "works on a bare DSH" means here.

**A `link:` dependency and a directory junction both fail** (`unverified` for your machine,
measured here on 2026-10-16). Node resolves imports from a module's *real* path, so a linked
copy outside the profile resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` outside the profile too:

```
attention-group (dsh-attention-group): failed to import
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
```

Installing a real copy inside the profile is what fixes it.

### Verify the install registered

Two places in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` must name the package — a package
that is only in `dependencies` is installed but **is not a profile layer**, and nothing will
happen:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "..." },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-attention-group" ] } }
}
```

### Restart DSH — this step is not optional

Host-side code (`src/index.js` and friends) is loaded once, at startup. Toggling the plugin
in the plugin panel does **not** re-import it; measured here, a newly added tool stayed
`unknown tool` across a toggle and appeared only after a restart. Install, then restart, then
look for the 「群聊」 entry in the sidebar.

### Development loop (source tree → live profile)

Because of the real-path rule above, editing this checkout edits nothing that DSH loads.
`tools/sync-plugin.ps1` copies the package into the profile and then *imports the copy* to
prove it still loads:

```powershell
pwsh -File tools/sync-plugin.ps1
```

### First 60 seconds

1. Sidebar → 「群聊」 → 「＋」 → name the room.
2. Settings → turn 「唤醒」 on only when you actually want group messages to be able to start
   turns.
3. Settings → add a member: **click the id box** and a list of this machine's sessions appears
   (title, workspace, last activity, most recent first) — click one and both the id and the
   `@` name are filled in. Pasting an id (`session-<uuid>` **or** a bare `<uuid>`) still works,
   and any stable id with kind `user` / `admin` / `bot` / `liaison` makes it a name in the room.
4. Ask the agent in that session to call `attention_group_list`, then `attention_send` with
   `wake` left off — you get the plan, and nobody is disturbed.

### Confirm the runtime is healthy

Call the `attention_probe` tool. It reports the data root, how many rooms exist, which live
agents are visible, which optional services this deployment offers, the last five wake-up
attempts with the path each one took, the status of the panel route (`registered`, or the
exact reason it is not), and whether the unread prompt line registered (`promptContext` — a
deployment with no prompt service loses that nudge, and this says so). A missing panel that
reads as "you have no rooms" is the failure this line exists to prevent.

---

## Core concepts

### Room

A room is a record in a JSON ledger plus one append-only JSONL transcript. It has an id
derived from its title (`插件工程协调-fpab`), a title, a charter, a member list, a routing
mode, one group-wide reasoning-effort knob, four sink settings, and a list of outgoing
liaisons.

### Member kinds

| kind | What it is | Can it be woken? |
|---|---|---|
| `session` | A DSH session, identified by its session id. | Yes — live or cold-resumed. |
| `user` | The human. The panel acts as this member. | No — recorded only. |
| `admin` | The room's built-in administrator. «总结今天»-style requests default to the first enabled `admin`. | No — recorded only, unless it is also a session id. |
| `bot` | Any non-session automated participant. | No — recorded only. |
| `liaison` | A reserved kind for an inter-room courier (see [Liaisons](#liaisons-r10)). | No — recorded only. |

**Both session-id shapes are real**: `session-<uuid>` and a bare `<uuid>`. Measured 2026-10-16
against the live runtime, `008bda70-4811-4349-a1a5-d6c6ff54d7d1` is a stored, resumable session
with a resolvable route — and most sessions on the machine this was developed on look like that.
An earlier version of this plugin required the `session-` prefix, which quietly made roughly
seventy real sessions unwakeable; the guard now accepts both.

Only ids that loo

plugins.description: Progressive tool discovery for DeepSeek Harness PTC using the official scoped registry
plugins.readme_text: # PTC Tool Search English | [中文](README.zh.md) Load PTC tool definitions on demand while preserving conversation history. Across 12 live four-turn sessions, the plugin reduced mean cumulative conversation input by **51.46% (GPT)** and **50.00% (Muse)**. Output tokens and latency are reported alongside the reductions. An independent community Host bundle using the official DeepSeek Harness scoped tool registry. Version 0.1.1 supports **Harness 0.2.1-rc.2** and Node.js 24+. ## Repeated live results Measured on 2026-10-18: macOS ARM64, Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, CLIProxyAPI Responses. **3 runs per model per group: 12 new sessions, 48 turns and 12 real image generations.** Identical four-turn prompts cover JSON reading, terminal execution, result writing, tool-free recall, image generation and file readback. A uses the full PTC SDK; B enables this plugin. Values below are means per complete four-turn session. | Model | Input tokens A → B | Input reduction | Output tokens A → B | Active seconds A → B | Workflow completion A / B | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | GPT 6.1 Sol | 153,825.0 → 74,669.7 | **51.46%** | 814.3 → 1,161.0 | 48.01 → 64.44 | 3/3 · 3/3 | | Muse Spark 1.3 | 193,155.3 → 96,569.0 | **50.00%** | 4,173.3 → 3,728.0 | 45.93 → 43.10 | 3/3 · 3/3 | Uncached input increased: GPT 6.1 Sol: 23,521.0 → 31,405.7 (+33.52%); Muse Spark 1.3: 25,761.0 → 31,464.0 (+22.14%). These results do not establish billing savings. Input includes cache reads/writes, searches and retries. Output counts conversation-model tokens; the image service does not expose its own token usage. Active time includes tools and image generation, excluding gaps between user prompts. **Actual charges: not reported**, never treated as zero; no billing reduction is claimed. The initial SDK shrank from **35 definitions to 2**; mean first-request input fell **80.27–80.79%**. Both groups expose only `run_code` at the API level. Discovery adds round trips: mean model requests were GPT 6.1 Sol: 7.0 → 11.7; Muse Spark 1.3: 8.0 → 12.0. Output and latency need not decrease, and the SDK grows as tools accumulate. GPT had no tool errors; Muse A/B had 4/3 recoverable errors respectively, all retried to completion and included. **Image dimensions:** every call requested `1024x1024`, returned GPT 6.1 Sol: 1254×1254 (n=6); Muse Spark 1.3: 1536×1024 (n=6); exact size matches: **0/12**. Workflow success covers tool execution, arithmetic, recall and image artifacts, not requested-size compliance. Compare A/B within each model, not image speed across models. This is a small repeated sample of one fixed workflow. See the [per-run report, method and limitations](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.md) and [auditable data](docs/benchmark-2026-10-18.json) for means, medians and ranges. ## Install Use Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, then enter `github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1`, or use the official CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search#v0.1.1 ``` For an immutable installation, replace `v0.1.1` with the full commit SHA in the [release notes](https://github.com/hrygo/dsh-ptc-tool-search/releases/tag/v0.1.1). The release also provides a tarball and SHA-256 checksum. Download and verify them, then install with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./hrygo-dsh-ptc-tool-search-0.1.1.tgz`. This package ships executable ESM JavaScript: no compilation, dependencies, `prepare` script or build-script permission is needed. Restart Desktop after replacing an installed version, then create a PTC session. Remove a previous local development installation first; only one `tool_search` plugin may be enabled. Distribution follows the official [package and install guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish). This package is not currently published to npm. ## Use New PTC agents initially see `tools.tool_search` plus agent-owned tools. Inside `run_code`: ```js return await tools.tool_search({ query: 'bash', limit: 1 }); ``` End that `run_code`. On the next model request Harness regenerates the SDK with the selected tool; call `tools.bash` in another `run_code`. Print or return the search result once. Prefer exact callable names and `limit:1`; short English capability keywords also work. Search uses deterministic lexical matching, without network calls or embeddings. Selections accumulate for each live agent. Recreated agents, including after restart or resume, discover again. Existing live agents at installation retain their previous surface. Tools registered after agent creation need a new agent to enter its catalog. Standard/native mode is unaffected. Other policy restrictions remain enforced; discovery cannot grant an excluded capability. ## Configuration and rollback The bundle inserts row `ptc-tool-search`. Configure it through Harness plugin configuration: | Key | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | Enable discovery for new PTC agents. | | `maxResults` | `3` | Maximum results accepted by a search call; positive integer. | | `maxQueryChars` | `256` | Maximum query length; positive integer. | | `maxDescriptionChars` | `160` | Search result description length; positive integer. | The selected SDK retains full tool definitions. Search adds a model round trip; broad queries can load unnecessary definitions. As tools are selected, the SDK grows. Disable or uninstall **PTC Tool Search** in Plugin Manager and create a new PTC session to restore full SDK visibility. No app or proxy changes are required. ## Verification ```sh npm test npm run check npm pack --dry-run ``` Nine tests cover ranking, bounds, scope isolation, policy intersection, unload and recreation. Local macOS ARM64 acceptance on 2026-10-18 verified GPT 6.1 Sol and Muse Spark 1.3 over CLIProxyAPI Responses, including terminal calls, follow-up memory and image generation. See [acceptance details](docs/validation.md), including image attachment and file checks. No runtime dependencies, credential handling, install scripts, prompt rewriting or custom persistent session events are added. Harness owns SDK generation, guarded tool dispatch, approvals and logging. ## License [MIT](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: A quieter way to keep moving. State-aware next-instruction drafts for DeepSeek DSH. 下一步，自然发生。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

![Next instruction suggestions. A quieter way to keep moving.](docs/readme/cover.png)

Download · Get started · Under the hood · MIT license

# Next instruction suggestions **The next step, without breaking your flow.** A small, considered plugin for **DeepSeek DSH**. When an assistant finishes a turn, it offers up to three concrete next instructions above the composer. Choose one, refine it, and send it when you are ready. Suggestions are optional. **A click fills your draft; it never sends a message or runs an action.** --- ### Less friction. More intention. | A little help | A clear boundary | | :--- | :--- | | **Relevant next steps** | Uses recent conversation text, open todos, tool outcomes, changed files, and the assistant's open question to propose short, concrete instructions. | | **Your words, your decision** | One click fills the composer and returns focus. Edit before sending. | | **Quiet by design** | Hides as you type, open the command menu, change sessions, or press Escape in the composer. Results arriving after 1.5 seconds are discarded. | | **A lighter model preference** | Auto mode favors names such as `flash`, `mini`, and `lite`. This is a naming heuristic, not a live price comparison. | | **Small, explicit context** | Sends limited text and tool names/targets—not tool outputs—to a provider configured in DSH, with common secret patterns and path usernames redacted. | ![Illustrative suggestion dock and composer with example content.](docs/readme/preview.png)

Illustrative interface with example content. Actual appearance follows your DSH theme.

### A simple rhythm 1. **Finish a turn.** Leave the composer empty after the assistant responds. 2. **Choose a direction.** Pick a suggestion, or dismiss it with `×`. 3. **Make it yours.** Review the draft, edit freely, and send it yourself. The plugin waits for at least two user turns. Thin context or greetings may produce no suggestions. Dismissed suggestions are filtered in page memory, capped at 20 entries per session across 50 tracked browser sessions. ### Why the next step is concrete The host keeps a compact state packet for the completed turn: recent tool calls and results (name, target, success/failure), changed files, running or recent jobs, active goal/plan, open todos, and the assistant's open question. It does not separately load full tool outputs, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. The model is asked for up to five candidates. A local ranker then selects at most three by grounding (a file, test, command, or function named in the state), fit to the assistant's question, a state prior (for example, favor commit after a completed run with changes; favor fixes after a failed action), and intent diversity (change / verify / inspect / ship). This can make suggestions shorter and more specific than a generic "continue". ## Getting started **Requirements:** Node.js **22.19 or later**, DeepSeek DSH **`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`**, a Web GUI or Desktop client, and a configured model provider. The original development baseline was DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; the full range has not been tested against every release. ### Install the release package 1. Open the [latest release](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/releases/latest) and copy the `.tgz` asset URL. 2. In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin / Install third-party plugin** and enter the `.tgz` download URL in the package field. 3. Enable **Next instruction suggestions**, restart DSH, then refresh the client. If your installer does not accept an archive URL, extract the archive and install the inner `package` directory as a local plugin. ### Install from source ```sh git clone https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion.git cd dsh-next-suggestion npm ci --ignore-scripts ``` Add the cloned directory through DSH's local plugin installer, enable the bundle, restart DSH, and refresh the client. A desktop-profile CLI alternative is: ```text dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:\path\to\dsh-next-suggestion" ``` This version is distributed through GitHub Release. These installation methods do not require an npm registry publication. ## Tune the experience Open **Plugins → Next instruction suggestions → Configure**, or **Settings → Next suggestions**. | Setting | Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Enable predictions | On | Turning this off stops new prediction calls. | | Candidates | `3` | Show between one and three suggestions. | | Provider / model | Empty | Auto-select a route, or specify your preferred provider and model. | | Host timeout | `8000 ms` | Bound the host request; the interface still has a 1.5-second display window. | | Debug details | Off | Show token counts, latency, and call count. | Automatic routing prefers models with lightweight names. When it falls back to a reasoning or expensive-looking model, it allows at most one prediction per tracked session. A provider-only setting stays within that provider; a model-only setting resolves that exact model. Choosing both overrides automatic routing. Prediction calls can consume provider credits. ## Context, with limits The plugin may send the session title, up to six open todos, up to six recent user/assistant turns, and a compact state packet (tool names and targets, success/failure, changed file paths, job labels, active goal/plan, and the assistant's open question) to your configured provider. It does **not separately load** tool output bodies, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. Assistant prose is shortened and fenced code blocks are replaced with `[code]`. User messages, shell command text, goals, or todo labels can still contain pasted code or sensitive material. Common API-key/token patterns, bearer strings, long base64 content, and usernames in common home-directory paths are redacted before the request. **Redaction is best effort; it cannot recognize every secret or personal detail.** Review the provider you select and the conversation you use it with. The plugin does not separately read file contents, attachment bodies, or tool-output bodies into its prompt. It adds no analytics endpoint and does not write prediction context to disk. In-memory state is cleared on reload or host restart as appropriate; DSH and your provider have their own storage behavior. ## Built to be understood Two small JavaScript modules, public DSH extension points, and no build step. The host tracks turns and prepares model calls; the client renders suggestions and edits the draft. No core patches are required. - [Architecture and extension points](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [Publishing guide](PUBLISHING.md) - [Host tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/host.test.mjs) · [Client tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/client.test.mjs) ```sh npm ci --ignore-scripts npm test npm pack --dry-run # inspect the prompt of a replay case without spending tokens node scripts/eval-replay.mjs --dry-run ``` The commands above run from a source checkout.
