plugins.description: Automatic same-session continuation, retry with backoff, goal revival, and restart recovery for the DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-autocontinue

A dsh plugin that keeps a session working when nobody is watching: it continues
the conversation on its own, retries through provider and network failures with
backoff, and refuses to let a goal session stall.

**Version 0.1.13** · verified on `dsh 0.2.1-rc.2`.

- [Why](#why)
- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Behaviour](#behaviour)
  - [1. Continuation](#1-continuation)
  - [2. Retry through outages](#2-retry-through-outages)
  - [3. Goal revival](#3-goal-revival)
- [Working with the goal round driver](#working-with-the-goal-round-driver)
- [Visibility](#visibility)
- [Commands](#commands)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Install and update](#install-and-update)
- [Hard-won notes](#hard-won-notes)

## Why

A long unattended run dies in three boring ways: the model stops after one turn
and waits for a human; the uplink drops and the turn ends in `TRANSPORT`; or a
goal quietly loses its activation edge — the round driver disarms a goal on
error, and a session resume or fork deliberately leaves it disarmed. The work is
still perfectly resumable in all three cases. This plugin resumes it.

## What it does

| | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| **Continues** | An armed session's idle agent gets the next round queued for it, instead of waiting for a human to type "continue". |
| **Retries** | A turn that failed on the provider or network is retried forever by default, with exponential backoff that plateaus at a constant 5-minute interval. |
| **Revives** | A goal that stopped being driven — disarmed after a failure, left disarmed by a resume/fork, or paused — is re-armed so the objective keeps moving. |

Nothing runs until a session is **armed** (see [Quick start](#quick-start)).

## Quick start

```sh
# 1. install into a profile (see Install and update for the why-tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-autocontinue-0.1.4.tgz

# 2. arm the current session, from the session itself
/autocontinue on
```

Goal sessions arm themselves (`goalSessions: true`). Profiles that launch
sessions rather than a human — cron, headless, "called in" — set
`enabled: true` and get it for every session in that profile.

## Behaviour

### 1. Continuation

When an armed session's agent goes idle, the plugin queues a round: a normal user
message headed `<autocontinue> Round n/…` that tells the model to keep going, to
treat the workspace and tool results as authoritative, and to end its reply with
the done marker when the assignment is genuinely finished. The transcript reads
as an ordinary conversation.

The loop stops when any of these is true: the model ends a reply with the done
marker (`AUTOCONTINUE: DONE`), a turn is aborted (you hit stop — a human
interrupt is respected), `maxRounds` is reached, or you run `/autocontinue off`.

### 2. Retry through outages

Defaults are tuned for an unreliable uplink — retry **forever**, backing off to a
constant 5-minute interval:

| Consecutive failure | Wait before the retry |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 15 s |
| 2 | 30 s |
| 3 | 60 s |
| 4 | 2 min |
| 5 | 4 min |
| 6+ | **5 min, forever** (unless `maxRetries` is set) |

Each retry round names the exact failure and instructs the model to retry the
action that failed rather than restart completed work. Set `maxRetries` to give
up after N, or leave it at `0` to ride out an outage of any length.

Two implementation facts that matter if you touch this code:

- The retry is driven by `turn/end` with `reason.kind === 'error'` — the turn
  boundary that owns a failed request, carrying the harness's structured
  `LlmFailure` (`TRANSPORT`, `AUTH`, …).
- `agent/error` is deliberately **not** counted. A failed turn emits
  `agent/error` first and then `turn/end` with the same failure; counting both
  burned two retry credits per outage, so `maxRetries: 2` gave up after a single
  real retry. `turn/end` is the only counter.

### 3. Goal revival

A goal stops being driven for reasons unrelated to the objective, and a stalled
goal is worse than a failed turn because nothing retries it:

- the round driver **disarms** a goal on `agent/error`, so one network blip ends
  the goal's own continuation;
- a session **resume or fork** leaves an active goal disarmed by design (the
  driver never revives work on its own);
- the goal can be **paused**.

With `reviveGoals: true` (default), the plugin calls the sanctioned
`ctx.goals.resume(agent, ref)` — which carries no caller-authority gate — and the
goal round driver immediately takes the rounds back, keeping the goal's own
round accounting authoritative.

Deliberately **not** revived:

- **`blocked`** — that is the model, or the goal-tool policy, stating the work
  cannot proceed. Overriding it would fight the harness's own repeated-blocking
  policy.
- A goal whose **round budget is spent** — `resume` would throw; `maxGoalRounds`
  is the goal's decision to make, not this plugin's.

Revivals are capped by `maxGoalRevives` (default 5) so something that keeps
pausing a goal cannot ping-pong with it forever; the counter resets as soon as
the goal actually starts a round. Every revival is announced in the chat.

### 4. Restart recovery

A server swap (the `dsh-update` staged install + reload) or a crash stops the
process while a turn is still open: the persisted log ends inside `turn/start`
with no `turn/end`, and no live agent is left to continue it. On startup this
plugin scans the session corpus, and for every recently-written log that still
ends inside a turn it reopens the session through the same path the Web GUI uses
(`resolveAgent`) and queues a resume round.

That does three things the browser cannot be relied on for:

- the harness appends its synthetic `interrupted` closers, so the old turn is
  balanced instead of looking like a permanently running one;
- the session's agent preset and model selection are recomposed, and the goal
  round driver picks the work back up for a goal session;
- sessions with no browser tab still continue, which is what keeps a switch from
  orphaning work in another workspace.

The resumed session is told exactly what happened so it does not spend a round
working it out: the notice and the resume round name the durable cut
(`turn N, step M`), say the interruption was infrastructure — an update or a
crash — rather than a verdict on the plan, and tell the model not to investigate
it or re-plan from scratch. A goal session gets the same explanation as an
autocontinue notice riding the goal round.

The scan also reconstructs what the dead process owned, because a resumed model
cannot know it from the transcript alone:

- **Pending input.** The harness durably cancels queued inbox messages when the
  process disposes, so a message typed during a turn disappears on restart. The
  scan replays the raw `agent/inbox/spliced` history and re-queues messages
  canceled at that shutdown, deduped against input that is still pending or was
  already admitted (a steer move appears as a cancel plus a re-insert). The
  last handled cancellation seq is persisted per session, so a tab that
  reattaches and appends a fresh `session/end-seed` before the scan cannot hide
  the shutdown cancel behind a new resume marker.
- **Background jobs.** `job/registered` minus `job/settled` from the same
  generation is listed in the resume round. The processes are gone; naming them
  is what lets the model decide what to re-launch.
- **Subagent sessions.** Direct children of the resumed session created in the
  same generation are listed, so their work is not silently orphaned.
- **Active goals.** A session whose latest `goal/change` is `phase: active` with
  rounds left is reopened even when its last turn completed, so the goal round
  driver keeps the objective moving instead of leaving it parked until someone
  opens the workspace. Paused, blocked and complete goals are left alone.

Only logs modified within `resumeWindowMs` are considered, at most `resumeMax`
sessions are resumed per startup, and each session's failure is contained and
logged.

A resume notice looks like:

```
[autocontinue] dsh server restarted mid-run (turn 3, step 12); background jobs
from the old process are gone — c

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）加密全量备份与恢复插件 —— 配置/会话/插件/工作区/Hindsight 记忆打包成加密分卷，带自包含还原器与 GFS 滚动保留，零外部依赖
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vault

**English** · [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

**Encrypted full backup and restore for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**

[![install](https://img.shields.io/badge/install-github%3Asoberkeen%2Fdsh--vault-2ea043.svg)](https://github.com/soberkeen/dsh-vault)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

> Packs **config / sessions / skills / plugins / workspaces / Hindsight memory / the DSH client installer** into
> **encrypted, chunked volumes**, written to a local directory and optionally pushed to a NAS (network share or WebDAV).
> Every package carries a **self-contained restorer** and a recovery ledger inside it, with GFS rotation and optional
> scheduled backups.
>
> **Zero build step · zero external dependencies**: the pure-ESM JavaScript under `lib/` *is* the source and the
> artifact. Only `node:` builtins are used — no 7z, no openssl, no rclone, no npm dependency — so it installs on any
> machine that runs DSH.
>
> Status (2026-10-17): **verified**. Real packages `core` (599 MB) and `full_all` (711 MB) both pass `verify`
> (plaintext hash and per-volume hashes agree) and `restore-drill` (30/30, 31/31). Runs on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, with the
> settings panel, all six tools and the HTTP API exercised in a real injected session. Contract **checked against
> `0.2.1-rc.2`** — see [docs/compat-0.2.1-rc.2.md](./docs/compat-0.2.1-rc.2.md) (9 contracts, 8 unchanged, 1 additive).

---

## 1. Install

### From GitHub (recommended — the only distribution channel right now)

```powershell
# Official DSH CLI — maintains dependencies + lockfile + node_modules + profile bundles
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin add github:soberkeen/dsh-vault

# Pin a profile when you run more than one
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:soberkeen/dsh-vault
```

Then **fully quit DSH and start it again** (not the "restart" button on the crash dialog). A **Backup** entry appears
in the settings sidebar when it worked.

> **npm distribution is on hold.** The package name is reserved as `@lingfengmow/dsh-vault`, but npm's 2FA publishing
> policy (granular-token bypass of 2FA deprecated in 2026-07) and `npm publish`'s web-auth handoff disagree: the browser
> handoff returns 200 and the following PUT still returns 404. Six rounds of controlled experiments ruled out
> permissions, org, package name, token, network and client version. Full evidence chain in
> [docs/RELEASING.md](./docs/RELEASING.md). **Installing from GitHub is equivalent** — `lib/` is plain ESM with no build
> step.

### Local development

```powershell
# Hot injection, no restart (needs dsh-super-injector)
dev_inject_plugin  -dir "<absolute path to this directory>"

# Or write it into the profile (assembled from bundles on restart)
dev_install_package -dir "<absolute path to this directory>" -profile desktop

# Pack a tgz for another machine (no build step; the tgz is the artifact)
npm pack
```

**Requires**: DSH ≥ 0.2.0, Node ≥ 18 (the DSH runtime is enough), pwsh 7 (only for `restore.ps1`).
**Does not require**: 7z / openssl / gpg / rclone / any npm dependency. Docker is used only when backing up Hindsight's
Postgres database (`docker exec … pg_dump`).

### Self-check after installing

```powershell
npm run check                            # syntax gate
node scripts/client-register-test.mjs    # client registration contract, 8 assertions, must be all green
node scripts/health-check.mjs            # 15 runtime checks
```

---

## 2. Six tools (the AI-facing entry points)

| Tool | What it does | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_scan` | Scan and preview by importance tier (P0 must-keep / P1 optional / P2 excluded), **no side effects** | `scope`, `includeP1`, `topExcluded` |
| `vault_backup` | Run an encrypted backup and write it out | `password`, `outDir`, `scope`, `includeP1`, `dryRun` |
| `vault_list` | List historical packages (grouping volumes of one logical package) | `dir` |
| `vault_verify` | Full decrypt plus plaintext/volume hash check (writes nothing) | `package` (required), `password` |
| `vault_restore` | Restore: unpack to `--target`, or restore in place | `package` (required), `password`, `target`, `inPlace`, `only`, `list` |
| `vault_prune` | GFS rotation (dry-run by default, prints the delete list) | `dir`, `apply`, `hardDelete`, `keepLast`, `maxTotalGB` |

> Tool schemas are guarded by `scripts/schema-gate.mjs`: top-level `type:'object'`, `required` a top-level array of
> strings, and **no** boolean `required` inside property nodes. Historically an invalid schema made whole
> DeepSeek/mimo sessions return 400.

---

## 3. Scripts (the command-line entry points, all dependency-free)

```powershell
cd <this directory>

# ── Gates and regressions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
node scripts/schema-gate.mjs      # tool schema gate (must pass before registering; wired into build.sh) → 6 tools + required semantics PASS
node scripts/policy-test.mjs      # GFS retention unit tests (10 cases: minKeep/keepLast/day-week-month buckets/size cap/chain protection/trash) → 10/10
node scripts/boundary-test.mjs    # boundaries and robustness (11 cases: empty dir/zero bytes/20MiB spanning frames/long paths LongLink/Unicode/multi-volume/missing volume/tampering/wrong password/per-file hashes/corrupt header) → 11/11
node scripts/selftest.mjs "G:\DSH-Backup\_selftest"   # end to end (scan→pack→verify→unpack→negative cases) → 12/12

# ── Real runs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --dry                                  # estimate only (strongly recommended first)
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --out "G:\DSH-Backup"                  # core: config+sessions+memory+installer+plugins+orchestration
node scripts/core-drop.mjs --out "G:\DSH-Backup" --scope all      # also include workspaces (02-workspaces)

# ── Verify and drill ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$key = (Get-ChildItem "G:\DSH-Backup\_keys\*.key.txt" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
$pkg = (Get-ChildItem "G:\DSH-Backup\*.vault" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
node scripts/verify-drop.mjs --package $pkg --key-file $key           # verify (password read from the key file)
node scripts/verify-drop.mjs --package $pkg --key-file $key --target D:\vault-check   # also unpack to compare
$pw = (Select-String -Path $key -Pattern '^密码：(.+)$').Matches[0].Groups[1].Value.Trim()
node scripts/restore-drill.mjs --package $pkg --password $pw          # clean-machine restore drill (five-way cross-check, no side effects by default)
```

**Build**: `bash scripts/build.sh` — for a zero-build package this only runs the `node --check` syntax gate, the
schema gate and a required-files existence check.

---

## 4. Password and key policy

| Source | Priority | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `--password <value>` | 1 | Explicit; shows up in the process command line, fine for a one-off local run |
| Env var `DSHVAULT_PASSWORD` (name configurable) | 2 | Suitable for scripts and scheduled jobs |
| Generated automatically | 3 | When `core-drop.mjs` gets no password it generates a **policy-compliant random** one (leading capital + special character + ≥8 chars), prints it once on stdout and **writes it nowhere by default**; pass `--write-key` to persist it to `<out>/_keys/<package>.key.txt` |

- **A key file is a decryption credential**: leaking it means the package can be opened. Move it somewhere safe, or copy
  it down and delete it.
- **A lost password means the package is unrecoverable** (AES-256-GCM, no backdoor, no recovery channel).
- The password is **never** written into the manifest, into documents inside the package, or into logs.

---

## 5. Backup scope and exclusion rules

**Partitions**

| Partition | Contents |
|---|---|
| `00-installer` | The DSH client installer (the prerequisite for restoring onto a bare machine; **exempt from the L4 large-binary rule**) |
| `01-dsh-home` | `$DSH_HOME`: config / s

plugins.description: Per-turn skill audit for DeepSeek Harness plus an in-app skill manager. Fork of dsh-echocat-skill-panel with the composer strip removed.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-useof-skill-panel

> **本仓库是 [`dsh-echocat-skill-panel`](https://github.com/VDERR/dsh-echocat-skill-panel) 的 fork，署名与出处保留。**
> 与原版**同时安装**、互不干扰，功能上唯一的区别是**删掉了输入框上方那条摘要横栏**（`conversation.input.dock`）——
> 组件与注册一并删除，所以那条横栏根本不会被挂载。
> 面板、侧边栏入口、装卸面板、背景/主题、宿主侧全部与原版逐字一致。
>
> 代价只有一个：原横栏是唯一能往输入框里插入 `/技能名` 的位置，所以**一键插入技能名的功能没有了**。
> 要看那条横栏，启用原版（`dsh-echocat-skill-panel@5.1.3`）即可 —— 两个插件可以并存。

**v5.1.4** · DSH Desktop Beta 的 cordis 插件：统计每轮对话用到了哪些 skill，并让你**在应用里直接装卸、更新它们**。

判定不依赖模型自觉 —— 插件从会话事件流推导本轮调了哪些 skill（模型自动、你手动 `/name`、或一个都没用），模型忘了说也照样报。

![面板](docs/panel.png)

两个界面共用一份数据：

| 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **左栏图标** | 常驻入口，点它在中间打开面板（`sidebar.panellist`，order 60） |
| **中栏面板** | 完整报告 + skill 目录（`main`） |

> 与原版的可视差异：本 fork 只注册上面两个座位。原版的第三个座位——输入框上方的摘要横栏——已整体移除。

## 一键安装

把作者给的地址**整个粘进来**就行：

```
https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/main/skills/my-skill
```

仓库主页、仓库里的文件夹链接、`SKILL.md` 链接、zip 直链、`owner/repo`、SSH 地址都认 —— host 自己判断该克隆还是该下载，分支与子目录从地址里解析，不用你填三个框。也可以上传 `.md`/`.zip`，或直接粘贴整篇 `SKILL.md`。

同名不会静默覆盖：先备份再替换。装错了能删，**删掉的进备份目录，永不硬删**。

![安装面板](docs/install-sheet.png)

## 背景自定义（4.4）

面板可以有背景。报告右上角的「背景自定义」打开一张设置面板，**左侧是实时预览**，改一下看一眼，不满意随时取消 —— **预览、取消、恢复默认是三件不同的事**，不会"改了就算数"。

![背景自定义](docs/background-settings.png)

- **四类样式**：液态、柔和渐变、纯色、本地图片；**六套低饱和预设**（柔柔银蓝、珍珠白、紫棠、暖砂灰、深色金属、青瓷）直接挑一个开始。
- **每个滑块都真的作用于背景**：主色 / 辅助色 / 高光色，明暗、亮度、饱和度、对比、金属高光、柔化、遮罩、速度、形变、指针反馈 —— 而**不适用的选项会隐藏**，不是摆在那里让你调了没反应。
- **图片在本机处理**：接受 JPG/PNG/WebP（上限 8 MB），**在本机缩到长边 1920 以内**，支持铺满裁切 / 完整显示 / 拉伸与位置。图片和设置**单独存在客户端数据库里，不上传、不改动 skill 数据、不碰宿主配置**。
- **只影响当前客户端**：设置跨本插件的各个表面共享、刷新后保留，但**不宣称跨设备同步** —— 因为它确实不跨。
- 静态模式下背景**不持续渲染**；隐藏、卸载和系统"减少动态"仍然照常生效。

## 装了之后能更新（4.0）

**问题**：3.0 把地址用一次就丢了（git 克隆还会被删掉）。作者发了修复，你无从判断新旧，只能删了重装 —— 而删除是移动到备份。

**做法**：安装时把来源写进该 skill 自己的 `.echocat.json`：地址、分支、子目录、**安装时的 commit**、以及一份**内容指纹**。于是：

- 卡片上多一行来源。远端有新 commit 时标成「**可更新**」，点两下即替换，**旧版本先进备份**。
- 判断只跑一次 `git ls-remote`，**不重新下载内容**；来源固定在某 commit 上时不会被误报成"有新版"。
- **你手改过这个 skill 的文件**时，确认文案会明说"更新会覆盖它们" —— 这是唯一会丢改动的场景。
- 手工装的、或 2.x/3.0 装的 skill 没有这条记录，卡片上给一个「标记来源」，填一次地址即纳入更新。
- 中文显示名不受影响：更新沿用你为该 skill 设的 `display-name-zh`。

## 界面

- **宽度跟着界面缩放**：面板的宽度由宿主自己的输入框宽度推导（`--dsh-composer-card-max-width` 减 16px），**永远比输入框窄**，并且和输入框共享同一条中轴 —— 宽窗口、窄窗口、嵌入式布局都对。
- **一套完整的设计语言**：四个表面台阶（画布 / 卡片 / 抬升 / 下沉）、一个强调色（靛蓝，只用于主操作、选中和"有东西可做"）、五级字阶（10.5 → 26px，字号越大字距越紧）、三级投影（每级两层低透明度叠加），发丝线用 `color-mix` 从墨色推导。
- **1006 条具名调整**：239 项行为打磨（[polish.js](src/client/polish.js)）+ 767 项设计重做（[design.js](src/client/design.js)），全部是带名字和理由的数据记录，样式表由它们生成，测试逐条核对真的生效。
- **插件自己也能检查更新**：面板头部有一组按钮 —— 「检查更新」问 npm 与 GitHub 谁更新（10 分钟缓存，只有点击才联网），旁边是 GitHub 发布页跳转。查到新版本时按钮带强调色和一个小圆点，头部还会直接写出「可更新 x.y.z」；"查不到"和"已是最新"是两句不同的话。
- **skill 名字一行显示全**：卡片是三行结构（名字行 / 说明 / 按钮行）。名字独占整行并且**会换行、不会被省略号截断** —— 之前它和六个按钮抢一行，长名字只剩几个字符加省略号。
- **每个 skill 一个开关**：停用会把目录**移出 DSH 监视的 skills 目录** —— 模型真的加载不到它，而文件一个不少，随时一键启用回来。已启用与已停用分两组列出，停用的卡片仍可改名、查来源、更新、删除。
- **深浅两套都验过**：深色盘同时挂在系统偏好与**应用内主题**两条信号上；所有文字色都按 WCAG 算过对比度（正文 18.2:1、次级 6.4:1、元数据 5.3:1）。
- `prefers-reduced-motion`、`prefers-reduced-transparency`、窄屏布局各自有覆盖。
- 改界面的做法：`node tools/preview.mjs` 渲染真实面板并截图，加 `--measure` 打印计算样式 —— **先看见，再改**。

> 原版横栏那一行的四个计数器，随横栏一起移除了；计数仍然在面板里。

## 中文显示

中文名写进该 skill 自己的 `meta.yaml`（`display-name-zh`），面板就按中文显示。安装时能填，装完在卡片上随时能改，留空则清除。

`/名字` 手势仍然走 ASCII 代号，两者互不干扰。

## 安装

**GitHub 源码**（拿到的是完整包）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Doctor-Pan-code/dsh-useof-skill-panel.git
cd dsh-useof-skill-panel
npm install            # 只装两个 optional peer，运行时并不需要
```

然后把仓库目录接进你的 profile（`<DSH_HOME>` 默认是 `~/.dsh`）：

```powershell
# 1) 在 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<你的 profile>/package.json 的 dependencies 里加：
#      "dsh-useof-skill-panel": "link:<本仓库的绝对路径>"
# 2) 在同文件的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组里加：
#      "dsh-useof-skill-panel"
# 3) 再 pnpm install 一次
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 已经随包提供，bundles 里声明它就会自动挂载 —— 不需要手写 patch 行。

> 两个 `peerDependencies`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`）标了 `optional`：由 DSH 运行时提供，npm 不会自己去下载一份来顶替宿主的那份。

> **装完必须重启 DSH Desktop Beta。** host 半侧在 boot 时快照进内存，而客户端 bundle 每次开页面会重新拉取 —— 所以只改客户端刷新页面就够，**改了 host 必须重启**。

手动安装的四步、卸载回滚，以及**五条会让应用起不来的硬性约束**都在 [安装说明.md](安装说明.md)。

## 更多

每轮结束弹一次系统原生通知；给没中文的 skill 自动翻译并缓存；深色主题；宿主不允许写入时自动变只读并说明原因；全部配置项 —— 见 [安装说明.md](安装说明.md)。

架构与实现要点、安装引擎的四条安全规矩、**宽度为什么用百分比而不是像素**、**停用为什么是"移出目录"而不是改名**、**1006 条调整为什么是生成的**、**设计重做是怎么"先看见再改"的**、**来源记录为什么放在 skill 目录里**、**版本比较为什么不能拿字符串比**、**为什么"声明进了样式表"不等于"规则能命中元素"**（4.0.1 整页空白 bug 的教训）、**踩过的坑**（宿主语义令牌不能当视觉令牌用、逗号选择器不能共享组合符、`min-height:0` 会架空粘底页脚、CSS 注释里的反引号会截断样式表……）—— 见 [docs/设计要点.md](docs/设计要点.md)。

## 开发

```powershell
node tools/build-client.mjs        # 生成 lib/client.js（改了 src/client/ 就必须跑）
npm test                           # 十四个套件，1520 项断言
node tools/preview.mjs             # 渲染真实面板并截图（浅色 + 深色）
node tools/preview.mjs --measure   # 打印关键元素的计算样式
node tools/check-width-live.mjs    # 真 Chrome 量宽度（改了宽度规则就跑）
```

> `lib/client.js` 是**入库的构建产物**（目标机器没有工具链，`lib/` 必须一起提交）。**改了 `src/client/` 就要在同一个 commit 里重建它**，漏了 `test/client-bundle.mjs` 会在门里失败。

运行时没有任何依赖；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 与 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 是 host 提供的 peer。

## 相对上游的改动

本 fork 与 [`dsh-echocat-skill-panel@5.1.3`](https://github.com/VDERR/dsh-echocat-skill-panel) 的差异**只有一处功能改动**，为了能与原版同时安装，另有一组标识符改名：

| 项 | 上游 | 本 fork |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 座位 | 三个（含输入框上方横栏） | **两个**（`main` + `sidebar.panellist`） |
| 目录 / 包名 / bundle id | `dsh-echocat-skill-panel` | `dsh-useof-skill-panel` |
| loader entry id | `skill-report` | `skill-report-use` |
| 客户端面板 key | `skill-report` | `skill-report-use` |
| HTTP 路由 | `/api/skill-report/*` | `/api/skill-report-use/*` |
| CSS 标记 | `data-plugin="dsh-echocat-skill-panel"` | `data-plugin="dsh-useof-skill-panel"` |
| 状态目录 | `~/.dsh/skill-report/` | `~/.dsh/skill-report-use/` |

**保留上游原样**的两处：写在每个 skill 目录里的来源记录文件名 `.echocat.json`（它是数据格式不是身份标识，改名会让已装用户的历史记录失效），以及 `src/release.js` 里的版本检查地址（仍指向上游的 npm 包与 GitHub 发布页 —— 本 fork 未发布到 npm）。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。Copyright (c) 2026 dsh-skill-report contributors.

# dsh-qwen-mode

会话模式：Qwen 出主意，工具由 DSH 真执行。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a session preset (`Qwen 模式`). The preset is a copy
of the standard preset with only three things changed — id, display name/description,
and order — so its tool list is identical to the standard mode and every tool call still
runs through DSH's own executors, permissions and sandbox.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Requires a provider that exposes the `qoder` models (see `dsh-qoder-provider`). With the
provider in `display` mode the tools would be shadowed by the provider's own copies; this
preset deliberately does not mount those.

## 与标准模式的差别

1. `id` / 名称 / 说明 / `order`：它是一个独立可选的会话模式。
2. 不挂 `qwen-display`（旧「照搬显示」那套影子工具）。drive 模式下工具由 DSH 真执行，
   挂影子工具只会把它们遮蔽成空转。

plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

# dsh-client-ui-notes · DSH 笔记插件

在 DeepSeek Harness 里充当**备忘录 + 目录阅读器**的插件：左侧栏一个「笔记」按钮，
点开后中间主面板切换成阅读器 —— 左边文件夹树 + 置顶区，右边浏览器式 tab 栏，
支持 Markdown 左编辑右实时预览、txt 单栏编辑。

> 纯外部插件：只通过官方 Slot 机制接入，**不改动 DSH 任何源码**。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 左侧栏入口 | 「笔记」按钮排在会话栏上方的全局面板按钮区，默认顺序 30 |
| 浏览器式 tab 栏 | 切换、`×` 关闭、中键关闭、`+` 新建；未保存时显示小圆点 |
| 文件夹树 | 可选任意文件夹作为根，目录懒加载展开，当前文件高亮；根目录按「文件夹 / 根目录文件」分组 |
| 隐藏项过滤 | 不展示 `.` 开头的文件/目录（`.git`、`.obsidian` 等）与 `node_modules`，但不禁止访问 |
| 切换文件夹 | 左侧最上方按钮，调起 DSH 原生目录选择器 |
| 置顶区 | 最多 6 个；1 个占满整行、2 个并排、更多自动往下延伸。有独立分隔线，与文件树分区 |
| 置顶操作 | hover 文件行点右侧图钉，或点已置顶胶囊上的 `×` 取消 |
| 置顶排序 | **按住置顶项拖动即可调整顺序**，拖动时其他项实时让位、并显示落点指示线；顺序与单双栏偏好在重启后保留 |
| 置顶排版 | 「置顶」标题右侧的开关在**双栏 / 单栏**间切换：双栏省纵向空间，单栏文件名更完整 |
| 删除文件 | 文件行右键 → 删除 → 二次确认；移入**系统回收站**可再取回。（Windows 不提供，见「兼容性」） |
| 定位文件 | 文件行右键 → **在访达中打开**（macOS）/ **打开文件所在位置**（Windows）/ 在文件管理器中显示（Linux），由系统打开所在文件夹 |
| 树内定位 | 文件树标题栏的准星按钮：**一键展开当前打开文件所在的所有文件夹并滚过去高亮**，文件夹层级再深也不用一层层点 |
| 树批量折叠 | 标题栏的「打开所有文件夹 / 收起所有文件夹」两个按钮，一次展开或收拢整棵树（超大目录树到 500 个文件夹会提示已截断） |
| 拖拽移动 | 拖文件到文件夹上即移动进去，也可拖回文件树空白处移回根目录；悬停 600ms 自动展开目标文件夹，可拖进多层 |
| Markdown | 左侧编辑、右侧实时预览（用官方 `MarkdownText`，GFM + 代码高亮 + 安全过滤） |
| 显示方式 | 编辑 / 分栏 / **仅预览** 三段切换；仅预览时编辑框完全不渲染，纯阅读更清爽 |
| 同步滚动 | 两侧按比例联动；工具栏可一键关闭，关闭后各自独立滚动 |
| 自适应宽度 | 面板变窄时自动收起文件夹栏、改为上下堆叠，避免内容被挤成一列字 |
| 层级分明 | 文件夹栏是内缩的圆角区块；macOS 折叠会话栏后，**只有左栏**额外下移让开交通灯，右侧阅读区（tab 栏 + 正文）保持不动，避免顶部露出空白带 |
| 纯文本 | txt 单栏直接编辑，不显示无意义的预览栏 |
| 新建 | 先选类型（Markdown / 纯文本），再填文件名；自动补扩展名 |
| 手动保存 | `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` 或保存按钮；未保存时 tab 有圆点、文档头显示「未保存」 |
| 状态记忆 | tab、当前 tab、置顶、展开的目录、滚动位置、未保存草稿都会保留 |
| 标签页管理 | tab 上右键可「关闭 / 关闭其他 / 关闭右侧标签页 / 关闭全部」；中键关闭 |
| 标签溢出 | 标签多到放不下时，栏右端出现向下尖头，点开下拉列出全部标签（含被裁掉的），当前项高亮 |
| 文件可见范围 | 文件树标题行有「可编辑 / 全部」开关（偏好持久化）。「可编辑」只列能在阅读器里打开的文件；「全部」连 `.doc`/`.pdf` 一起列出 |
| 打开方式 | 点这类不可预览的文件**不会直接弹出系统程序**，而是在阅读区开一个标签页：显示「此格式无法在阅读器中打开」+ 一个**打开方式**控件。左边按钮用默认应用打开，右边下拉列出系统里所有能打开它的应用，底部另有「显示文件位置」 |

## 安装

> **前置条件：本插件是图形界面插件**，只在 **Web GUI** 里有界面 —— 包括桌面应用，
> 以及终端里自己跑起来的 `dsh web`（浏览器访问）。
> 纯终端场景（`dsh headless "..."`、SDK、ACP）装了不会报错，但也**没有任何功能可用**：
> 界面所依赖的槽位与 `webServer` 服务都由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 提供。

**桌面应用目前只发布 macOS 与 Windows 版，没有 Linux 版。** Linux 用户需要自行安装
DSH CLI，再用 `dsh web` 在浏览器里使用（功能与桌面版一致）。

### 桌面应用（macOS / Windows）

在左侧栏打开**「插件」面板** → 点**「添加插件」** → 填入包名 `dsh-client-ui-notes` → 安装。

> 注意不是「设置 → 内置插件」那一页 —— 那页只用于**查看**本部署内置了哪些插件，不能安装。

### 终端 / 自建 profile（任意平台，含 Linux）

先建一个带 Web 界面的 profile，再把插件装进去：

```sh
# 1. 以 web 模板创建 profile（--dump-config 让它只建不启动，配置输出丢弃即可）
dsh --profile notes --from-default-profile web --dump-config > /dev/null

# 2. 把插件装进该 profile
dsh plugin --profile notes add dsh-client-ui-notes

# 3. 启动，然后在浏览器里打开它打印的地址
dsh --profile notes web
```

左侧栏出现「笔记」图标即为安装成功。

> ⚠️ **不要跳过第 1 步。** 直接 `dsh plugin add` 会让 DSH 自动创建一个以
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 为基础的 profile，而 **base 里没有 Web 界面层**
> （`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`）。那样的 profile 启动 `web` 时界面出不来，
> 插件自然也无从显示。
>
> ⚠️ 也不能用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 去装桌面应用的 profile：
> 那个 profile 归应用独占管理，命令行写入会被拒绝
> （`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。
> 桌面版请用上面的「插件」面板。

想确认插件层已登记，可以看合并后的配置：

```sh
dsh --profile notes --dump-config | grep -A2 dsh-client-ui-notes
# # == dsh-client-ui-notes
# - id: ui-notes
#   name: dsh-client-ui-notes
```

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile notes remove dsh-client-ui-notes
```

### 首次使用

插件初始没有任何笔记目录，需要两步：

1. 点左上角的**文件夹按钮**选一个目录作为笔记根目录；
2. 右侧文件树标题行的可见范围开关默认是「**可编辑**」（只列 `.md`/`.txt` 等能在阅读器里打开的文件）。
   想看 `.doc`/`.pdf` 这类文件就切到「**全部**」。

### 开发者方式（本地改动 + 热链接）

```sh
# 1. 构建
cd ~/dsh-notes-plugin
npm install          # 首次
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json
node scripts/build-client.mjs

# 2. 链接进目标 profile（以 desktop 为例）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
ln -sfn ~/dsh-notes-plugin node_modules/dsh-client-ui-notes
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 里登记：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-client-ui-notes": "link:/Users/你/dsh-notes-plugin" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-client-ui-notes" ] } }
}
```

重启 DSH 后，左侧栏出现「笔记」按钮。

> 用 `link:` 装的插件，**改了 `lib/` 下的产物必须重启 DSH** 才会生效：客户端产物是启动时
> 读取并缓存的，磁盘文件变化不会自动重载。

## 更新

三条路都能升级，效果一样：

| 方式 | 怎么用 |
|---|---|
| 插件详情页的「更新」 | 侧栏「插件」→ 点本插件卡片 → 顶部按钮。发现新版本后点一下即升（**0.1.7 起才真正可用**） |
| 插件市场 | 市场里搜到本插件后点「更新」 |
| 命令行 | `dsh plugin --profile <名字> add dsh-client-ui-notes@latest` |

每个版本改了什么见 [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md)。

> **从 0.1.6 及更早升上来时，详情页的「更新」按钮必然失败**：带 HMR 的宿主会在跑
> pnpm 之前就以 `already-installed` 拒绝「覆盖安装自己」，而旧版本正是这么做的。
> 需要**手动升级一次**（市场或插件页装到 0.1.7+），之后这个按钮才通。
>
> 手动升级若被 pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge`（新版本观察期）拦下，用**插件市场**装：
> 它会自动往 profile 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` 追加放行规则，失败还会带
> `--config.minimum-release-age=0` 重试一次；插件页那条路没有这两个兜底。

## 工程结构

```
src/
  index.ts              Host 半边：文件读写路由 + 信任围栏
  client/
    index.tsx           插件入口：注册左侧栏按钮与主面板
    NotesPanel.tsx      面板 UI：树、置顶、tab 栏、编辑器
    store.ts            状态仓库 + localStorage 持久化（记忆功能）
    api.ts              Host 路由的浏览器端客户端
    styles.ts           样式（全部走 DSH 主题 token）
scripts/
  build-client.mjs      客户端 bundle 打包
cordis.patch.yml        profile 补丁：把插件插入插件名册
```

## 安全设计

Host 半边注册的路由能真实读写磁盘，因此：

- **信任围栏**：只接受 loopback 来源（校验 socket 地址 + Host 头 + 浏览器同源标记），
  拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`，防 CSRF。
- **根目录约束**：每个请求都要带 `root`（用户显式选中的文件夹），目标路径必须落在
  root 之内，`../` 穿越与相对路径一律拒绝。
- **原子写**：先写同目录临时文件再 `rename`，不会出现半个文件。
- **删除可恢复**：删除优先移入**系统回收站**（macOS `~/.Trash`、Linux XDG 回收站），
  用户在文件管理器里能直接找回；系统回收站不可用时（如 Windows）回退到笔记根目录下的
  `dsh-notes-trash/`，该目录在文件树里可见，同样能取回。任何情况下都不是真删。
- **只允许 md/txt 新建**，文件名里禁止路径分隔符。

## 兼容性

### 操作系统

**怎么跑起一个有界面的 DSH** 各平台不同：

| | macOS | Windows | Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| 桌面应用 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ 官方未发布 |
| 自建 `dsh web` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 插件运行环境 | 两者皆可 | 两者皆可 | 只能自建 |

插件功能各平台的差异：

| 能力 | macOS | Windows | Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| 阅读器功能（树、标签页、编辑、预览、置顶、拖拽） | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 「打开方式」控件 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **删除文件** | 系统「废纸篓」 | ❌ **不提供**（见下） | XDG 回收站 |
| 顶部避让窗口控件 | 生效 | 不触发（无此需求） | 不触发 |

**为什么 Windows 上没有删除**：Windows 没有可移植的用户态回收站路径 —— 真正的回收站只能
通过 `SHFileOperation` 或 PowerShell 的 `Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem` 写入，
而后者官方注明「非用户交互的应用程序不支持 `recycle` 参数」。做不到「可还原的删除」，
本插件就**不显示删除入口**（右键菜单里没有这一项，直接调接口也会被 403 拒绝）。

这是刻意的取舍：删除的本意是清理文件，若只是把文件挪进一个自建目录，既没清掉、又让用户
以为还能从系统回收站找回，反而更容易误判。其余平台删除进**系统回收站**，可正常还原。

> 补充：macOS / Linux 上若系统回收站本身写不进去（跨分区、权限不足等），会回退到笔记根目录下的
> `dsh-notes-trash/`。该目录**不以点开头**，因此在文件树里可见、可点开、可取回 ——
> 带点的目录会被文件树隐藏，那样用户就找不回误删的文件了。

### DSH 版本与依赖

- 目标 DSH：`>=0.2.0-rc.1`
- **零三方运行时依赖**：客户端 bundle 实际只 `require` 三个平台基线模块
  （`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`），
  宿主侧只用 Node 内置模块。打包脚本维护一份平台模块白名单
  （`react` / `react-dom` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis` / `dsh-client-store` /
  `dsh-client-ui-primitives` / `dsh-client-ui-slots`），**表外的模块一律不能用**，
  越界会在构建期直接报错。
- 所有槽位注册都包在 `ctx.slots.inject()` 里：**即使 DSH 未来删掉某个席位，
  插件也只是不显示，不会让启动失败。**
- 客户端 `inject` 里**必须显式声明 `remote.session`**。DSH 把每个 Remote 命名空间
  注册成独立的 cordis 服务（服务名就是 `remote.` + 命名空间名），而 cordis 的服务
  可见性按 fiber 隔离 —— 只声明 `remote` 是读不到 `remote.session` 的，会抛
  `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject`。官方 `ui-open-in-app`
  同样如此声明。

## 更多文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [DEVELOPMENT.md](./DEVELOPMENT.md) | 开发笔记：实现过程中踩到并修复的坑（贡献者向） |
| [VERIFICATION.md](./VERIFICATION.md) | 验证记录：各项功能在真实环境中的实测结果 |

plugins.description: Independent ChatGPT subscription provider for DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC). Native model and reasoning selection, tools, and no core patches.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-openai-oauth

**Use your ChatGPT subscription in DeepSeek Harness Desktop through official Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC).**

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

[![Verify](https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth/actions/workflows/verify.yml)

Independent community plugin; not affiliated with OpenAI or DeepSeek. This is **not** the legacy fixed-client Codex OAuth/backend-api integration.

## Features

- Continue with ChatGPT, dynamic Agent registration, persistent host identity, and verified ID Tokens.
- Account-specific models and reasoning levels in **DSH's existing model selector**.
- Public Responses streaming, local function tools, tool results, and compatible history replay.
- Multiple saved account/workspace registrations, explicit account selection, rotating refresh, and scoped sign-out.
- Keeps DeepSeek Account, API-key providers, other sources, and existing sessions independent. No silent billing fallback.
- Stable account/session-scoped Responses affinity for cache reuse, without sending raw session identifiers.
- No Codex CLI, API key, patched ASAR, or replacement pi-ai installation.

## Compatibility

Validated Desktop releases: **0.2.1-rc.2, 0.2.1-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2**. Development/install helpers require Node.js **24+**.

Forward-eligible range: `0.2.0-rc.2 || >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`. Later 0.2.x releases are **candidates, not validated releases**: installation and direct-update startup require isolated native checks before real-account activation. Next-minor prereleases/final, mixed components and failed contracts are rejected. See [forward compatibility](docs/forward-compatibility.md).

| Environment                                      | Status                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2                       | Native suites pass; initial UI recovery confirmed; hardened-startup recheck pending            |
| Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.1 (0.2.0-rc.2 baseline) | Previously validated native suites and desktop source/account/selection                        |
| macOS Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.1            | Native and real desktop validation pending for these releases; 0.2.0-rc.2 native suites passed |
| Windows/macOS/Linux Node CI                      | Protocol/package tests only; not proof of desktop login or inference                           |
| Older DSH, remote/headless Hosts, Linux Desktop  | Not currently claimed supported                                                                |

See [compatibility and verification](docs/compatibility.md). Do not bypass compatibility contracts or upgrade bundled framework dependencies to force compatibility.

## Install from source

No npm publication is required or currently promised.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth.git
cd dsh-openai-oauth
npm ci
npm test
npm run check
npm run test:package
npm run doctor
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop add -w .
```

The `dsh` helper discovers the installed desktop executable and invokes its own bundled CLI; it does not install another Host. Use `DSH_APP` for a nonstandard installation. See [installation](docs/install.md) for Windows PowerShell and macOS examples.

Only restart DSH after running tasks have finished. A window close may hide the application to the tray; use its normal Quit action.

### Use a reviewed archive

```sh
npm run pack
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop add ./artifacts/pyh-pan-dsh-openai-oauth-0.3.2.tgz
```

Do not keep the old private bundle and this bundle enabled simultaneously: they deliberately preserve the same provider/credential identity. See [migration](docs/migration.md).

## Sign in and use

1. Open **Settings → Models → ChatGPT subscription**.
2. Click **Continue with ChatGPT**, then open the official authorization link in your browser.
3. Name/approve the Agent on OpenAI's page. Finish authentication yourself; never copy tokens from another client.
4. Read the first-use notice and select **Use this account**. Signing in alone does not switch your conversation's model.
5. Select **ChatGPT Subscription** in the existing model picker. Its **Reasoning level** submenu shows only choices advertised by that model.
6. Use **Manage usage** to review the Agent, quota, limits, and access at [ChatGPT Settings → Usage](https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage).

Accounts without the granted direct-inference scope remain signed in but disabled for inference. Explicitly enable subscription inference to request consent again. Reauthorization reuses the registration; adding a different account is a separate action.

## Limits and security

- Models, reasoning choices and quota are account/server dependent, not an unlimited or universal model entitlement.
- Currently advertises **text input** and client function tools. Direct image/file upload and hosted MCP/tool-search are not implemented.
- The current SIWC preview does not accept some ordinary API parameters. Explicit `maxTokens`/`temperature` settings are rejected, not silently ignored; clear them before using this source.
- Subscription failures never switch to an API-key/balance provider.
- Tokens stay in the native Host credentials service, not browser storage or ordinary plugin settings. Native local storage is not a promise of OS-keychain encryption.
- Sign-out attempts remote revocation and clears this account's local tokens, retaining its registration. Unconfirmed remote revocation is reported; review access in ChatGPT settings.
- Read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), [protocol design](docs/protocol.md), and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Development

```sh
npm ci
npm test
npm run check
npm run test:package
npm run test:native
npm run test:race
```

Pure tests use generated identities and mock upstreams. Native tests use an installed DSH and **temporary** credentials; they do not read your grant or spend inference quota. Real-account desktop validation is separately documented and always user-controlled.

Source is published directly as ESM; no generated `lib/` or vendor snapshot is necessary. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Update / remove

If both the source and authorization settings disappear after a DSH upgrade, check [version compatibility troubleshooting](docs/install.md#missing-source-and-authorization-settings-after-a-dsh-upgrade) before signing in again. An incompatible bundle is skipped before its code runs.

For a linked checkout, review/pull changes, run checks, then restart DSH safely. For an archive, install the reviewed replacement using the native plugin command. To remove:

```sh
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop remove @pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth
```

Removal preserves stored credentials. If you want to disconnect this Agent, sign out or manage access in ChatGPT settings first; do not delete the entire DSH profile.

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: One DSH composer plugin: direct model picker, draggable reasoning-effort rail, and a DeepSeek account hider. DSH 输入框三合一插件：模型选择 + 拖动强度条 + 隐藏 DeepSeek 账号
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-composer-plus

One plugin, three things: model picker + draggable reasoning-effort rail + DeepSeek account hider.

中文 | English

## What it is `dsh-composer-plus` is a pure front-end plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) **web client**. It folds the composer's right-hand controls into one pill: | Feature | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Model picker** | Click the model name to get a provider-grouped list (no submenu). A pick applies immediately. | | **Effort rail (drag bar)** | A notched slider: click, drag, or use `←`/`→`/`Home`/`End`. Levels come from each model's own `reasoningEfforts`; the top level gets a gradient sweep and halo. | | **Hide DeepSeek account** | The bundle patch disables the official account entry (sidebar account menu, account settings page, credential onboarding), and the custom model menu filters the `deepseek-account` channel. | | **Theme-aware** | Every color binds to `--dsw-alias-*` theme variables, so light/dark and third-party skins stay readable. | | **Zero intrusion** | A modular bundle: no core changes, nothing written outside the profile, clean removal. |

## Compatibility - dsh **0.1.5+** (the `ctx.modelDirectories` / `session/selectModel` generation) and a **web client** (`dsh web`, or the web UI inside the desktop app). - End-to-end tested on dsh **0.1.7-rc.2**: model switching, drag + keyboard effort changes, light/dark themes, no account entry in Settings. - The rail only appears for models that declare reasoning levels; other models show the picker alone. - The plugin draws into the composer's `conversation.input.right` seat and tucks the native model trigger away. If a future dsh changes the composer DOM and the native trigger is not hidden, please open an issue. ## Install ### Web profile (`dsh web`) ```sh # straight from GitHub — no npm account needed dsh plugin --profile web add github:WuweiRE/dsh-composer-plus ``` Or clone and install the local directory: ```sh git clone https://github.com/WuweiRE/dsh-composer-plus.git dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-composer-plus ``` Restart `dsh web` (or `dsh --profile web`) once and refresh the page. Later client-only updates usually need just a refresh. ### Desktop app The desktop profile is managed by the Electron app (`dsh plugin --profile desktop` is refused). Install this bundle from the app's **Plugins** page (GitHub repo or a local directory), then restart the app. If your build has no such entry, validate on a web profile first and point the app at that profile. > The plugin participates in profile composition, so install/remove needs one app restart; CSS/client-only changes only need a refresh. ## Configuration Both switches are on by default and live in the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: ui-composer-plus name: dsh-composer-plus config: hideAccount: true # account menu / account settings page / credential onboarding + leftover rows hideAccountModels: true # filter the deepseek-account channel from the custom model menu ``` To bring the official account UI back, override the row in **your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`** and delete these two patches, which are what actually close the account page: ```yaml - id: ui-settings-account disabled: true - id: ui-settings-models name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models' config: credentialOnboarding: false ``` ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-composer-plus ``` Then restart `dsh web` / the app. The plugin stores no runtime data; the last selected effort stays in dsh's own session state. ## Layout ```text dsh-composer-plus/ ├─ package.json # bundle + web client manifest (immediately / inject) ├─ cordis.patch.yml # account hider patches + plugin row ├─ lib/index.js # host half: publishes options as window.__DSH_COMPOSER_PLUS__ ├─ lib/client.js # browser half: pill, model menu, rail, account-row hider ├─ locale/{zh,en}.json # plugin-manager title/description ├─ icon.svg # plugin icon └─ docs/*.png # README screenshots ``` There is no build step: `lib/client.js` is a browser-executed `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` factory and React comes from the dsh module table. ## Known limits - Account hiding is **patch-layer disable + client-side fallback**: another plugin that re-adds account UI can override it; disable that plugin first. - The account-model filter only affects this plugin's menu; the native `/model` popup is still dsh's (use it to pick an account model temporarily). - Web client only; headless/TUI profiles never render the composer. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE). Third-party credits: [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

# dsh-plugin-resolver **让 agent 自己把 DSH 插件装明白。** 搜索 → 同名消歧 → 按当前内核选兼容版本 → 安装（registry 或 GitHub 源码构建）→ 装后校验，一次调用走完。 [![test](https://github.com/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![ablation](https://github.com/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver/actions/workflows/ablation.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver/actions/workflows/ablation.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-resolver?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-resolver) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver)](LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](package.json) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2%2B-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-35%20checks%20passing-brightgreen)](test) [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver?style=social)](https://github.com/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver/stargazers) > **装两个典型插件：工具操作 −87%（45 → 6 次），实际耗时 −80%（20+ 分钟 → 约 3 分钟），失败重试 0。** > > 基线是"同一个 agent、没装 resolver 时的手工流程"，不是官方 Discover 的点击次数——对点 UI 的人，市场已经够好；这个插件服务的是**把安装交给 agent 的人**。 > > 搜索 → 同名消歧 → 按当前内核选兼容版本 → 安装（registry / GitHub 源码构建）→ 装后校验，一次调用走完。 > host-only 插件，给 DSH 加 4 个模型工具，不注册服务、没有前端、纯 ESM 免构建。 --- ## 为什么要它 **场景**：给一台 DSH 装两个真实插件——`dsh-better-sidebar`（npm 上的 latest 不保证兼容当前内核）和 `dsh-browser`（6 个同名 owner、GitHub-only、还要本地构建扩展）。当时在 agent 侧，这是这样一串手工活： | 实际会发生的事 | 代价（真机实测，agent 手工路径） | |---|---| | 目录在 GitHub Pages 上，拉一次 6.4 MB | **91 s**，模型还得读一堆条目 | | 同一个名字有多个 owner（`dsh-browser` 有 6 个） | 靠猜，猜错就装错来源 | | `latest` 未必兼容当前内核（peer 线或 `engines.dsh` 可能高于宿主） | 装上后启动预检把它静默禁用 | | 直连 npmjs 慢 | 两次 **90 s 超时**，换镜像后 13.4 s | | GitHub-only 仓库不提交构建产物 | `dsh plugin add github:…` 装了个 `main` 指向不存在文件的包 | | 装完不知道有没有生效 | 需要另找手段回读 loader entry / 前端 boot 表 | 这个插件的存在意义：把上面这些**判断与验证**固化一次，之后每次只需一次工具调用。 ## 怎么工作 ```mermaid flowchart LR Q["“装 xxx 插件”"] --> S["plugin_search
目录检索 / 同名消歧"] S --> R["plugin_resolve
读取宿主版本
peer + engines 求解"] R --> C{有兼容版本?} C -- 否 --> X["列出拒绝原因
（需要 DSH 几）"] C -- 是 --> V["选最高兼容版本"] V --> K{npm 发布?} K -- 是 --> I["installBundle
最快 registry"] K -- 否 --> B["检出源码
pnpm install + build
link: 注册"] I --> H["回读 loader entry
bundle / client 半"] B --> H H --> O["如实告知：刷新 / 重启 / 已生效"] ``` ## 先装一次，之后都能一句话 第一次仍需把 resolver 装进来（约 10 秒）；从下一次安装开始，用户只需要说"帮我装 xxx"。 - 官方版：`插件 → 实验性插件 → 打开自定义插件市场 → 发现 → 添加索引源`（URL 见下），安装 `dsh-plugin-resolver`； - 或者 CLI（profile 名以你的 DSH 安装为准）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-resolver ``` 装完重启一次宿主；之后： > "帮我装 dsh-browser" → 列出 6 个同名候选，要求 `owner=`，不猜； > "装 dsh-builtin-browser" → 选到与你内核兼容的版本并装好。 明确的包直接装；歧义名、GitHub 源码、未知来源会先给出解析计划。它不是插件市场的替代品，而是"把安装交给 agent"的那条路径。 ## 三种安装方式（任选） 要求 **DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`**（已在 `engines.dsh` 声明）。纯 JS、无构建、无 install 脚本，三种方式都不需要 `allowBuilds` 授权： ```sh # npm（已发布 0.1.2；profile 名以你的 DSH 安装为准） dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-resolver # GitHub 源码安装（建议锁 commit） dsh plugin --profile add github:sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver# # tarball npm pack && dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-plugin-resolver-0.1.2.tgz ``` 插件市场（Discover）索引（在插件页打开实验性「自定义插件市场」，然后 `插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源`）： ```text https://sakikoTGW.github.io/dsh-plugin-resolver/market/index.json ``` 真实调用长这样： ```text $ plugin_resolve dsh-builtin-browser target kind: npm running DSH: 0.2.1-rc.2 package: dsh-builtin-browser@0.4.13 install spec: dsh-builtin-browser@0.4.13 registry: https://registry.npmmirror.com/ notes: - newest published version whose DSH peer range accepts the running host ``` ```text $ plugin_resolve dsh-better-sidebar package: dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0 install spec: dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0 ``` ## 四个工具 | 工具 | 作用 | 是否改动环境 | |---|---|---| | `plugin_search` | 搜社区目录（npm 载体优先），排序并显式标出同名歧义 | 只读 | | `plugin_resolve` | 只解析不装：目录条目、兼容版本、registry、是否需要源码构建 | 只读 | | `plugin_install` | 完整安装：选版本 → 安装/构建 → 回读校验 → 下一步提示 | 写 profile | | `plugin_status` | 已装 bundle / loader entry / fiberPhase 盘点 | 只读 | ## 版本选择规则 1. 运行时版本 = `pluginManager.listBundles()` 里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 的版本； 2. 逐版本从高到低检查：非可选 **`@deepseek-ai/dsh*`** peer 必须满足运行时版本；声明了 **`engines.dsh`** 也要满足； 3. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 等**同命名空间但不同版本线**的库**不算**运行时约束（这条曾把 4/8 个包误判成"无兼容版本"，见 [ABLATION](ABLATION.md)）； 4. 取第一个通过者；全不通过时列出最近版本的拒绝原因；用户显式给 `version` 时跳过求解。 ## 安装路径 - **registry 包**：`pluginManager.installBundle(name@resolved, { registry })`，profile/lockfile/激活生命周期都交给插件管理器； - **GitHub-only**：检出到 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-sources/__`，缺构建产物且声明了 `build` 时执行 `pnpm install` + `pnpm run build`，随后 `installBundle('link:')`，已构建的检出直接复用； - **显式 spec**（`github:` / `link:` / `file:` / `https:`）：原样交给插件管理器。 ## 重启判定 `plugin_install` 不再无条件要求重启；安装前后会比较： - `pluginManager.listBundles()` 的 bundle 集合 - 已安装包运行时文件的 hash（排除 README / docs / 版本号） 结果： - 无变化 / 仅版本号变化 / 管理器已就地应用 → `restart: not required` - bundle 新增、运行时代码变化、client 半变化 → `restart: required — <原因>` 本插件自身的 `logic/` 改动可以按 mtime 热加载，不需要重启；新增 bundle 或宿主壳变化仍然必须重启。 ## 结构：稳定壳 + 可热加载逻辑 ``` index.js 宿主入口（稳定） host/register.js 工具 schema + pluginManager 桥接（稳定，改动需重启） logic/ 目录 / 版本 / 兼容 / 安装编排（每次调用按 mtime 重新 import） ``` `host/register.js` 每次调用计算 `logic/` 下最大 mtime，以 `import('./logic/api.js?v=')` 导入；逻辑模块之间用同一 `?v=` 传递依赖。Node 的 ESM 缓存按完整 URL 计，因此： - **改 `logic/` 任何文件 → 下一次工具调用立即生效，不用重启宿主** - 只有改动工具定义层（`index.js` / `host/register.js`）才需要重启 这是为无 HMR 的打包运行环境设计的：宿主拿不到真 HMR 所需的 Node 内部模块加载器，但"重新 import 一个带新 query 的模块"完全可行。 ## 效果 | 指标 | agent 手工路径（未装 resolver） | 本插件 | 来源 | |---|---|---|---| | 工具调用（装 1 歧义 + 1 GitHub-only 插件） | ≈ 45 次 | **≈ 6 次** | [BENCHMARK](BENCHMARK.md) | | 决策链耗时 | — | **1.05 s / 9 个决策任务** | benchmark.mjs（官方 0.2.1-rc.2） | | 目录获取 | 91.06 s / 6.4 MB | **0.86 s / 2 请求** | benchmark.mjs（官方 0.2.1-rc.2） | | 安装失败重试 | 2 次 90 s 超时 | **0 次** | 会话日志 | | 安装后校验调用 | 2 次额外探测 | **0 次** | benchmark.mjs | > 基线是 **agent 手工流程**，不是官方 Discover 的点击次数：对点 UI 的人市场已经够用，这个插件服务的是把安装交给 agent 的人。 消融测试（逐项拆能力）见 [ABLATION.md](ABLATION.md)：同名 287 组、naive 会选错 51 组；8 个真实包中 2 个 latest 不兼容；镜像元数据延迟比 59.6–78.8×（随线路波动）；GitHub-only 入口探针 404；静默失败可检测；逻辑热加载 2 ms vs 重启 30–40 s。 ```sh node test/benchmark.mjs # 插件路径基准 node test/ablation.mjs # 消融测试（无副作用） ``` ## 测试与 CI ```sh npm test # = selftest(25) + harness(10) npm run bench # 基准 npm run ablate # 消融 ``` - `test/selftest.mjs`：semver 子集、版本选择、spec 解析、目录检索（离线） - `test/harness.mjs`：假 Cordis ctx + 假 pluginManager 驱动真实工具体 - `test/benchmark.mjs` / `test/ablation.mjs`：真实目录 + 真实 registry 的测量脚本 - CI：每次 push 跑 `test`；`ablation` 走手动/每周定时任务 ## 已知限制 - 兼容性以 npm 元数据里的 peer / `engines.dsh` 为准，宿主启动预检另有判断时以宿主为准； - **替换已加载插件**仍需要重启宿主（loader 模块缓存 + 打包宿主无 Node 内部 loader）；`plugin_install` 会先比较安装前后的 bundle 集合与运行时文件 hash，只有真正变化时才报 `restart-required`； - 同名歧义不猜，需要调用方给 `owner=` 或完整 spec； - 目录是社区维护的第三方列表，插件只保证"按声明来源装对版本"，不做安全审计； - GitHub 源码构建依赖宿主环境里的 `pnpm`（PATH 或 `DSH_PNPM_PATH`）与 `tar`，大仓库首次构建较慢。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Windows screen control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot, mouse and keyboard input, UI Automation and window management as agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control

[![CI](https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Platform: Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11-0078D4.svg)](#requirements)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4F7CFF.svg)](#install)

**Windows screen control for DeepSeek Harness.** Six `screen_*` tools let an agent look at this desktop and drive it like a person: screenshot, move/click/drag/scroll the real mouse, type Unicode text, send key chords, read the UI Automation tree, focus windows, and wait for UI changes.

Like Codex's computer-use plugin, but built for DSH on Windows with **no dependencies, no MCP server, no compiler**: a single Windows PowerShell 5.1 worker does the Win32 work, and the agent gets first-class tools, approval gating, and an emergency stop.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Tools](docs/tools.md) · [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) · [Verification](docs/verification.md)

---

## Features

- **Look** — full virtual desktop, one window (works while covered, via `PrintWindow`), or a rectangle; PNG/JPEG with optional downscale and a cursor crosshair.
- **Act** — click, double/right/middle click, drag with interpolation, wheel scroll, Unicode typing (Chinese, emoji), key chords such as `ctrl+shift+t`.
- **Understand** — UI Automation tree with control type, name, automation id, rectangle, enabled/off-screen state and values; window list with process names and rectangles.
- **Image-aware** — when the routed model accepts images, the screenshot is committed through the attachment service and returned as a real image block; text-only routes get the file path plus metadata instead.
- **Safe by default** — desktop input is gated by `inputPolicy: "ask"` (one approval per session), `Ctrl+Alt+Esc` stops all input for 30 s, and every call reports the cursor position it actually read back.
- **Cheap to run** — one long-lived worker per profile, serialized requests (~100 ms per action after the first), automatic restart, one-shot fallback when the host forbids piped stdio.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11 with an interactive desktop session.
- DeepSeek Harness (tested with 0.2.1-rc.2).
- Windows PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe`), which ships with Windows. PowerShell 7 is not required.
- Optional: a model that declares image input, for screenshot understanding. Text-only models can still work through `screen_ui`.

## Install

### From GitHub (recommended)

```sh
dsh plugin add github:xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control
```

### From a local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control.git
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control
```

In the desktop app, the equivalent is **Settings → Plugins → Install bundle** with the directory as the target.

### From a release tarball

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/releases/latest/download/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control.tgz
```

After installing, the tools appear on the next turn. The plugin row is called **Screen Control** in Settings → Plugins.

### From the plugin market (Discover)

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 ships the plugin market as an **experimental bundle that is disabled by default**, and it has no built-in index: the Discover tab reads the index URLs you add. Enable the bundle once (Settings → Plugins → *Plugin market*; the package is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle`), then add this index:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control/main/market/index.json
```

The index uses the harness's plugin market format 1 and pins the `v0.1.0` commit, so installing from Discover gets exactly the released code. See [docs/market.md](docs/market.md) for the entry, the update procedure, and the exact validation rules.

## Quick start

Ask the agent for an outcome, not a keystroke:

> Open Notepad, type a haiku about the sea, and screenshot the result.

A typical tool sequence:

1. `screen_windows { action: "list", title: "记事本" }` — is the target already open?
2. `screen_capture { window: "记事本" }` — look before acting.
3. `screen_pointer { action: "click", x: 640, y: 520 }` — click the text area.
4. `screen_keyboard { action: "type", text: "…" }` — type.
5. `screen_capture { window: "记事本" }` — verify the text is really there.

Pixels picked from a screenshot can be reused directly:

```jsonc
// 1) capture returns: source {x:0,y:0,width:2560,height:1600}, scale 0.625
{ "name": "screen_capture", "arguments": { "max_width": 1600 } }

// 2) click the pixel you saw in that image — the plugin maps it back to the screen
{ "name": "screen_pointer", "arguments": { "action": "click", "x": 400, "y": 300, "coordinate_space": "image" } }
```

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `screen_capture` | Screenshot the desktop, a window, or a region; returns path, geometry and (for image-capable models) the image. |
| `screen_pointer` | Move, click, double/right/middle click, drag, scroll. Screen or image coordinates. |
| `screen_keyboard` | Type Unicode text, send a key chord, or paste through the clipboard. |
| `screen_windows` | List top-level windows or focus one by title/handle. |
| `screen_ui` | Read the UI Automation tree of a window as text, with rectangles. |
| `screen_wait` | Sleep, or wait for a window title to appear. |

Full parameter and return contracts: [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md).

## Configuration

The plugin row accepts these keys (all optional; defaults shown):

```yaml
inputPolicy: ask            # ask | allow | deny
capture:
  maxWidth: 1600            # downscale screenshots to this width
  format: png               # png | jpeg
  quality: 82               # jpeg quality
  keepShots: 20             # reserved for capture retention
failsafe:
  enabled: true
  hotkey: ctrl+alt+esc
  cooldownMs: 30000
bridge:
  command: ''               # override the powershell.exe path
  timeoutMs: 15000          # per-action timeout
  restartLimit: 2           # consecutive worker restarts allowed
  idleTimeoutSec: 1800      # worker exits after this much idle time
```

`inputPolicy`:

- `ask` — default. The first pointer or keyboard action in a session asks for approval; the grant is remembered for that session.
- `allow` — no prompts (only for fully trusted sessions).
- `deny` — read-only: screenshots, window and UI Automation queries still work, input is refused.

## Safety and privacy

- **Approval gate.** Desktop input is what a person's hands do; the plugin routes the first input action of a session through the harness approval channel. Screenshots and UI trees never prompt.
- **Emergency stop.** Hold `Ctrl+Alt+Esc` while any input tool runs (or before it) and input is refused for 30 seconds with `E_FAILSAFE`.
- **Elevated windows.** Windows' UIPI blocks synthetic input to processes at a higher integrity level (an administrator app). Run the harness at the same integrity level if you need to drive one; the plugin reports `E_UIPI` when it can detect the refusal.
- **Locked screen.** The secure desktop cannot be captured or driven; expect `E_LOCKED`.
- **Screenshots contain everything on screen**, including other windows. The plugin has no redaction; do not use it on a desktop with content you would not share with the model provider.
- The worker never touches the network. It receives JSON lines on stdin and returns capture files under your temp directory.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause and fix |
| --- | --- |
| `cannot start PowerShell` | `bridge.command` is wrong, or the host forbids child processes. The bridge falls back to one-shot runs automatically. |
| `SetCursorPos failed` / `SendInput rejected input` | The process is confined by an external sandbox, or the desktop is locked. Run the harness in the interactive user session. |
| Screenshot is black | Hardware overlay, DRM-protected video, or the secure deskto

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle
